Profound Diuresis Warning: Furosemide tablets are a potent diuretic which, if given in excessive amounts, can lead to a profound diuresis with water and electrolyte depletion. Therefore, careful medical supervision is required and dose and dose schedule must be adjusted to the individual patient needs.

Impaired neurological function and coma in patients with hepatic impairment, cirrhosis and ascites
Decreased libido, inability to achieve or maintain erection, irregular menses or amenorrhea, postmenopausal bleeding, breast and nipple pain

records.gap_note_zh: ⚠️ 來源不對藥:本筆記錄的 setid 5b44e248… 是「Sorbitol-Mannitol 泌尿科灌洗液」標籤,標籤首行即為「NOT FOR INJECTION BY USUAL PARENTERAL ROUTES / FOR UROLOGIC IRRIGATION ONLY」,且含 sorbitol 為共同成分。這與本卡要教的靜脈滲透性利尿劑(腦水腫、眼壓)不是同一個臨床角色,因此 2026-08-11 這一批刻意不從該標籤填入禁忌與不良反應 —— 填了會把灌洗液的安全資訊掛到靜脈用藥上。需要 Ting 指定一筆靜脈用 mannitol 的 setid 才能續填。
records.setid_fix_note: 2026-08-11: prior setid pointed to a sorbitol-mannitol UROLOGIC IRRIGATION label (wrong clinical role, flagged by pharm enrich batch); replaced with OSMITROL (Baxter) IV injection label after live fetch verification.
contraindications_en: pre-existing severe pulmonary vascular congestion or pulmonary edema
active intracranial bleeding except during craniotomy (OSMITROL label §4).

無尿

records.adverse_effects_en: Hypersensitivity reactions (incl. cardiac arrest, anaphylaxis, hypotension, dyspnea); renal failure (acute kidney injury, osmotic nephrosis, azotemia, anuria); CNS toxicity (coma, seizures); fluid/electrolyte disturbances; infusion-site reactions (OSMITROL label §6, voluntary-report frequency caveat applies).
records.adverse_effects_zh: 過敏反應(含心搏停止、全身性過敏、低血壓、呼吸困難);腎衰竭(急性腎損傷、滲透性腎病、氮血症、無尿);中樞神經毒性(昏迷、癲癇發作);體液與電解質失衡;輸注部位反應(OSMITROL 標籤 §6,自發通報頻率限制適用)。
records.site_of_action_en: Renal tubules (glomerular filtrate osmolarity); extracellular fluid compartment.
records.site_of_action_zh: 腎小管(腎絲球濾液滲透壓);細胞外液腔室。
records.physiologic_effect_en: Osmotic diuresis; redistribution of intracellular water to extracellular/vascular space; lowered intracranial and intraocular pressure.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 滲透性利尿;細胞內水分重新分布至細胞外/血管腔;顱內壓與眼內壓下降。

records.mechanism_en: Inhibits vitamin K epoxide reductase (VKORC1), depleting functional vitamin K and reducing hepatic synthesis of coagulation factors II, VII, IX, and X, as well as anticoagulant proteins C and S.
records.mechanism_zh: 抑制維生素 K 環氧化物還原酶 (VKORC1)，耗竭功能性維生素 K 並降低肝臟凝血因子 II、VII、IX、X 及抗凝血蛋白 C 與 S 之合成。

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: 24-72 hours; Peak effect: 5-7 days; Duration: 2-5 days.
pharmacokinetics.metabolism_en: Hepatic metabolism primarily via CYP2C9 (S-enantiomer) and CYP1A2/CYP3A4 (R-enantiomer).

indications_en: Prophylaxis and treatment of venous thrombosis and pulmonary embolism

records.boxed_warning_en: Warfarin sodium can cause major or fatal bleeding. Perform regular monitoring of INR in all treated patients.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 華法林可造成重大或致命出血。所有用藥病人都須定期監測 INR。
contraindications_en: Pregnancy (except in women with mechanical heart valves)
Recent or contemplated surgery of the central nervous system or eye
Active bleeding of the gastrointestinal, genitourinary or respiratory tract
Unsupervised patients with conditions associated with potential high level of non-compliance
Spinal puncture and other diagnostic or therapeutic procedures with potential for uncontrollable bleeding
Major regional or lumbar block anesthesia
contraindications_zh: 孕婦(機械性心臟瓣膜者除外)
出血傾向或血液惡質
近期或計畫中的中樞神經或眼部手術
胃腸道、泌尿生殖道或呼吸道活動性出血
流產徵象、子癲、子癲前症
無人監督且順從性可能很差的病人

records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Contraindicated in pregnancy (teratogenic; causes fetal warfarin syndrome, nasal hypoplasia, and CNS anomalies).
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Routine INR monitoring required; target therapeutic range usually 2.0-3.0 (2.5-3.5 for mechanical prosthetic valves).
records.acupuncture_note_zh: 禁忌明列「有無法控制出血風險的操作」—— 這一條直接涵蓋侵入性針刺的判斷。臨床上必須先確認 INR 與最近一次抽血日期。標籤未針對針刺給數值門檻,不要自行設一個。
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: 使用華法林患者如有皮膚易瘀斑、齒齦出血、尿血或黑便，應立即評估 INR 並排除嚴重出血風險，切勿單純診斷為血熱妄行或脾不統血。
records.mnemonic_en: Warfare against Vitamin K: Vitamin K antagonist requiring strict INR monitoring.
records.mnemonic_zh: WARFARIN = 對抗維生素 K；監測 INR（目標 2-3）；解毒劑為維生素 K1 或四因子凝血因子濃縮物。
records.classic_association_en: Warfarin -> Vitamin K antagonist -> INR monitoring & Bleeding risk
records.classic_association_zh: 維生素 K 抗衡劑原型 -> 狹窄治療窗口、INR 監測與黑框出血警告
records.exam_trap_en: Warfarin has a narrow therapeutic index; diet (vitamin K rich foods), drugs, and herbs alter INR. Bleeding is the major fatal toxicity.
records.exam_trap_zh: 華法林初始用藥因蛋白 C 快速耗竭可致短暫高凝狀態（皮壞死風險）；初始階段須以肝素進行橋接治療。
records.board_high_yield_en: VKA prototype. Inhibits VKORC1. Reversal: Vitamin K1 (slow), Kcentra/PCC or FFP (immediate). CYP2C9 interactions (Amiodarone increases INR; St. John's Wort decreases INR).

records.herb_drug_interaction_note_zh: 以上七種全部是華法林標籤自己指名的,不是推論。標籤未逐一給機轉與方向,所以本層只記錄「標籤指名」這個事實 —— 要寫成臨床建議需再查 NCCIH 或原始文獻,不可從這一筆推導。中醫常用而標籤未提及的藥(丹參、當歸等)目前為 unknown,尚未查證,不列入以免看起來像已排除。
records.site_of_action_en: The C1 subunit of the vitamin K epoxide reductase (VKORC1) enzyme complex
records.site_of_action_zh: 維生素 K 環氧化物還原酶複合體的 C1 次單元 (VKORC1)
records.physiologic_effect_en: Reduced synthesis of the vitamin K-dependent clotting factors II, VII, IX and X and of the anticoagulant proteins C and S; an anticoagulant effect generally occurs within 24 hours, but peak effect may be delayed 72 to 96 hours
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 減少維生素 K 依賴性凝血因子 II、VII、IX、X 以及抗凝蛋白 C 與 S 的合成;抗凝血作用通常在 24 小時內出現,但作用高峰可能延遲至 72 至 96 小時

records.boxed_warning_en: Effectiveness of clopidogrel depends on conversion to an active metabolite by the cytochrome P450 (CYP) system, principally CYP2C19. Poor metabolizers show diminished antiplatelet effect; consider an alternative P2Y12 inhibitor.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 氯吡格雷須經 CYP450(主要為 CYP2C19)代謝為活性代謝物才有效。代謝不良者抗血小板效果減弱,應考慮改用其他 P2Y12 抑制劑。
contraindications_en: Active pathological bleeding, such as peptic ulcer or intracranial hemorrhage
Hypersensitivity (e.g. anaphylaxis) to clopidogrel or any component of the product
contraindications_zh: 活動性病理性出血,如胃潰瘍或顱內出血
對氯吡格雷或製劑任何成分過敏(如過敏性休克)
records.dailymed_label_title: CLOPIDOGREL (CLOPIDOGREL BISULFATE) TABLET, FILM COATED [PREFERRED PHARMACEUTICALS INC.]
records.gap_note_zh: 交互作用已分級(10 條,全部引用標籤)。植物藥標記為 unknown 並記錄已查來源。機轉、不良反應、作用部位與生理效應已於 2026-08-11 自標籤補入。孕期仍待補。

drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Avoid concomitant use. Omeprazole significantly reduces the antiplatelet activity of clopidogrel, whether given together or 12 hours apart.
drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 避免併用。奧美拉唑顯著降低氯吡格雷的抗血小板活性,不論同時服用或間隔 12 小時。
drug_interactions_graded.note_zh: 這是本藥最重要的交互作用 —— 抗血小板效果減弱代表血栓風險上升,不是出血風險。方向與直覺相反。

drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Avoid concomitant use, same as omeprazole.
drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 同奧美拉唑,避免併用。

drug_interactions_graded.with_label_zh: 泮托拉唑(以及右蘭索拉唑、蘭索拉唑)
drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Had less effect on the antiplatelet activity of clopidogrel than omeprazole or esomeprazole.
drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 對氯吡格雷抗血小板活性的影響小於奧美拉唑與埃索美拉唑。
drug_interactions_graded.note_zh: 標籤明確區分 PPI 之間的差異 —— 不可當成一個分類一起處理。需要 PPI 時這幾個是標籤所指的較小影響選項。

drug_interactions_graded.with_label_zh: 強效 CYP2C19 誘導劑(如利福平)
drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Increase the level of the active metabolite; the label advises avoiding strong CYP2C19 inducers.
drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 提高活性代謝物濃度;標籤建議避免強效 CYP2C19 誘導劑。
drug_interactions_graded.note_zh: 與 warfarin 方向相反 —— warfarin 遇誘導劑是效果減弱,氯吡格雷是前驅藥,遇誘導劑反而活性代謝物變多。考題常拿這兩個對照。

drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Avoid concomitant use of repaglinide with clopidogrel.
drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 避免與氯吡格雷併用。

drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Reduce clopidogrel absorption. The label suggests considering a parenteral antiplatelet agent.
drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 降低氯吡格雷吸收。標籤建議考慮改用非口服抗血小板藥。
drug_interactions_graded.note_zh: 機轉是吸收而非代謝 —— 急性冠心症併用嗎啡時是真實情境。

drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Coadministration increases the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.
drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 併用增加胃腸道出血風險。

drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Increases bleeding because of independent effects on hemostasis.
drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 兩者對止血的作用各自獨立,併用增加出血。

drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Concomitant administration may increase the risk of bleeding.
drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 併用可能增加出血風險。

drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Coadministration increases the risk of bleeding due to an additive effect.
drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 加成作用,併用增加出血風險。

herb_drug_interactions_graded.note_zh: 已查標籤,未指名任何植物藥 —— 與 warfarin 標籤不同(那份指名七種)。這不代表沒有交互,只代表這份來源沒說。要下結論需再查 NCCIH 與原始文獻。

records.exam_trap_zh: ⚠️ 方向陷阱:氯吡格雷是前驅藥。CYP2C19 抑制劑(奧美拉唑)使它變弱 → 血栓風險;誘導劑使它變強。華法林正好相反。
records.exam_trap_en: Direction trap: clopidogrel is a prodrug. A CYP2C19 inhibitor (omeprazole) makes it weaker, raising thrombotic risk; an inducer makes it stronger. Warfarin behaves the opposite way.
indications_en: Acute coronary syndrome (ACS)
Recent myocardial infarction (MI), recent stroke, or established peripheral arterial disease
indications_zh: 急性冠狀動脈症候群 (ACS)
近期心肌梗塞、近期中風或已確立之周圍動脈疾病
records.mnemonic_en: Clopidogrel blocks P2Y12 ADP receptors on platelets.
records.classic_association_en: Clopidogrel -> P2Y12 ADP receptor inhibitor -> Antiplatelet effect
records.mechanism_en: Inhibits platelet activation and aggregation through irreversible binding of its active metabolite to the P2Y12 class of ADP receptors on platelets. Clopidogrel must first be metabolized by CYP450 enzymes to produce that active metabolite.
records.mechanism_zh: 其活性代謝物不可逆地結合血小板上的 P2Y12 型 ADP 受體,藉此抑制血小板活化與凝集。clopidogrel 必須先經 CYP450 酵素代謝才能生成該活性代謝物。
adverse_effects_en: Bleeding, including life-threatening and fatal bleeding — the most commonly reported adverse reaction
adverse_effects_zh: 出血,包括危及生命與致命性出血 —— 最常被通報的不良反應
血栓性血小板減少性紫斑症
records.site_of_action_en: P2Y12 class of ADP receptors on platelets
records.site_of_action_zh: 血小板上的 P2Y12 型 ADP 受體
records.physiologic_effect_en: Irreversible inhibition of ADP-induced platelet aggregation for the remainder of the platelet lifespan, about 7 to 10 days; average inhibition at steady state on 75 mg daily is 40% to 60%, and aggregation returns to baseline about 5 days after discontinuation
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 不可逆地抑制 ADP 誘發的血小板凝集,作用持續至該批血小板生命週期結束,約 7 至 10 天;每日 75 mg 於穩定狀態的平均抑制率為 40% 至 60%,停藥後約 5 天凝集功能回到基線

records.gap_note_zh: 機轉、不良反應、作用部位與生理效應已於 2026-08-11 自標籤補入。交互作用、腎功能調整、孕期仍待補。
records.boxed_warning_en: (A) Premature discontinuation of any oral anticoagulant, including ELIQUIS, increases the risk of thrombotic events. (B) Epidural or spinal hematomas may occur in patients receiving neuraxial anesthesia or undergoing spinal puncture. These hematomas may result in long-term or permanent paralysis.
records.boxed_warning_zh: (A) 提早停用任何口服抗凝劑(含阿哌沙班)會增加血栓事件風險。(B) 接受神經軸麻醉或脊椎穿刺的病人可能發生硬膜外或脊椎血腫,可能導致長期或永久癱瘓。
contraindications_en: Severe hypersensitivity reaction to ELIQUIS (e.g. anaphylactic reactions)
contraindications_zh: 活動性病理性出血
對阿哌沙班嚴重過敏反應(如過敏性休克)
records.dailymed_label_title: ELIQUIS (APIXABAN) TABLET, FILM COATED [CARDINAL HEALTH 107, LLC]
records.acupuncture_note_zh: 黑框第二段講的是**神經軸麻醉與脊椎穿刺**,不是針灸。標籤沒有針對針刺給任何門檻,不要把這一條讀成「不能針」,也不要縮成「比較會出血」—— 它指名的後果是長期或永久癱瘓。臨床上可用的判斷是:督脈與夾脊等近脊椎深刺要特別謹慎,並確認最近一次服藥時間。DOAC 沒有 INR 可查,這是它與 warfarin 最大的差別。
records.monitoring_note_zh: 無常規凝血監測指標 —— 不像 warfarin 有 INR。判斷依據是腎功能、劑量與末次服藥時間。
indications_en: Reduction of risk of stroke and systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation
Prophylaxis of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) following hip/knee replacement
Treatment of DVT and pulmonary embolism (PE)
indications_zh: 非瓣膜性心房顫動患者降低中風與全身性栓塞風險
髖關節/膝關節置換術後深層靜脈血栓預防
深層靜脈血栓 (DVT) 及肺栓塞 (PE) 之治療
records.mnemonic_en: -XABAN indicates Factor Xa inhibitor.
records.exam_trap_en: DOAC Xa inhibitors (-xaban) do not require routine INR monitoring, unlike warfarin, but carry risk of spinal/epidural hematoma during neuraxial anesthesia.
records.mechanism_en: A selective inhibitor of factor Xa that does not require antithrombin III for antithrombotic activity. It inhibits free and clot-bound factor Xa and prothrombinase activity, thereby decreasing thrombin generation and thrombus development.
records.mechanism_zh: 選擇性抑制第十凝血因子活化型 (FXa),且不需要抗凝血酶 III 即可發揮抗血栓作用。它同時抑制游離態與結合於血栓上的 FXa 以及凝血酶原酶活性,因而減少凝血酶生成與血栓形成。
adverse_effects_en: Bleeding — the most common adverse reactions (>1%) in adult patients are related to bleeding
Increased risk of thrombotic events after premature discontinuation
Spinal or epidural hematoma with neuraxial anesthesia or spinal puncture
In pediatric patients, the most common adverse reactions (10% or more) were headache, vomiting, and excessive menstrual bleeding
adverse_effects_zh: 出血 —— 成人最常見的不良反應(大於 1%)皆與出血有關
過早停藥會提高血栓事件風險
接受脊椎或硬脊膜外麻醉、脊椎穿刺時可能發生脊椎或硬脊膜外血腫
兒童病人最常見的不良反應(10% 以上)為頭痛、嘔吐與月經量過多
records.site_of_action_en: Factor Xa, both free and clot-bound, and the prothrombinase complex
records.site_of_action_zh: 游離態與結合於血栓上的 FXa,以及凝血酶原酶複合體
records.physiologic_effect_en: Decreased thrombin generation and thrombus development; no direct effect on platelet aggregation, but indirect inhibition of thrombin-induced platelet aggregation
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 減少凝血酶生成與血栓形成;對血小板凝集沒有直接作用,但可間接抑制凝血酶誘發的血小板凝集

records.gap_note_zh: 機轉、不良反應、作用部位與生理效應已於 2026-08-11 自標籤補入。交互作用、腎功能調整、孕期仍待補。
records.boxed_warning_en: (A) Premature discontinuation of any oral anticoagulant, including rivaroxaban, increases the risk of thrombotic events. (B) Epidural or spinal hematomas may occur in patients receiving neuraxial anesthesia or undergoing spinal puncture. These hematomas may result in long-term or permanent paralysis.
records.boxed_warning_zh: (A) 提早停用任何口服抗凝劑(含利伐沙班)會增加血栓事件風險。(B) 接受神經軸麻醉或脊椎穿刺的病人可能發生硬膜外或脊椎血腫,可能導致長期或永久癱瘓。
contraindications_en: Severe hypersensitivity reaction to rivaroxaban (e.g. anaphylactic reactions)
contraindications_zh: 活動性病理性出血
對利伐沙班嚴重過敏反應(如過敏性休克)
records.acupuncture_note_zh: 黑框第二段講的是**神經軸麻醉與脊椎穿刺**,不是針灸。標籤沒有針對針刺給任何門檻,不要把這一條讀成「不能針」,也不要縮成「比較會出血」—— 它指名的後果是長期或永久癱瘓。臨床上可用的判斷是:督脈與夾脊等近脊椎深刺要特別謹慎,並確認最近一次服藥時間。DOAC 沒有 INR 可查,這是它與 warfarin 最大的差別。
records.monitoring_note_zh: 無常規凝血監測指標 —— 不像 warfarin 有 INR。判斷依據是腎功能、劑量與末次服藥時間。
indications_en: Reduction of risk of stroke and systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation
Treatment of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE)
Prophylaxis of DVT following hip or knee replacement surgery
indications_zh: 非瓣膜性心房顫動患者降低中風與全身性栓塞風險
深層靜脈血栓 (DVT) 及肺栓塞 (PE) 之治療
髖關節或膝關節置換術後深層靜脈血栓預防
records.mnemonic_en: -XABAN indicates Factor Xa inhibitor.
records.exam_trap_en: DOAC Xa inhibitors (-xaban) do not require routine INR monitoring, but carry spinal/epidural hematoma risk during neuraxial procedures.
records.mechanism_en: A selective inhibitor of factor Xa that does not require a cofactor such as antithrombin III for activity. It inhibits free factor Xa and prothrombinase activity, thereby decreasing thrombin generation.
records.mechanism_zh: 選擇性抑制第十凝血因子活化型 (FXa),不需要抗凝血酶 III 之類的輔因子即可作用。它抑制游離態 FXa 與凝血酶原酶活性,因而減少凝血酶生成。
adverse_effects_en: Bleeding — the most common adverse reaction (>5%) in adult patients
Increased risk of stroke after discontinuation in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation
Spinal or epidural hematoma with neuraxial anesthesia or spinal puncture
adverse_effects_zh: 出血 —— 成人最常見的不良反應(大於 5%)
非瓣膜性心房顫動病人停藥後中風風險升高
接受脊椎或硬脊膜外麻醉、脊椎穿刺時可能發生脊椎或硬脊膜外血腫
records.site_of_action_en: Free factor Xa and the prothrombinase complex
records.site_of_action_zh: 游離態 FXa 與凝血酶原酶複合體
records.physiologic_effect_en: Dose-dependent inhibition of factor Xa activity with dose-dependent prolongation of prothrombin time and activated partial thromboplastin time; monitoring of the anticoagulant effect by anti-factor Xa activity or a clotting test is not recommended
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 呈劑量依賴性地抑制 FXa 活性,凝血酶原時間與活化部分凝血活酶時間也隨劑量延長;但不建議以抗 FXa 活性或凝血試驗來監測其抗凝血效果

records.boxed_warning_zh: (A) 提早停用任何口服抗凝劑(含達比加群酯)會增加血栓事件風險。(B) 接受神經軸麻醉或脊椎穿刺的病人可能發生硬膜外或脊椎血腫。

對達比加群、達比加群酯或賦形劑曾有嚴重過敏反應
機械性人工心臟瓣膜

records.exam_trap_zh: ⚠️ 機械性人工心臟瓣膜:達比加群是禁忌,華法林是適應症 —— 方向完全相反。這是 DOAC 不能一律取代 warfarin 的具體例子。
records.exam_trap_en: Mechanical prosthetic heart valve: contraindicated for dabigatran, but an indication for warfarin. DOACs do not simply replace warfarin.
records.acupuncture_note_zh: 黑框第二段指的是神經軸麻醉與脊椎穿刺,不是針灸。無常規凝血監測指標。
records.monitoring_note_zh: 無常規監測 —— 與其他 DOAC 相同,不像 warfarin 有 INR。
records.mechanism_en: Dabigatran and its acyl glucuronides are competitive, direct thrombin inhibitors. Because thrombin enables the conversion of fibrinogen into fibrin during the coagulation cascade, its inhibition prevents the development of a thrombus. Both free and clot-bound thrombin, and thrombin-induced platelet aggregation, are inhibited.
records.mechanism_zh: dabigatran 及其醯基葡萄糖醛酸苷是競爭性的直接凝血酶抑制劑。凝血酶在凝血瀑布中負責把纖維蛋白原轉為纖維蛋白,抑制凝血酶即可阻止血栓形成。游離態與結合於血栓上的凝血酶,以及凝血酶誘發的血小板凝集,都會被抑制。
indications_en: To reduce the risk of stroke and systemic embolism in adults with non-valvular atrial fibrillation
Treatment of deep venous thrombosis and pulmonary embolism in adults treated with a parenteral anticoagulant for 5 to 10 days
To reduce the risk of recurrence of deep venous thrombosis and pulmonary embolism in previously treated adults
Prophylaxis of deep venous thrombosis and pulmonary embolism in adults who have undergone hip replacement surgery
Treatment of venous thromboembolic events in pediatric patients 8 to under 18 years of age treated with a parenteral anticoagulant for at least 5 days
To reduce the risk of recurrence of venous thromboembolism in previously treated pediatric patients 8 to under 18 years of age
indications_zh: 降低非瓣膜性心房顫動成人病人的中風與全身性栓塞風險
已接受注射型抗凝劑治療 5 至 10 天的成人,用於治療深層靜脈栓塞與肺栓塞
降低曾接受治療的成人深層靜脈栓塞與肺栓塞的復發風險
接受髖關節置換手術的成人,用於預防深層靜脈栓塞與肺栓塞
已接受注射型抗凝劑治療至少 5 天、8 歲至未滿 18 歲的兒童病人,用於治療靜脈血栓栓塞事件
降低曾接受治療、8 歲至未滿 18 歲兒童病人的靜脈血栓栓塞復發風險
adverse_effects_en: Bleeding — the most serious adverse reactions reported are related to bleeding
Gastrointestinal adverse reactions — with bleeding, the most common adverse reactions (>15%)
Increased risk of thrombotic events after premature discontinuation
Spinal or epidural hematoma with neuraxial anesthesia or spinal puncture
Thromboembolic and bleeding events in patients with prosthetic heart valves
adverse_effects_zh: 出血 —— 通報中最嚴重的不良反應皆與出血有關
腸胃道不良反應 —— 與出血同為最常見的不良反應(大於 15%)
過早停藥會提高血栓事件風險
接受脊椎或硬脊膜外麻醉、脊椎穿刺時可能發生脊椎或硬脊膜外血腫
裝有人工心臟瓣膜的病人可能發生血栓栓塞與出血事件
records.site_of_action_en: Thrombin (factor IIa), both free and clot-bound
records.site_of_action_zh: 凝血酶(第二凝血因子活化型),包括游離態與結合於血栓上者
records.physiologic_effect_en: Prevention of thrombus development by blocking conversion of fibrinogen to fibrin; at therapeutic doses it prolongs aPTT, ECT, TT and dTT, while INR is relatively insensitive and cannot be interpreted as it is for warfarin
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 阻斷纖維蛋白原轉為纖維蛋白,藉此防止血栓形成;治療劑量下會延長 aPTT、ECT、TT 與 dTT,而 INR 對其相對不敏感,不能比照 warfarin 的方式判讀

records.boxed_warning_en: Ticagrelor, like other antiplatelet agents, can cause significant, sometimes fatal bleeding. Do not use in patients with active pathological bleeding or a history of intracranial hemorrhage. Do not start in patients undergoing urgent coronary artery bypass graft surgery (CABG). If possible, manage bleeding without discontinuing ticagrelor: stopping it increases the risk of subsequent cardiovascular events.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 替格瑞洛如同其他抗血小板藥,可造成顯著、有時致命的出血。活動性病理性出血或有顱內出血病史者不可使用。正接受緊急冠狀動脈繞道手術者不可起始使用。若可能,處理出血時不要停藥 —— 停藥會增加後續心血管事件風險。
contraindications_en: Active pathological bleeding such as peptic ulcer or intracranial hemorrhage
Hypersensitivity (e.g. angioedema) to ticagrelor or any component of the product
contraindications_zh: 曾有顱內出血病史
活動性病理性出血,如胃潰瘍或顱內出血
對替格瑞洛或製劑任何成分過敏(如血管性水腫)

records.exam_trap_zh: ⚠️ 禁忌是**顱內出血**病史,不是 TIA／中風 —— 那是普拉格雷。兩者常被對調。另外黑框特別寫「若可能不要停藥」,因為停藥本身會增加心血管事件。
records.exam_trap_en: The contraindication is a history of intracranial hemorrhage, not TIA or stroke — that is prasugrel. The boxed warning also says to manage bleeding without stopping the drug where possible, since stopping raises cardiovascular risk.
records.acupuncture_note_zh: 黑框明寫「若可能不要停藥」—— 所以不要為了針灸建議病人停藥,那不是我們能決定的,要由開藥醫師判斷。
records.mechanism_en: Ticagrelor and its major metabolite reversibly interact with the platelet P2Y12 ADP receptor to prevent signal transduction and platelet activation. Ticagrelor and its active metabolite are approximately equipotent.
records.mechanism_zh: ticagrelor 與其主要代謝物可逆地作用於血小板 P2Y12 ADP 受體,阻斷訊息傳遞與血小板活化。原藥與其活性代謝物的效價大致相當。
indications_en: To reduce the risk of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, and stroke in patients with acute coronary syndrome or a history of myocardial infarction; it also reduces the risk of stent thrombosis in patients stented for acute coronary syndrome
To reduce the risk of a first myocardial infarction or stroke in patients with coronary artery disease at high risk for such events
To reduce the risk of stroke in patients with acute ischemic stroke (NIH Stroke Scale score 5 or less) or high-risk transient ischemic attack
indications_zh: 降低急性冠心症或曾發生心肌梗塞病人的心血管死亡、心肌梗塞與中風風險;對因急性冠心症置放支架者亦可降低支架內血栓風險
降低高風險冠狀動脈疾病病人首次發生心肌梗塞或中風的風險
降低急性缺血性中風(NIH 中風量表 5 分以下)或高風險短暫性腦缺血病人的中風風險
adverse_effects_en: Bleeding — with dyspnea, the most common adverse reactions (>5%)
adverse_effects_zh: 出血 —— 與呼吸困難同為最常見的不良反應(大於 5%)
records.site_of_action_en: Platelet P2Y12 ADP receptor
records.site_of_action_zh: 血小板 P2Y12 ADP 受體
records.physiologic_effect_en: Reversible inhibition of platelet aggregation; maximum inhibition is reached at around 2 hours after a loading dose and maintained for at least 8 hours, and by 5 days after the last dose inhibition is similar to placebo
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 可逆地抑制血小板凝集;給予負荷劑量後約 2 小時達最大抑制並可維持至少 8 小時,末次給藥後 5 天抑制程度已與安慰劑相當

records.boxed_warning_en: Prasugrel can cause significant, sometimes fatal, bleeding. Do not use in patients with active pathological bleeding or a history of transient ischemic attack or stroke. Do not start in patients likely to undergo urgent coronary artery bypass graft surgery (CABG).
records.boxed_warning_zh: 普拉格雷可造成顯著、有時致命的出血。活動性病理性出血或有短暫性腦缺血(TIA)／中風病史者不可使用。可能需接受緊急冠狀動脈繞道手術(CABG)者不可起始使用。

contraindications_zh: 活動性病理性出血,如胃潰瘍或顱內出血
曾有短暫性腦缺血(TIA)或中風病史

indications_en: dailymed:f51e64e0-f556-65d0-a876-fb709aaeefea#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE

records.exam_trap_zh: ⚠️ TIA／中風病史是普拉格雷的禁忌 —— 這一條 clopidogrel 與 ticagrelor 都沒有。三個 P2Y12 抑制劑不可互換。
records.exam_trap_en: A history of TIA or stroke contraindicates prasugrel; clopidogrel and ticagrelor do not carry that. The three P2Y12 inhibitors are not interchangeable.
records.acupuncture_note_zh: 黑框直接寫「顯著、有時致命的出血」。針刺前需確認是否仍在服用及末次劑量;無常規監測指標。
records.mechanism_en: Inhibits platelet activation and aggregation through the irreversible binding of its active metabolite to the P2Y12 class of ADP receptors on platelets.
records.mechanism_zh: 其活性代謝物不可逆地結合血小板上的 P2Y12 型 ADP 受體,藉此抑制血小板活化與凝集。
indications_en: Reduction of thrombotic cardiovascular events, including stent thrombosis, in patients with acute coronary syndrome managed with percutaneous coronary intervention: patients with unstable angina or non-ST-elevation myocardial infarction
Reduction of thrombotic cardiovascular events in patients with ST-elevation myocardial infarction when managed with primary or delayed percutaneous coronary intervention
indications_zh: 降低以經皮冠狀動脈介入治療處理的急性冠心症病人之血栓性心血管事件(含支架內血栓):適用於不穩定型心絞痛或非 ST 段上升型心肌梗塞病人
ST 段上升型心肌梗塞病人接受初級或延遲經皮冠狀動脈介入治療時,降低血栓性心血管事件
adverse_effects_en: Bleeding, including life-threatening and fatal bleeding — the most commonly reported adverse reaction
adverse_effects_zh: 出血,包括危及生命與致命性出血 —— 最常被通報的不良反應
血栓性血小板減少性紫斑症
過敏反應,包括血管性水腫
records.site_of_action_en: P2Y12 class of ADP receptors on platelets
records.site_of_action_zh: 血小板上的 P2Y12 型 ADP 受體
records.physiologic_effect_en: Approximately 90% of patients achieve at least 50% inhibition of platelet aggregation within 1 hour of a 60 mg loading dose, with maximum inhibition about 80%; aggregation returns to baseline over 5 to 9 days after discontinuation, reflecting new platelet production
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 給予 60 mg 負荷劑量後 1 小時內,約 90% 的病人血小板凝集抑制達 50% 以上,最大抑制約 80%;停藥後 5 至 9 天凝集功能回到基線,反映的是新血小板生成而非藥物本身的藥動學

records.dual_role_note_zh: 低劑量抗血小板(本層),高劑量為 NSAID(P4)。同一分子兩種臨床角色,不要合併成一句。
records.gap_note_zh: 交互作用、高劑量 NSAID 角色(P4)待補。低劑量抗血小板與高劑量 NSAID 是同一分子的兩種角色,不要合併。⚠️ 2026-08-11 查證:本筆引用的 OTC Drug Facts 標籤沒有 CONTRAINDICATIONS 與 ADVERSE REACTIONS 區段(原 dailymed_api_responses.json 誤記為有),因此 contraindications_en 的來源已改指向實際存在的 Do not use 與 Warnings 區段。機轉與不良反應無法從這張標籤取得,需要一張處方藥標籤或另一具名來源。另請 Ting 裁示:contraindications 第三項「每日飲酒三杯以上」在標籤上屬於胃出血的風險因子,不是 Do not use 條目,是否要移到 warnings。
contraindications_en: Allergy to aspirin or any other pain reliever/fever reducer
Children and teenagers who have or are recovering from chicken pox or flu-like symptoms (Reye syndrome risk)
Three or more alcoholic drinks every day while using this product
contraindications_zh: 對阿斯匹靈或任何其他止痛/退燒藥過敏
正在或剛從水痘或類流感症狀恢復的兒童與青少年(雷氏症候群風險)
用藥期間每日飲酒三杯以上
warnings_en: Aspirin may cause a severe allergic reaction including hives, facial swelling, shock, or asthma (wheezing)
Ask a doctor before use with stomach problems, age 60 or over, prior stomach ulcers or bleeding problems, or if taking blood thinning drugs
Stop use and seek immediate medical help for signs of stomach bleeding: feeling faint, bloody or black stools, vomiting blood, or unrelieved stomach pain
warnings_zh: 可能引起嚴重過敏反應,包括蕁麻疹、顏面腫脹、休克或氣喘(喘鳴)
有胃部問題、年齡 60 歲以上、曾有胃潰瘍或出血問題、或正在服用抗凝血藥者,使用前應諮詢醫師
出現胃出血徵象時立即停用並就醫:頭暈欲昏、血便或黑便、吐血、持續不緩解的胃痛

records.label_format_note_zh: 本筆引用的是 OTC「Drug Facts」格式標籤,不是處方藥的 PLR/舊格式 —— 沒有 BOXED WARNING 區段,對應內容在 Do not use 與 Warnings。欄位對照時要注意,不要因為沒有 boxed_warning 就以為漏查。
records.acupuncture_note_zh: 標籤明列「正在服用抗凝血藥者使用前應諮詢醫師」—— 病人自行買 OTC 阿斯匹靈加上處方抗凝劑是很常見的組合,問診時要主動問,因為病人常不把 OTC 當成「藥」。
records.exam_trap_zh: ⚠️ 雷氏症候群:兒童與青少年在水痘或類流感期間禁用 —— 這是 OTC 標籤上明列的,考題常出。
records.exam_trap_en: Reye syndrome: contraindicated in children and teenagers with or recovering from chicken pox or flu-like symptoms.
indications_en: Analgesia, antipyresis, and anti-inflammatory therapy
Vascular indications: reduction of risk of death and arterial thromboembolic events in ACS, TIA, ischemic stroke
indications_zh: 鎮痛、解熱及抗發炎
血管適應症：降低 ACS、短暫性腦缺血 (TIA) 及缺血性中風之死亡與動脈血栓風險
records.mnemonic_en: Irreversible COX-1 inhibitor antiplatelet.
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid ac94cce3-9a39-41de-bb8b-10a5e5b8e83b)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid ac94cce3-9a39-41de-bb8b-10a5e5b8e83b), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.gap_note_zh: 機轉、不良反應、作用部位與生理效應已於 2026-08-11 自標籤補入 —— 註:該標籤的 MECHANISM OF ACTION 只有一句話,作用部位是依 PHARMACODYNAMICS 的抗 FXa/抗 FIIa 比值敘述而來。交互作用、腎功能調整、孕期仍待補。
records.boxed_warning_en: Epidural or spinal hematomas may occur in patients anticoagulated with low molecular weight heparins (LMWH) or heparinoids who are receiving neuraxial anesthesia or undergoing spinal puncture. These hematomas may result in long-term or permanent paralysis. Risk is increased by indwelling epidural catheters; concomitant drugs affecting hemostasis such as NSAIDs, platelet inhibitors and other anticoagulants; a history of traumatic or repeated epidural or spinal punctures; and a history of spinal deformity or spinal surgery.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 使用低分子量肝素或類肝素抗凝、且接受神經軸麻醉或脊椎穿刺的病人可能發生硬膜外或脊椎血腫,可能導致長期或永久癱瘓。風險增加因子:留置硬膜外導管;併用影響止血的藥物(NSAID、抗血小板藥、其他抗凝劑);曾有創傷性或反覆的硬膜外／脊椎穿刺病史;脊椎變形或脊椎手術病史。
contraindications_en: History of heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT) within the past 100 days or in the presence of circulating antibodies
Known hypersensitivity to heparin or pork products
contraindications_zh: 活動性大出血
過去 100 天內曾有肝素誘發血小板減少症(HIT),或體內有循環抗體
對依諾肝素鈉過敏
對肝素或豬類製品過敏
records.acupuncture_note_zh: 這是全 P1 層唯一列出**風險因子清單**的黑框,其中兩條值得注意:①「併用影響止血的藥物(NSAID、抗血小板藥、其他抗凝劑)」——雙重抗凝／抗血小板的病人風險更高;②「曾有創傷性或反覆的硬膜外／脊椎穿刺病史」。第②條講的是硬膜外與脊椎穿刺,**不是針灸**,標籤沒有把針刺納入。但它說明了「反覆穿刺」本身是風險因子,近脊椎深刺時值得納入判斷。標籤未給任何針灸門檻,不要自行推導一個。
records.cultural_note_zh: 肝素為豬源 —— 對豬類製品過敏是明列禁忌,穆斯林、猶太教與素食病人也可能有非醫療考量,問診時值得主動提及。
records.exam_trap_zh: ⚠️ HIT(肝素誘發血小板減少症)是禁忌,而且標籤明訂「過去 100 天內」的時間窗。
indications_en: Prophylaxis of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) in abdominal surgery, hip/knee replacement, or medical patients with severely restricted mobility
Inpatient and outpatient treatment of acute DVT
Prophylaxis of ischemic complications of unstable angina and non-Q-wave MI
indications_zh: 腹部手術、髖/膝關節置換術或極度行動不便內科病人深層靜脈血栓之預防
急性深層靜脈血栓住院及門診治療
不穩定型心絞痛及非 Q 波心肌梗塞缺血性併發症之預防
records.mnemonic_en: Low Molecular Weight Heparin (LMWH).
records.exam_trap_en: Monitored via anti-Factor Xa levels when necessary (e.g. renal failure or pregnancy), NOT routine aPTT.
records.mechanism_en: Enoxaparin is a low molecular weight heparin with antithrombotic properties, characterized by a substantially higher ratio of anti-factor Xa to anti-factor IIa activity than unfractionated heparin.
records.mechanism_zh: enoxaparin 是具有抗血栓作用的低分子量肝素,其抗 FXa 與抗 FIIa 活性的比值遠高於未分餾肝素。
adverse_effects_en: Bleeding and increased risk of hemorrhage
Fever, edema, peripheral edema, dyspnea, and confusion
Spinal or epidural hematoma with neuraxial anesthesia or spinal puncture
adverse_effects_zh: 發燒、水腫、周邊水腫、呼吸困難與意識混亂
接受脊椎或硬脊膜外麻醉、脊椎穿刺時可能發生脊椎或硬脊膜外血腫
records.site_of_action_en: Factor Xa and, to a much lesser extent, factor IIa (thrombin)
records.site_of_action_zh: 第十凝血因子活化型 (FXa),對第二凝血因子活化型(凝血酶)的作用則小得多
records.physiologic_effect_en: Anti-factor Xa activity predominates over anti-factor IIa activity, with a mean ratio of 14.0 compared with 1.22 for unfractionated heparin; thrombin time and aPTT are increased up to 1.8 times control values
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 抗 FXa 活性明顯強於抗 FIIa 活性,平均比值為 14.0,而未分餾肝素僅 1.22;凝血酶時間與 aPTT 最多可延長至對照值的 1.8 倍

records.gap_note_zh: 機轉、適應症、不良反應、作用部位與生理效應已於 2026-08-11 自標籤補入。交互作用、劑量、孕期仍待補。
contraindications_en: Known hypersensitivity to heparin or pork products
When suitable blood coagulation tests cannot be performed at appropriate intervals
An uncontrolled active bleeding state, except when due to disseminated intravascular coagulation
contraindications_zh: 嚴重血小板減少
對肝素或豬類製品過敏
無法在適當間隔進行合適凝血檢驗時
無法控制的活動性出血,但因瀰漫性血管內凝血(DIC)所致者除外
warnings_en: Heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT) is a serious antibody-mediated reaction that may progress to venous and arterial thrombosis (HITT). If the platelet count falls below 100,000/mm3 or recurrent thrombosis develops, promptly discontinue heparin, evaluate for HIT and HITT, and administer an alternative anticoagulant.
Fatal hemorrhages have occurred in pediatric patients due to medication errors in which 1 mL heparin sodium injection vials were confused with catheter lock flush vials.
warnings_zh: 肝素誘發血小板減少症(HIT)是抗體媒介的嚴重反應,可能進展為靜脈與動脈血栓(HITT)。血小板降至 100,000/mm3 以下或再發血栓時,應立即停用肝素、評估 HIT 與 HITT,並改用其他抗凝劑。
曾發生兒科病人致命出血 —— 因 1 mL 肝素注射瓶與導管沖洗瓶混淆的給藥錯誤。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 本標籤**沒有**黑框警告 —— 已查證,不是漏查。低分子量肝素(依諾肝素)反而有脊椎血腫黑框,兩者不同,不要互相套用。

warnings_en: dailymed:9ea0a519-dc7c-42e3-939e-2a7c80eedd25#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.exam_trap_zh: ⚠️ 禁忌明列「無法在適當間隔進行凝血檢驗時」—— 肝素需要監測(aPTT),這與 DOAC 無監測、warfarin 用 INR 各不相同。三種抗凝劑三種監測方式。
records.exam_trap_en: Contraindicated when suitable coagulation tests cannot be performed at appropriate intervals. Heparin needs monitoring (aPTT), warfarin uses INR, DOACs have no routine monitor - three different answers.
records.acupuncture_note_zh: 靜脈/皮下給藥,住院情境為主,門診針灸較少遇到。若病人剛出院仍在用,出血風險高且需監測。豬源過敏同依諾肝素。
records.mechanism_en: Heparin interacts with the naturally occurring plasma protein antithrombin III to induce a conformational change that markedly enhances its serine protease activity, thereby inhibiting the activated coagulation factors in the clotting sequence, particularly Xa and IIa. Small amounts inhibit factor Xa and larger amounts inhibit thrombin. Heparin also prevents formation of a stable fibrin clot by inhibiting activation of the fibrin stabilizing factor, and has no fibrinolytic activity.
records.mechanism_zh: 肝素與血漿中天然的抗凝血酶 III 結合,誘發其構型改變而大幅增強其絲胺酸蛋白酶活性,進而抑制凝血瀑布中已活化的凝血因子,尤以 Xa 與 IIa 為主。小劑量主要抑制 FXa,大劑量才抑制凝血酶。肝素另可抑制纖維蛋白穩定因子的活化,阻止穩定血栓形成;它沒有溶解血栓的作用。
indications_en: Prophylaxis and treatment of venous thrombosis and pulmonary embolism
Prevention of postoperative deep venous thrombosis and pulmonary embolism in patients undergoing major abdominothoracic surgery or otherwise at risk of thromboembolic disease
Atrial fibrillation with embolization
Treatment of acute and chronic consumptive coagulopathies (disseminated intravascular coagulation)
Prevention of clotting in arterial and cardiac surgery
Prophylaxis and treatment of peripheral arterial embolism
Anticoagulant use in blood transfusions, extracorporeal circulation, and dialysis procedures
indications_zh: 靜脈血栓與肺栓塞的預防及治療
接受腹胸腔大手術或因其他原因具血栓栓塞風險者,預防術後深層靜脈栓塞與肺栓塞
心房顫動併發栓塞
急性與慢性消耗性凝血病變(瀰漫性血管內凝血)的治療
動脈與心臟手術中防止血液凝固
周邊動脈栓塞的預防及治療
輸血、體外循環與透析過程中的抗凝用途
adverse_effects_en: Heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT) and heparin-induced thrombocytopenia with thrombosis (HITT)
adverse_effects_zh: 肝素誘發血小板減少症 (HIT) 與肝素誘發血小板減少併血栓症 (HITT)
records.site_of_action_en: Antithrombin III in plasma; the resulting complex inhibits the activated coagulation factors, particularly Xa and IIa (thrombin)
records.site_of_action_zh: 血漿中的抗凝血酶 III;所形成的複合體再去抑制已活化的凝血因子,尤以 Xa 與 IIa(凝血酶)為主
records.physiologic_effect_en: Full therapeutic doses prolong the activated clotting time, activated partial thromboplastin time, prothrombin time and whole blood clotting time; low doses usually do not measurably affect them, and bleeding time is usually unaffected. Existing clots are not lysed.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 足量治療劑量會延長活化凝血時間、活化部分凝血活酶時間、凝血酶原時間與全血凝固時間;低劑量通常不會造成可測得的改變,出血時間一般也不受影響。既有的血栓不會被溶解。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: This label carries **no** boxed warning — verified, not an omission. Low-molecular-weight heparin (enoxaparin), by contrast, carries a spinal/epidural hematoma boxed warning; the two are different drugs — do not carry one over to the other.

records.mechanism_en: Selectively blocks angiotensin II binding to AT1 receptors, preventing vasoconstriction and aldosterone release.
records.mechanism_zh: 選擇性阻斷血管緊張素 II 與 AT1 受體結合，抑制血管收縮與醛固酮釋放。
indications_en: Hypertension
Diabetic nephropathy in type 2 diabetes
Stroke risk reduction in hypertension with left ventricular hypertrophy
indications_zh: 高血壓
第 2 型糖尿病之糖尿病腎病變
降低高血壓合併左心室肥大患者之中風風險
records.boxed_warning_en: Fetal Toxicity: Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus. Discontinue as soon as possible when pregnancy is detected.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 胎兒毒性：直接作用於腎素-血管緊張素系統的藥物會對發育中的胎兒造成傷害甚至死亡。一旦發現懷孕，應儘速停藥。
contraindications_en: Hypersensitivity to losartan or any component
Co-administration of aliskiren with losartan in patients with diabetes
contraindications_zh: 對氯沙坦或其任何成分過敏
糖尿病患者禁止聯合使用阿利吉崙 (aliskiren)
warnings_en: Fetal toxicity
Hypotension in volume- or salt-depleted patients
Impaired renal function
Hyperkalemia

drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Increased risk of hyperkalemia
Increases serum lithium concentrations and risk of lithium toxicity

records.mnemonic_en: -SARTAN indicates ARB. Think: hypertension, diabetic nephropathy, hyperkalemia, and fetal toxicity.
records.exam_trap_en: ARBs avoid ACE inhibitor-induced cough and angioedema, but still carry severe fetal toxicity boxed warning and hyperkalemia risk.
records.exam_trap_zh: ARBs 不會引起 ACEi 常見的乾咳與血管神經性水腫，但仍具有嚴重的胎兒毒性黑框警告與高血鉀風險。
records.classic_association_en: ARB (-sartan) -> Hyperkalemia & Fetal toxicity boxed warning
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: 服藥患者若出現頭暈、疲倦或血壓過低，需考量血管收縮素受體阻斷劑造成之血容量或電解質變化，避免單純歸咎於氣血兩虛。
records.dailymed_label_title: LOSARTAN POTASSIUM TABLET, FILM COATED [PREFERRED PHARMACEUTICALS INC.]

warnings_en: dailymed:9501dfaa-c8cf-46d6-8bec-936c4fd8fe03#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.site_of_action_en: Angiotensin II type 1 (AT1) receptor, found in many tissues including vascular smooth muscle and the adrenal gland
records.site_of_action_zh: 第一型血管收縮素 II 受體 (AT1),分布於血管平滑肌與腎上腺等多種組織
records.physiologic_effect_en: Blockade of the vasoconstrictor and aldosterone-secreting effects of angiotensin II; a 100 mg dose inhibits the pressor effect of angiotensin II by about 85% at peak, with 25% to 40% inhibition persisting for 24 hours. Unlike ACE inhibitors, losartan does not affect the response to bradykinin.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 阻斷血管收縮素 II 的血管收縮與促醛固酮分泌作用;100 mg 劑量在作用高峰可抑制其升壓效應約 85%,24 小時後仍維持 25% 至 40% 的抑制。與 ACE 抑制劑不同,losartan 不影響對緩激肽的反應。

records.mechanism_en: Inhibits angiotensin-converting enzyme, blocking conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II and reducing aldosterone secretion.
records.mechanism_zh: 抑制血管緊張素轉換酶，阻斷血管緊張素 I 轉化為 II，並減少醛固酮分泌。

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: 1 hour; Peak: 6 hours; Duration: 24 hours.

indications_en: Hypertension
Heart failure
Reduction of mortality in hemodynamically stable patients within 24 hours of acute myocardial infarction
indications_zh: 高血壓
心衰竭
急性心肌梗塞 24 小時內血流動力學穩定患者之死亡率降低
serious_adverse_effects_en: Acute renal failure in bilateral renal artery stenosis
records.boxed_warning_en: Fetal Toxicity: Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus. Discontinue as soon as possible when pregnancy is detected.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 胎兒毒性：直接作用於腎素-血管緊張素系統的藥物會對發育中的胎兒造成傷害甚至死亡。一旦發現懷孕，應儘速停藥。
contraindications_en: Concomitant use or administration within 36 hours of switching to or from a neprilysin inhibitor (e.g., sacubitril/valsartan)
History of angioedema or hypersensitivity related to previous treatment with an angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor
Concomitant use with aliskiren in patients with diabetes
contraindications_zh: 禁止併用腦啡肽酶抑制劑（如 sacubitril/valsartan）或於換藥前後 36 小時內給藥
曾對血管緊張素轉換酶 (ACE) 抑制劑治療產生血管神經性水腫或過敏病史
遺傳性或特發性血管神經性水腫
糖尿病患者禁止聯合使用阿利吉崙 (aliskiren)
records.renal_considerations_en: Dose reduction required in renal impairment (eGFR < 30 mL/min). Monitor serum creatinine and potassium.
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Boxed warning for fetal toxicity (Category D in 2nd/3rd trimesters). Discontinue immediately if pregnancy detected.
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor renal function (BUN/creatinine) and serum potassium baseline and periodically.
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: ACE 抑制劑常引致慢性無痰乾咳（緩激肽積聚所致），針灸或中藥診治肺陰虛乾咳時應先確認患者是否服用 -pril 類降壓藥，避免將藥物副作用誤診為內傷咳嗽。
records.mnemonic_en: -PRIL indicates ACE inhibitor. Think: cough, hyperkalemia, angioedema, and fetal toxicity.
records.mnemonic_zh: -PRIL 代表 ACE 抑制劑。記憶重點：乾咳、高血鉀、血管神經性水腫、胎兒毒性。
records.classic_association_en: ACE inhibitor (-pril) -> Dry cough & Angioedema & Fetal toxicity boxed warning
records.classic_association_zh: ACE 抑制劑 (-pril) -> 乾咳、血管神經性水腫與胎兒毒性黑框警告
records.exam_trap_en: Dry cough and angioedema are classic ACE inhibitor adverse effects due to bradykinin accumulation; sacubitril co-administration requires 36h washout.
records.exam_trap_zh: 乾咳與血管神經性水腫是 ACEi 因緩激肽積聚導致的經典不良反應；與 sacubitril 換藥須嚴格遵守 36 小時洗脫期。
records.board_high_yield_en: ACEi prototype. Causes dry cough & angioedema due to bradykinin breakdown inhibition. Contraindicated with sacubitril (36h washout) and in pregnancy.
records.site_of_action_en: Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE), a peptidyl dipeptidase that catalyzes conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II
records.site_of_action_zh: 血管收縮素轉換酶 (ACE) —— 一種胜肽基二肽酶,負責把血管收縮素 I 轉為血管收縮素 II
records.physiologic_effect_en: Decreased plasma angiotensin II leading to decreased vasopressor activity and decreased aldosterone secretion, which may produce a small increase in serum potassium; supine and standing blood pressure fall to about the same extent with no compensatory tachycardia, with onset at one hour and peak reduction by six hours
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 血漿中血管收縮素 II 下降,升壓活性與醛固酮分泌隨之減少,血鉀可能因此略為上升;臥姿與站姿血壓下降幅度相近,且不會出現代償性心搏過速,口服後約 1 小時起效、6 小時達最大降壓效果

records.mechanism_en: Selective beta-1 adrenergic receptor blocker, reducing heart rate, cardiac output, and blood pressure.
records.mechanism_zh: 選擇性 beta-1 腎上腺素受體阻斷劑，降低心跳率、心輸出量與血壓。
records.pharmacodynamics_summary_en: Competitive inhibition of beta-1 receptors in cardiac tissue decreases chronotropic and inotropic activity.

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: 1-2 hours (oral); Duration: 6-12 hours (tartrate), 24 hours (succinate ER).

indications_en: Hypertension
Angina pectoris
Stable symptomatic heart failure (metoprolol succinate extended-release formulation)
indications_zh: 高血壓
心絞痛
穩定具症狀之心衰竭（美托洛爾琥珀酸鹽緩釋劑型）
warnings_en: Abrupt Cessation: Abrupt cessation of therapy can exacerbate angina and lead to myocardial infarction. When discontinuing long-term therapy, dosage should be gradually reduced over 1 to 2 weeks.
warnings_zh: 突發停藥：突發停用美托洛爾可能加重心絞痛並導致心肌梗塞。長期治療停藥時應在 1 至 2 週內逐漸減量。
contraindications_en: Sick sinus syndrome (unless a permanent pacemaker is in place)
Hypersensitivity to metoprolol or any component of the product
contraindications_zh: 嚴重心跳過緩
二度或三度房室傳導阻滯
心源性休克
失代償性心臟衰竭
病竇症候群（除非已植入永久性心律調節器）
對美托洛爾或產品任何成分過敏
records.renal_considerations_en: No major dosage adjustment required in renal impairment.
records.hepatic_considerations_en: Consider lower initial dose in severe hepatic impairment due to decreased CYP2D6 clearance.
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy Category C; may cause fetal bradycardia and hypoglycemia near term.
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and ECG during dosage titration.
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: 患者如出現脈遲（心率過緩）、手足厥冷或極度倦怠，應考量美托洛爾之 beta-1 阻斷效應，避免單純歸結為陽虛或宗氣不足。
records.mnemonic_en: -OLOL indicates Beta blocker. Think: bradycardia, bronchospasm risk, masking hypoglycemia, and abrupt withdrawal danger.
records.mnemonic_zh: -OLOL 代表 Beta 阻斷劑。記憶重點：心慢、氣管痙攣風險、掩蓋低血糖、突發停藥危險。
records.classic_association_en: Beta-1 selective blocker (-olol) -> Bradycardia & Abrupt withdrawal rebound angina risk
records.classic_association_zh: Beta-1 選擇性阻斷劑 (-olol) -> 心跳過緩與突發停藥反彈性心絞痛風險
records.exam_trap_en: Abrupt withdrawal of metoprolol can trigger severe rebound angina or MI; beta-1 selectivity is lost at higher doses.
records.exam_trap_zh: 突發停用美托洛爾可能引發嚴重反彈性心絞痛或心肌梗塞；在高劑量下會失去 beta-1 選擇性。
records.board_high_yield_en: Beta-1 selective prototype (Metoprolol succinate for HF, tartrate for acute BP/angina). Abrupt withdrawal causes rebound tachycardia/angina.

records.site_of_action_en: Beta1-adrenergic receptors, chiefly cardiac; at higher plasma concentrations metoprolol also inhibits beta2-adrenoreceptors in bronchial and vascular musculature
records.site_of_action_zh: 乙型第一型腎上腺素受體,主要位於心臟;血漿濃度較高時也會抑制支氣管與血管平滑肌上的乙型第二型受體
records.physiologic_effect_en: Reduction in heart rate and cardiac output at rest and on exercise, reduction of systolic blood pressure on exercise, inhibition of isoproterenol-induced tachycardia, and reduction of reflex orthostatic tachycardia; the sinus rate is slowed and AV nodal conduction decreased
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 靜止與運動時的心率及心輸出量下降、運動時收縮壓下降、抑制 isoproterenol 誘發的心搏過速,並減少反射性姿勢性心搏過速;竇房結節律變慢,房室結傳導減緩
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid 151079c5-6360-45ed-8118-885543d6a4ad)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid 151079c5-6360-45ed-8118-885543d6a4ad), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.mechanism_en: Dihydropyridine calcium channel blocker that inhibits influx of calcium ions into vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle, causing peripheral arterial vasodilation.
records.mechanism_zh: 二氫吡啶類鈣通道阻斷劑，抑制鈣離子流入血管平滑肌與心肌，引起周邊動脈血管擴張。
indications_en: Hypertension
Coronary artery disease (chronic stable angina, vasospastic angina)
indications_zh: 高血壓
冠狀動脈疾病 (慢性穩定型心絞痛、血管痙攣型心絞痛)
contraindications_en: Known sensitivity to amlodipine or any of its components
contraindications_zh: 對氨氯地平或其任何成分過敏
records.mnemonic_en: -DIPINE indicates DHP CCB. Think: peripheral edema, flushing, dizziness, and arterial vasodilation.
records.exam_trap_en: DHP CCBs like amlodipine cause peripheral edema and reflex tachycardia rather than heart block (unlike non-DHP verapamil/diltiazem).
records.exam_trap_zh: DHP CCB 如氨氯地平主要造成周邊水腫與反射性心跳過速，而非房室傳導阻滯（與 non-DHP 如 verapamil/diltiazem 不同）。
records.classic_association_en: DHP CCB (-dipine) -> Peripheral edema & Vasodilation
adverse_effects_en: Edema — the most common adverse reaction, occurring in a dose-related manner
adverse_effects_zh: 水腫 —— 最常見的不良反應,且與劑量相關
records.site_of_action_en: L-type calcium channels of vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle, with a greater effect on vascular smooth muscle
records.site_of_action_zh: 血管平滑肌與心肌的 L 型鈣離子通道,對血管平滑肌的作用較強
records.physiologic_effect_en: Vasodilation producing a reduction of supine and standing blood pressure that is not accompanied by significant change in heart rate or plasma catecholamine levels with chronic dosing; antihypertensive effectiveness is maintained for at least 24 hours with once-daily dosing
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 藉由血管擴張降低臥姿與站姿血壓,長期使用時心率與血漿兒茶酚胺濃度不會明顯改變;每日一次給藥,降壓效果可維持至少 24 小時
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid 5467eee5-1519-7859-e063-6294a90afed1)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
