records.mechanism_en: Selective, competitive inhibitor of HMG-CoA reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme in cholesterol biosynthesis.
records.mechanism_zh: 選擇性、競爭性 HMG-CoA 還原酶抑制劑，阻斷膽固醇生物合成的速控酶。
indications_en: Hyperlipidemia
Prevention of cardiovascular disease in high-risk patients
indications_zh: 高脂血症
高風險患者心血管疾病之預防
contraindications_en: Acute liver failure or decompensated cirrhosis
Hypersensitivity to atorvastatin or any excipients in the product
contraindications_zh: 急性肝臟衰竭或失代償性肝硬化
對阿托伐他汀或產品任何賦形劑過敏
records.mnemonic_en: -VASTATIN indicates Statin. Think: myopathy/rhabdomyolysis, LFT monitoring, and HMG-CoA reductase inhibition.
records.exam_trap_en: Myopathy and rhabdomyolysis risk increases significantly when statins are combined with fibrates, niacin, or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors.
records.exam_trap_zh: 當他汀類與纖維酸類 (fibrates)、菸鹼酸或強效 CYP3A4 抑制劑併用時，肌病變與橫紋肌溶解症風險顯著增加。
records.classic_association_en: Statin (-vastatin) -> Myopathy / Rhabdomyolysis risk & LFT elevation
adverse_effects_en: Nasopharyngitis, arthralgia, diarrhea, pain in extremity, and urinary tract infection — the most common adverse reactions (incidence 5% or greater)
Increases in HbA1c and fasting serum glucose levels
adverse_effects_zh: 鼻咽炎、關節痛、腹瀉、四肢疼痛與泌尿道感染 —— 最常見的不良反應(發生率 5% 以上)
免疫媒介性壞死性肌病變
糖化血色素與空腹血糖上升
records.site_of_action_en: HMG-CoA reductase; the liver is the primary site of action and the principal site of cholesterol synthesis and LDL clearance
records.site_of_action_zh: HMG-CoA 還原酶;肝臟是主要作用部位,也是膽固醇合成與低密度脂蛋白清除的主要場所
records.physiologic_effect_en: Lowering of plasma cholesterol and lipoprotein levels by inhibiting cholesterol synthesis and increasing the number of hepatic LDL receptors, enhancing uptake and catabolism of LDL; LDL production and the number of LDL particles are also reduced
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 抑制膽固醇合成並增加肝臟低密度脂蛋白受體數目,促進低密度脂蛋白的攝取與分解,使血漿膽固醇與脂蛋白濃度下降;同時減少低密度脂蛋白的生成量與顆粒數
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid b687ba81-cb24-bbdf-5dd9-ab0e53dd480b)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid b687ba81-cb24-bbdf-5dd9-ab0e53dd480b), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.mechanism_en: Inhibits membrane Na+/K+-ATPase, leading to increased intracellular calcium concentration, positive inotropy, and increased vagal tone.
records.mechanism_zh: 抑制細胞膜 Na+/K+-ATPase，導致細胞內鈣離子濃度增加，發揮正性肌力作用並提高迷走神經張力。
indications_en: Heart failure
Atrial fibrillation rate control
indications_zh: 心衰竭
心房顫動心室率控制
contraindications_en: Known hypersensitivity to digoxin or other digitalis preparations
contraindications_zh: 心室顫動
對地高辛或其它毛地黃製劑已知過敏
records.mnemonic_en: Digoxin = Narrow therapeutic index + Yellow-green visual halos + Hypokalemia exacerbates toxicity.
records.exam_trap_en: Hypokalemia (e.g. from loop or thiazide diuretics) increases digoxin binding to Na+/K+-ATPase and markedly enhances digoxin toxicity.
records.exam_trap_zh: 低血鉀（如來自袢利尿劑或 thiazide）會增加地高辛與 Na+/K+-ATPase 的結合，顯著增強地高辛毒性。
records.classic_association_en: Digoxin -> Narrow therapeutic index & Visual halos & Hypokalemia toxicity trap
records.site_of_action_en: Na-K ATPase (the sodium pump) in the myocardium and conduction system
records.site_of_action_zh: 心肌與傳導系統上的鈉鉀幫浦 (Na-K ATPase)
records.physiologic_effect_en: Increased availability of intracellular calcium in the myocardium and conduction system, with increased inotropy, increased automaticity and reduced conduction velocity; indirect parasympathetic stimulation affects the SA and AV nodes. Cardiac output rises while pulmonary artery pressure, pulmonary capillary wedge pressure and systemic vascular resistance fall.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 心肌與傳導系統的細胞內鈣離子可用量增加,收縮力上升、自律性提高、傳導速度減慢;另經由間接的副交感興奮影響竇房結與房室結。心輸出量增加,肺動脈壓、肺微血管楔壓與全身血管阻力下降。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid dbc0bc24-f250-47e8-8d10-6aef551823d7)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid dbc0bc24-f250-47e8-8d10-6aef551823d7), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.mechanism_en: Selectively stimulates beta-2 adrenergic receptors in bronchial smooth muscle, activating adenylate cyclase, increasing intracellular cAMP, and producing bronchodilation.
records.mechanism_zh: 選擇性刺激支氣管平滑肌 beta-2 腎上腺素受體，活化腺苷酸環化酶，提高胞內 cAMP 濃度，引致支氣管平滑肌鬆弛。
records.pharmacodynamics_summary_en: Rapid-onset bronchodilation relieving acute bronchospasm within 5-15 minutes.

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: 5-15 minutes (inhalation); Peak effect: 0.5-2 hours; Duration: 2-6 hours.
pharmacokinetics.metabolism_en: Extensively metabolized in the liver to inactive albuterol 4'-O-sulfate.
pharmacokinetics.elimination_en: Renal excretion (80-100% of dose excreted in urine over 72 hours).

indications_en: Treatment or prevention of bronchospasm in patients 4 years of age and older with reversible obstructive airway disease
Prevention of exercise-induced bronchospasm
indications_zh: 治療或預防 4 歲及以上可逆性阻塞性呼吸道疾病患者之支氣管痙攣
預防運動誘發性支氣管痙攣
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 反常性支氣管痙攣
低血鉀
顯著心血管影響
warnings_en: Paradoxical bronchospasm: Discontinue albuterol immediately if paradoxical bronchospasm occurs.
Cardiovascular effects: May produce significant tachycardia, blood pressure changes, and ECG changes.
warnings_zh: 反常性支氣管痙攣：若發生反常性支氣管痙攣應立即停用沙丁胺醇。
心血管影響：可能引起顯著心跳過速、血壓變化及心電圖改變。
contraindications_en: Hypersensitivity to albuterol or any formulation components.
contraindications_zh: 對沙丁胺醇或任何製劑成分過敏。
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Risk Summary: There are no adequate and well-controlled studies of albuterol sulfate in pregnant women. Albuterol should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the fetus.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 風險摘要：目前尚無針對孕婦使用沙丁胺醇的充分對照研究。孕期僅在潛在益處大於對胎兒潛在風險時方可使用。
records.renal_considerations_en: No dosage adjustment necessary; monitor in severe renal impairment.
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor lung function (FEV1/peak flow), heart rate, blood pressure, serum potassium, and frequency of rescue inhaler use.

drug_interactions_graded.interaction_en: Beta blockers block the bronchodilatory effect of albuterol and may produce severe bronchospasm in asthmatics.

records.tcm_relation_note_zh: Albuterol 為急救哮喘吸入劑（SABA）。中醫診治肺氣虛哮喘或痰熱平喘時，須詢問患者救急吸入劑使用頻率；頻繁使用代表氣喘未控制，不可逕行停用西藥吸入劑。
records.mnemonic_en: Albuterol = A (Acute) B (Bronchodilator) U (Urgent) T (Tremor side effect). SABA rescue inhaler.
records.mnemonic_zh: Albuterol = 急性 (Acute) 支氣管擴張劑 (Bronchodilator) 救急 (Urgent) 震顫 (Tremor)。SABA 救急吸入劑。
records.classic_association_en: SABA rescue inhaler -> Rapid bronchodilation & tremor/tachycardia side effects
records.classic_association_zh: SABA 救急吸入劑 -> 快速支氣管擴張與震顫/心急副作用
records.exam_trap_en: Frequent albuterol use indicates worsening asthma control requiring stepped-up controller therapy (ICS); nonselective beta-blockers block albuterol and trigger fatal bronchospasm.
records.exam_trap_zh: 頻繁使用沙丁胺醇代表氣喘控制惡化，須升級控制藥物 (ICS)；非選擇性 beta 阻斷劑會阻斷沙丁胺醇並誘發致命性支氣管痙攣。
records.board_high_yield_en: Prototype SABA. Rapid bronchodilation via beta-2 stimulation. First-line acute asthma rescue. Major adverse effect: Tremor & tachycardia.
records.dailymed_label_title: ALBUTEROL SULFATE AEROSOL, METERED [NUCARE PHARMACEUTICALS, INC.]

indications_en: dailymed:583c6408-45cc-9121-e063-6294a90afcc4#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:583c6408-45cc-9121-e063-6294a90afcc4#WARNINGS

records.site_of_action_en: Beta2-adrenergic receptors, the predominant receptors on bronchial smooth muscle; a population of beta2-receptors also exists in the human heart, at 10% to 50% of cardiac beta-adrenergic receptors, whose precise function has not been established
records.site_of_action_zh: 乙型第二型腎上腺素受體 —— 支氣管平滑肌上的主要受體;人類心臟亦有一群乙型第二型受體,約佔心臟乙型腎上腺素受體的 10% 至 50%,其確切功能尚未確立
records.physiologic_effect_en: Activation of adenylcyclase raises intracellular cyclic AMP, activating protein kinase A, which inhibits phosphorylation of myosin and lowers intracellular ionic calcium, resulting in relaxation of the smooth muscle of all airways from the trachea to the terminal bronchioles; albuterol acts as a functional antagonist, relaxing the airway irrespective of the spasmogen involved
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 活化腺苷酸環化酶使細胞內環腺苷單磷酸上升,進而活化蛋白激酶 A,抑制肌凝蛋白磷酸化並降低細胞內鈣離子濃度,使氣管到終末細支氣管的所有氣道平滑肌鬆弛;albuterol 屬功能性拮抗劑,不論引發痙攣的物質為何皆能使氣道鬆弛
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid 583c6408-45cc-9121-e063-6294a90afcc4)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid 583c6408-45cc-9121-e063-6294a90afcc4), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.mechanism_en: Competitive antagonist of acetylcholine at central and peripheral muscarinic receptors (M1-M5), blocking parasympathetic neuro-effector sites.
records.mechanism_zh: 中樞與周邊毒蕈鹼型受體 (M1-M5) 之競爭性乙醯膽鹼拮抗劑，阻斷副交感神經效應器部位。
records.pharmacodynamics_summary_en: Increases heart rate, decreases salivary/bronchial secretions, relaxes GI smooth muscle, causes mydriasis & cycloplegia.

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: Immediate (IV), 30 minutes (IM); Duration: 4 hours (parenteral), 7-14 days (topical ophthalmic cycloplegia).
pharmacokinetics.metabolism_en: Partially metabolized by hepatic hydrolysis to tropic acid and tropine.
pharmacokinetics.elimination_en: Renal excretion (30-50% excreted unchanged in urine).

indications_en: Temporary blockade of severe bradycardia and bradyarrhythmias
Antidote for organophosphorus nerve agent or insecticide poisoning and muscarinic mushroom poisoning
Preoperative medication to reduce salivary and respiratory secretions
indications_zh: 嚴重心跳過緩與緩慢型心律不整之暫時性阻斷
有機磷神經毒劑/農藥中毒及毒蕈鹼型毒菇中毒之解毒劑
術前用藥以減少唾液及呼吸道分泌物
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 抗膽鹼精神病 / 譫妄
高熱
誘發閉角型青光眼急性發作
warnings_en: Risk of precipitating acute angle-closure glaucoma in patients with narrow anterior chamber angles.
Caution in urinary retention, prostatic hypertrophy, and severe ulcerative colitis due to antimuscarinic blockade.
Anticholinergic psychosis and severe hyperthermia risk in high ambient temperatures.
warnings_zh: 房角狹窄患者具誘發急性閉角型青光眼之風險。
因抗毒蕈鹼阻斷作用，攝護腺肥大、尿滯留及嚴重潰瘍性結腸炎患者慎用。
高溫環境下具抗膽鹼精神病與嚴重高熱風險。
contraindications_en: Hypersensitivity to atropine sulfate or any component of the formulation.
contraindications_zh: 對硫酸阿托品或其任何配方成分過敏。
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy Category C. Crosses placenta; may cause fetal tachycardia.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 懷孕級別 C。通過胎盤；可能引起胎兒心跳過速。
records.renal_considerations_en: Use caution in renal impairment due to reduced clearance.
records.hepatic_considerations_en: No specific dosage adjustment guidelines reported.
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, pupil size, body temperature, urinary output, and bowel sounds.

drug_interactions_graded.interaction_en: Additive anticholinergic effects leading to severe urinary retention, severe constipation, or confusion.

records.tcm_relation_note_zh: Atropine 具強烈「燥濕昂陽」之抗膽鹼作用（口乾、無汗、瞳孔散大、心跳加快）。針灸治療胃腸痙攣或心跳過緩時，若患者已接受阿托品，切勿將藥物所致之口乾舌紅目赤誤診為陰虛火旺或實熱證。
records.mnemonic_en: Atropine toxidrome: Blind as a bat (mydriasis), Mad as a hatter (delirium), Red as a beet (flushing), Hot as a hare (hyperthermia), Dry as a bone (anhidrosis/dry mouth).
records.mnemonic_zh: 阿托品中毒口訣：盲如蝙蝠（散瞳）、瘋如帽匠（譫妄）、紅如甜菜（潮紅）、熱如野兔（高熱）、乾如枯骨（無汗口乾）。
records.classic_association_en: Atropine -> Antimuscarinic prototype & Organophosphate poisoning antidote
records.classic_association_zh: 阿托品 -> 抗毒蕈鹼代表藥與有機磷農藥中毒解毒劑
records.exam_trap_en: Atropine treats cholinergic DUMBBELSS toxidrome from organophosphate poisoning, but is ABSOLUTELY CONTRAINDICATED in closed-angle glaucoma.
records.exam_trap_zh: 阿托品用於救治有機磷中毒之副交感 DUMBBELSS 症候群，但對閉角型青光眼患者為絕對禁忌。
records.board_high_yield_en: Prototype antimuscarinic agent. Antidote for organophosphate poisoning & muscarinic mushrooms. Causes pupillary dilation, dry mouth, tachycardia, urinary retention. CI in closed-angle glaucoma.
records.dailymed_label_title: ATROPINE (ATROPINE SULFATE) SOLUTION/ DROPS [GLAND PHARMA LIMITED]

indications_en: dailymed:a116af5c-ba4c-408c-9a02-4bc33772aa8d#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:a116af5c-ba4c-408c-9a02-4bc33772aa8d#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.site_of_action_en: Muscarinic acetylcholine receptors; atropine does not distinguish among the M1, M2 and M3 subgroups, and its potency at nicotinic receptors is much lower
records.site_of_action_zh: 蕈毒鹼型乙醯膽鹼受體;atropine 不區分 M1、M2、M3 三種亞型,對菸鹼型受體的效價則低得多
records.physiologic_effect_en: Reversible antagonism of the muscarine-like actions of acetylcholine; blockade of the pupillary constrictor muscle leaves sympathetic dilator activity unopposed, producing mydriasis, and weakening of the ciliary muscle produces cycloplegia with loss of accommodation for near vision
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 可逆地拮抗乙醯膽鹼的蕈毒鹼樣作用;阻斷瞳孔括約肌後,交感神經的散瞳作用不再受制衡而使瞳孔放大,睫狀肌收縮力減弱則造成睫狀肌麻痺,喪失近距離調節能力
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid a116af5c-ba4c-408c-9a02-4bc33772aa8d)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid a116af5c-ba4c-408c-9a02-4bc33772aa8d), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.subclass_en: Quinazoline Alpha-1 Selective Adrenergic Receptor Blocker
records.mechanism_en: Selectively inhibits post-synaptic alpha-1 adrenergic receptors, causing peripheral vasodilation of vascular smooth muscle and decreasing peripheral vascular resistance.
records.mechanism_zh: 選擇性抑制突觸後 alpha-1 腎上腺素受體，引起外周血管平滑肌舒張並降低外周血管阻力。
records.pharmacodynamics_summary_en: Reduces standing and supine blood pressure without causing significant reflex tachycardia during long-term therapy.

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: 2 hours; Peak effect: 1-3 hours; Duration: 10-24 hours.
pharmacokinetics.metabolism_en: Extensively metabolized in the liver via demethylation and conjugation.

indications_en: Treatment of hypertension alone or in combination with other antihypertensive agents
Off-label: PTSD-associated trauma nightmares and sleep disruption
indications_zh: 單獨或聯合其他降壓藥治療高血壓
仿單外用途：PTSD 創傷後壓力症相關創傷夢魘與睡眠障礙
common_offlabel_uses_en: PTSD-associated nightmares and hyperarousal sleep disruption
common_offlabel_uses_zh: PTSD 創傷性夢魘與過度警覺睡眠障礙
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 嚴重姿勢性低血壓與暈厥
陰莖異常勃起 (Priapism)
warnings_en: First-dose effect: Severe orthostatic hypotension with syncope may occur within 30-90 minutes of initial dose. Advise taking at bedtime.
Intraoperative Floppy Iris Syndrome (IFIS) during cataract surgery.
warnings_zh: 首劑效應：初始服藥 30-90 分鐘內易發生嚴重姿勢性低血壓與暈厥。建議睡前服藥。
白內障手術中可能引致術中虹膜鬆弛症候群 (IFIS)。
contraindications_en: Hypersensitivity to prazosin or other quinazolines.
contraindications_zh: 對哌唑嗪或其他喹唑啉類成分過敏。
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy Category C. Excreted in human milk in small amounts.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 懷孕級別 C。少量分泌至母乳中。
records.renal_considerations_en: Initiate at lowest dose in renal impairment due to increased sensitivity.
records.hepatic_considerations_en: Reduce dose in hepatic impairment due to decreased drug clearance.
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor blood pressure (sitting and standing) especially after initial dose and dosage increases.

drug_interactions_graded.interaction_en: Additive blood pressure lowering effect resulting in symptomatic hypotension.

records.tcm_relation_note_zh: Prazosin 具強烈降壓與首劑暈厥效應。針灸治療高血壓、失眠或 PTSD 時，患者起立移步須特別注意姿勢性低血壓（中醫頭暈目眩、清陽不升），防範起立暈倒跌傷。
records.mnemonic_en: Prazosin = P (PTSD nightmares) R (Relax vascular smooth muscle) A (Alpha-1 selective) Z (Zzz... take at bedtime for first-dose syncope).
records.mnemonic_zh: Prazosin = P (PTSD 噩夢) R (舒張血管) A (Alpha-1 選擇性) Z (睡前服藥防首劑暈厥)。
records.classic_association_en: Prazosin -> Alpha-1 blocker prototype & first-dose syncope / PTSD nightmares
records.classic_association_zh: 哌唑嗪 -> Alpha-1 阻斷劑代表藥、首劑暈厥與 PTSD 噩夢
records.exam_trap_en: Prazosin causes first-dose syncope/orthostatic hypotension (mitigated by bedtime dosing); also uniquely used off-label for PTSD nightmares.
records.exam_trap_zh: Prazosin 會引起首劑暈厥與姿勢性低血壓（睡前給藥可減輕）；臨床上亦獨特仿單外用於 PTSD 噩夢。
records.board_high_yield_en: Prototype alpha-1 blocker (-osin). Causes vasodilation & first-dose syncope (take at bedtime). Off-label first-choice for PTSD nightmares.

indications_en: dailymed:2f86fc8e-71c1-4749-b67e-86d86cf1d984#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:2f86fc8e-71c1-4749-b67e-86d86cf1d984#WARNINGS

records.site_of_action_en: Postsynaptic alpha-adrenoceptors; the peripheral vasodilator effect is confined mainly to the resistance vessels (arterioles)
records.site_of_action_zh: 突觸後甲型腎上腺素受體;其周邊血管擴張作用主要侷限於阻力血管(小動脈)
records.physiologic_effect_en: A decrease in total peripheral resistance and a fall in blood pressure without clinically significant change in cardiac output, heart rate, renal blood flow or glomerular filtration rate. Unlike conventional alpha-blockers, the antihypertensive action is usually not accompanied by reflex tachycardia. The exact mechanism of the hypotensive action is stated by the label to be unknown.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 降低全周邊阻力使血壓下降,而心輸出量、心率、腎血流與腎絲球過濾率沒有臨床上顯著的變化。與傳統甲型阻斷劑不同,其降壓作用通常不伴隨反射性心搏過速。標籤明載其降壓作用的確切機轉仍屬未知。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid 2f86fc8e-71c1-4749-b67e-86d86cf1d984)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid 2f86fc8e-71c1-4749-b67e-86d86cf1d984), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.subclass_en: Non-Selective Beta-1 and Beta-2 Adrenergic Blocker
records.mechanism_en: Non-selectively antagonizes beta-1 (cardiac) and beta-2 (bronchial and vascular) adrenergic receptors, competing with sympathomimetic neurotransmitters.
records.mechanism_zh: 非選擇性拮抗 beta-1 (心臟) 與 beta-2 (支氣管及血管) 腎上腺素受體，競爭性阻斷交感神經傳導。
records.pharmacodynamics_summary_en: Reduces heart rate, cardiac output, blood pressure, and myocardial oxygen demand; inhibits glycogenolysis; causes bronchoconstriction.

pharmacokinetics.metabolism_en: Extensive hepatic first-pass metabolism via CYP2D6 and CYP1A2.
pharmacokinetics.elimination_en: Renal clearance of metabolites (<1% excreted unchanged).

indications_en: Hypertension and Angina Pectoris due to coronary atherosclerosis
Migraine headache prophylaxis
Essential tremor management
Thyroid storm / Thyrotoxicosis symptom management
Hypertrophic subaortic stenosis and Pheochromocytoma adjunctive therapy
indications_zh: 高血壓與冠狀動脈硬化引致之心絞痛
偏頭痛發作之預防
原發性顫抖症之控制
甲狀腺風暴 / 甲狀腺毒症症狀控制
肥厚性亞主動脈狹窄與嗜鉻細胞腫之輔助治療
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 嚴重支氣管痙攣
心臟傳導阻滯 / 心衰竭惡化
突發停藥反彈性缺血 / 心肌梗塞
warnings_en: Abrupt Discontinuation: Taper dosage gradually over 1-2 weeks to avoid rebound angina or MI.
Bronchospastic disease: Contraindicated in asthma and COPD due to blockade of beta-2 mediated bronchodilation.
Masking hypoglycemia: May mask hypoglycemia-induced tachycardia in diabetic patients.
warnings_zh: 突發停藥：應於 1-2 週內逐漸減量，以避免反彈性心絞痛或心肌梗塞。
支氣管痙攣性疾病：氣喘及 COPD 患者禁忌（阻斷 beta-2 介導之支氣管擴張）。
掩蓋低血糖：可能掩蓋糖尿病患者低血糖所致之心跳過速。
contraindications_en: Asthma, COPD, or history of severe bronchospasm
Sinus bradycardia, 2nd or 3rd degree AV block, cardiogenic shock
contraindications_zh: 氣喘、COPD 或嚴重支氣管痙攣病史
竇性心跳過緩、二度或三度房室傳導阻滯、心源性休克
失代償性心衰竭
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy Category C. May cause intrauterine growth restriction, neonatal bradycardia, and hypoglycemia.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 懷孕級別 C。可能造成胎兒宮內生長遲緩、新生兒心跳過緩與低血糖。
records.renal_considerations_en: Use caution in renal impairment; clearance may be reduced.
records.hepatic_considerations_en: Bioavailability increased in hepatic impairment due to reduced first-pass metabolism; reduce dose.
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, ECG, blood glucose in diabetics, and respiratory status.

drug_interactions_graded.interaction_en: Propranolol antagonizes the bronchodilatory effects of beta-2 agonists, precipitating severe bronchospasm.

records.tcm_relation_note_zh: Propranolol 為非選擇性 beta 阻斷劑。氣喘患者絕對禁用（Beta-2 阻斷引發致命喘息）。針灸治療偏頭痛或原發性顫抖時，須注意其鎮靜、心跳過緩與四肢冰冷（中醫陽氣不達四末、手足厥冷）副作用。
records.mnemonic_en: Propranolol = P (Prevent Migraine) R (Restricts Bronchi - DO NOT give in Asthma) O (Original Non-selective Beta Blocker) P (Prostatitis/Essential Tremor).
records.mnemonic_zh: Propranolol = 預防偏頭痛 (Prevent Migraine) 緊縮支氣管 (氣喘禁用) 原創非選擇性 (Original Non-selective) 原發性顫抖 (Essential Tremor)。
records.classic_association_en: Propranolol -> Nonselective beta blocker prototype & asthma contraindication / migraine prophylaxis
records.classic_association_zh: 普萘洛爾 -> 非選擇性 beta 阻斷劑代表藥、氣喘禁忌與偏頭痛預防
records.exam_trap_en: Propranolol is NONSELECTIVE (blocks beta-1 & beta-2), so it is ABSOLUTELY CONTRAINDICATED in asthma; it also uniquely prevents migraines & treats essential tremor.
records.exam_trap_zh: 普萘洛爾為非選擇性（阻斷 beta-1 與 beta-2），故氣喘患者絕對禁忌；臨床亦用於預防偏頭痛與治療原發性顫抖。
records.board_high_yield_en: Prototype nonselective beta blocker (-lol). Contraindicated in asthma & COPD due to beta-2 bronchospasm. High yield for migraine prophylaxis & essential tremor.

indications_en: dailymed:1cd914b6-b250-4b11-8404-41db3589361e#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:1cd914b6-b250-4b11-8404-41db3589361e#WARNINGS

records.site_of_action_en: Beta-adrenergic receptors (nonselective); at dosages greater than required for beta blockade propranolol also exerts a quinidine-like membrane action on the cardiac action potential
records.site_of_action_zh: 乙型腎上腺素受體(非選擇性);劑量超過阻斷乙型受體所需時,還會對心臟動作電位產生類似 quinidine 的膜作用
records.physiologic_effect_en: Competition with beta-adrenergic agonists for receptor sites decreases the chronotropic, inotropic and vasodilator responses to beta-adrenergic stimulation proportionately. The label states the mechanism of the antihypertensive effect has not been established; contributing factors may include decreased cardiac output, inhibition of renin release by the kidneys, and diminished tonic sympathetic outflow from vasomotor centers in the brain.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 與乙型腎上腺素促效劑競爭受體結合位,使心律、心肌收縮力與血管擴張對乙型刺激的反應等比例下降。標籤載明其降壓機轉尚未確立;可能的促成因素包括心輸出量下降、抑制腎臟腎素釋放,以及腦部血管運動中樞的張力性交感輸出減弱。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid 1cd914b6-b250-4b11-8404-41db3589361e)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid 1cd914b6-b250-4b11-8404-41db3589361e), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.mechanism_en: Stimulates presynaptic alpha-2 adrenergic receptors in the vasomotor center of the brainstem, reducing central sympathetic outflow and decreasing peripheral vascular resistance.
records.mechanism_zh: 刺激腦幹血管運動中心突觸前 alpha-2 腎上腺素受體，降低中樞交感神經衝動輸出並降低外周血管阻力。
records.pharmacodynamics_summary_en: Decreases blood pressure, heart rate, and plasma renin activity; produces CNS sedation.

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: 30-60 minutes (oral); Peak effect: 3-5 hours; Duration: 6-12 hours (tablets), 7 days (transdermal patch).
pharmacokinetics.elimination_en: Renal excretion (40-60% excreted unchanged in urine).

indications_en: Treatment of hypertension alone or in combination with other antihypertensives
Treatment of ADHD in pediatric patients (Kapvay extended-release formulation)
Off-label: Opioid withdrawal management, Tourette syndrome
indications_zh: 單獨或聯合其他降壓藥治療高血壓
兒科患者注意力不足過動症 (ADHD) 治療 (Kapvay 緩釋劑型)
仿單外用途：鴉片類戒斷輔助、妥瑞氏症候群
common_offlabel_uses_zh: 鴉片類戒斷症候群控制
妥瑞氏症抽動症狀減輕
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 反彈性高血壓危機
嚴重心跳過緩 / 房室傳導阻滯
中樞神經抑制
warnings_en: Rebound Hypertension: Abrupt discontinuation can cause severe rebound hypertension, tachycardia, and catecholamine surge. Taper dosage gradually over 2-4 days.
Sedation & CNS depression: Caution when operating machinery or co-administered with alcohol.
warnings_zh: 反彈性高血壓：突然停藥引致嚴重反彈性高血壓、心率過速及兒茶酚胺劇增。應於 2-4 天內逐漸減量。
鎮靜與中樞抑制：操作機械或與酒精併用時須特別注意。
contraindications_en: Hypersensitivity to clonidine or patch components.
contraindications_zh: 對可樂定或貼片成分過敏。
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy Category C. Excreted in human milk; use caution in nursing mothers.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 懷孕級別 C。分泌至母乳中；哺乳期婦女慎用。
records.renal_considerations_en: Reduce dose and adjust frequency in renal impairment.
records.hepatic_considerations_en: No specific dosage adjustment provided; monitor clinical response.
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, level of sedation, and signs of rebound hypertension.

drug_interactions_graded.interaction_en: Co-administration may exacerbate rebound hypertension if clonidine is abruptly withdrawn while beta blocker is continued.

records.tcm_relation_note_zh: Clonidine 具強烈中樞交感抑制作用（口乾、鎮靜、心跳過緩）。患者若欲停用 clonidine，必須告知其不可突發停藥，否則會引發中樞交感暴衝之「反彈性高血壓危機」（中醫肝陽暴亢、風陽上擾），具腦卒中風險。
records.mnemonic_en: Clonidine = C (Central Alpha-2 agonist) L (Lowers BP & HR) O (Opioid withdrawal helper) N (No abrupt stopping -> Rebound hypertension).
records.mnemonic_zh: Clonidine = 中樞 Alpha-2 致劑 (Central Alpha-2) 降低血壓心率 (Lowers BP) 鴉片戒斷輔助 (Opioid helper) 切勿突停 (No abrupt stopping -> 反彈高血壓)。
records.classic_association_en: Clonidine -> Central alpha-2 agonist & rebound hypertensive crisis warning / ADHD formulation
records.classic_association_zh: 可樂定 -> 中樞 alpha-2 致劑、反彈高血壓危機警語與 ADHD 劑型
records.exam_trap_en: Abruptly stopping clonidine causes a severe REBOUND HYPERTENSIVE CRISIS; Kapvay is the ER formulation approved for ADHD.
records.exam_trap_zh: 突然停用可樂定會引發嚴重反彈性高血壓危機；Kapvay 為其核准用於 ADHD 的緩釋劑型。
records.board_high_yield_en: Prototype central alpha-2 agonist sympatholytic. Decreases sympathetic outflow. Used for hypertension, ADHD (Kapvay), opioid withdrawal. WARNING: Abrupt stop -> Rebound hypertensive crisis.

indications_en: dailymed:8171776a-dd14-4dcc-8860-3c27d8ea9504#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:8171776a-dd14-4dcc-8860-3c27d8ea9504#WARNINGS

records.site_of_action_en: Alpha-adrenoreceptors in the brain stem
records.site_of_action_zh: 腦幹的甲型腎上腺素受體
records.physiologic_effect_en: Reduced sympathetic outflow from the central nervous system, with decreases in peripheral resistance, renal vascular resistance, heart rate and blood pressure; blood pressure declines within 30 to 60 minutes of an oral dose with maximum decrease at 2 to 4 hours. Renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate remain essentially unchanged, and normal postural reflexes stay intact, so orthostatic symptoms are mild and infrequent.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 減少中樞神經系統的交感輸出,使周邊阻力、腎血管阻力、心率與血壓下降;口服後 30 至 60 分鐘血壓開始下降,2 至 4 小時降幅最大。腎血流與腎絲球過濾率大致不變,姿勢反射保持完整,因此姿勢性症狀輕微且少見。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid 8171776a-dd14-4dcc-8860-3c27d8ea9504)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid 8171776a-dd14-4dcc-8860-3c27d8ea9504), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.mechanism_en: Irreversibly inhibits hepatic aldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH), blocking oxidation of alcohol-derived acetaldehyde to acetic acid and causing toxic accumulation of acetaldehyde.
records.mechanism_zh: 不可逆性抑制肝臟乙醛脫氫酶 (ALDH)，阻斷酒精代謝中間物乙醛氧化為乙酸，引致乙醛毒性蓄積。
records.pharmacodynamics_summary_en: Ingestion of even small amounts of alcohol produces a severe disulfiram-alcohol reaction within 5-10 minutes.

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: 12 hours (full enzymatic inhibition); Duration: 1-2 weeks after last dose due to slow synthesis of new ALDH.
pharmacokinetics.metabolism_en: Metabolized in the liver to diethyldithiocarbamate and carbon disulfide.
pharmacokinetics.elimination_en: Excreted via lungs (carbon disulfide) and urine.

indications_en: Aid in the management of selected chronic alcoholic patients who want to remain in a state of enforced sobriety
indications_zh: 輔助管理自願保持強制戒酒狀態之選擇性慢性酒精依賴患者
serious_adverse_effects_en: Severe disulfiram-alcohol reaction (cardiovascular collapse, arrhythmias, shock)
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 嚴重雙硫崙-酒精反應 (心血管崩潰、心律不整、休克)
肝臟毒性 / 暴發性肝衰竭
視神經炎 / 周邊神經病變
records.boxed_warning_en: Never administer disulfiram to a patient when they are intoxicated or without their full knowledge and consent. The physician must instruct relatives accordingly.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 絕不可在患者處於醉酒狀態或未具完全知情同意下給予雙硫崙。醫師須對家屬進行相應衛教指示。
warnings_en: Disulfiram-Alcohol Reaction: Occurs with ingestion of any ethanol (including mouthwash, sauces, cough syrups, or rubbing alcohol). Reactions can be fatal.
Hepatotoxicity: Hepatic failure resulting in transplantation or death has been reported. Perform baseline and periodic LFTs.
warnings_zh: 雙硫崙-酒精反應：攝取任何乙醇（含漱口水、醬汁、止咳糖漿或擦拭酒精）均可觸發，嚴重可致死。
肝毒性：已有肝衰竭導致肝移植或死亡案例報告。須檢測基線及定期肝功能。
contraindications_en: Severe myocardial disease or coronary occlusion
Hypersensitivity to disulfiram or rubber derivatives
Concurrent or recent ingestion of alcohol, paraldehyde, or metronidazole
contraindications_zh: 嚴重心肌疾病或冠狀動脈阻塞
精神病病史
對雙硫崙或橡膠衍生物過敏
併用或近期攝取酒精、三聚乙醛或 Metronidazole
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy Category C. Safety in pregnancy has not been established.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 懷孕級別 C。孕期安全性尚未確立。
records.renal_considerations_en: Use caution in renal failure; no specific dosage adjustment provided.
records.hepatic_considerations_en: Contraindicated in severe hepatic impairment or baseline active hepatitis. Monitor LFTs.
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor baseline LFTs, CBC, serum chemistry, and signs of disulfiram-alcohol reaction.

drug_interactions_graded.interaction_en: Combined use produces acute psychosis and confusion due to combined ALDH and central toxicity.

records.tcm_relation_note_zh: Disulfiram 阻斷乙醛脫氫酶。酒精擦拭塗抹、含酒藥膳（如黃酒泡服或藥酒外敷）在服藥患者均可誘發致命「雙硫崙反應」（面赤、頭痛、喘促、心悸，中醫氣血逆亂、火毒上攻）。治療期間絕對禁用含酒精中藥外用或內服。
records.mnemonic_en: Disulfiram = D (Deterrent for alcohol) I (Inhibits ALDH) S (Severe flushing reaction) U (Unsafe with metronidazole).
records.mnemonic_zh: Disulfiram = 戒酒工具 (Deterrent) 抑制 ALDH (Inhibits ALDH) 嚴重潮紅反應 (Severe flushing) 併用 metronidazole 不安全 (Unsafe)。
records.classic_association_en: Disulfiram -> ALDH inhibitor & disulfiram-alcohol reaction (flushing/nausea)
records.classic_association_zh: 雙硫崙 -> ALDH 抑制劑與雙硫崙-酒精反應 (潮紅/噁心)
records.exam_trap_en: Disulfiram blocks ALDH leading to acetaldehyde accumulation; metronidazole also causes a disulfiram-like reaction when taken with alcohol.
records.exam_trap_zh: Disulfiram 阻斷 ALDH 導致乙醛蓄積；Metronidazole 併用酒精時亦會引發雙硫崙樣反應。
records.board_high_yield_en: Prototype alcohol deterrent. Irreversibly blocks ALDH -> toxic acetaldehyde accumulation upon ethanol consumption. Boxed warning against secret administration. Contraindicated with metronidazole.
records.dailymed_label_title: DISULFIRAM TABLET [GOLDEN STATE MEDICAL SUPPLY, INC.]

indications_en: dailymed:d3832a1a-a140-49c1-a7df-134fa81341e3#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:d3832a1a-a140-49c1-a7df-134fa81341e3#WARNINGS

records.site_of_action_en: The oxidation of alcohol at the acetaldehyde stage — the label describes the step blocked, and does not name the enzyme
records.site_of_action_zh: 酒精氧化過程中的乙醛階段 —— 標籤只描述被阻斷的步驟,並未指名該酵素
records.physiologic_effect_en: Blood acetaldehyde during alcohol metabolism may reach 5 to 10 times the concentration seen with the same amount of alcohol alone, producing the disulfiram-alcohol reaction. The reaction is proportional to the dose of both disulfiram and alcohol and persists as long as alcohol is being metabolized; disulfiram does not appear to change the rate of alcohol elimination, and sensitivity increases the longer the patient remains on therapy.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 服藥後代謝酒精時,血中乙醛濃度可達單獨飲用同量酒精時的 5 至 10 倍,因而引發雙硫侖—酒精反應。此反應與雙硫侖及酒精的劑量成正比,並持續到酒精代謝完畢為止;雙硫侖似乎不改變酒精的排除速率,且服藥愈久,對酒精愈敏感。

records.mechanism_en: Promotes sodium efflux or decreases sodium influx by stabilizing the inactivated state of voltage-gated neuronal sodium channels, suppressing high-frequency repetitive firing.
records.mechanism_zh: 藉由穩定電壓門控神經元鈉離子通道之失活狀態促進鈉外流或減少鈉內流，抑制高頻重複性放電。
records.pharmacodynamics_summary_en: Exhibits non-linear Michaelis-Menten saturation kinetics at therapeutic concentrations (small dose increase can lead to toxicity).

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: 0.5-1 hour (IV); Peak: 1.5-3 hours (oral prompt), 4-12 hours (extended); Duration: 24 hours.
pharmacokinetics.metabolism_en: Extensively metabolized by hepatic CYP2C9 and CYP2C19 (saturable zero-order kinetics).
pharmacokinetics.elimination_en: Renal clearance of metabolites (<5% excreted unchanged).

indications_en: Treatment of generalized tonic-clonic (grand mal) and focal (partial) seizures
Prevention and treatment of seizures during or following neurosurgery
Intravenous: Control of status epilepticus
indications_zh: 全體強直陣攣性發作 (大發作) 及局灶性 (部分性) 發作之治療
神經外科手術中或術後癲癇發作之預防與治療
靜脈注射：癲癇重積狀態之控制
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 史蒂芬斯-強森症候群 (SJS) / TEN
靜脈注射紫手症候群
再生不良性貧血 / 白血球減少
肝毒性
warnings_en: Serious Dermatologic Reactions: SJS/TEN risk. Discontinue at first sign of rash.
CYP Enzyme Induction: Potent inducer of CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and P-glycoprotein, reducing efficacy of oral contraceptives, warfarin, and corticosteroids.
warnings_zh: 嚴重皮膚反應：SJS/TEN 風險。出現皮疹徵兆應立即停藥。
CYP 酵素誘導：強效 CYP3A4、CYP2C9 及 P-gp 誘導劑，降低口服避孕藥、華法林與類固醇療效。
contraindications_en: Sinus bradycardia, sinoatrial block, 2nd or 3rd degree AV block
Hypersensitivity to phenytoin or other hydantoins
contraindications_zh: 竇性心跳過緩、竇房阻滯、二度或三度房室傳導阻滯
斯托克氏-亞當斯症候群 (Stokes-Adams)
對苯妥英或其他乙內醯脲類過敏
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy Category D. Fetal hydantoin syndrome (craniofacial abnormalities, hypoplastic nails, microcephaly).
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 懷孕級別 D。胎兒苯妥英症候群（顱顏畸形、指甲發育不全、小頭畸形）。
records.renal_considerations_en: Unbound free fraction of phenytoin is increased in uremia; monitor free phenytoin levels.
records.hepatic_considerations_en: Saturable hepatic clearance reduced in liver disease; monitor free therapeutic levels.
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor serum phenytoin total levels (10-20 mcg/mL) & free levels (1-2 mcg/mL), LFTs, CBC, ECG during IV, and oral hygiene/gums.

drug_interactions_graded.interaction_en: Phenytoin induces CYP metabolism of warfarin (decreasing INR) but may initially displace warfarin from plasma proteins (increasing bleeding).

records.tcm_relation_note_zh: Phenytoin 為強效抗癲癇藥。具經典副作用「齒齦增生」（Gingival hyperplasia）與眼震。中醫口腔診察或針灸治療痛證時，切勿將苯妥英所致之齒齦腫脹發炎誤診為胃火上炎或牙疳，並須保持良好口腔衛生。
records.mnemonic_en: Phenytoin toxicity = PHENYTOIN: P-450 inducer, Hirsutism, Enlarged gums (Gingival hyperplasia), Nystagmus, Yellow-brown skin, Teratogenic, Osteomalacia, Interference with folate (anemia), Neuropathy.
records.mnemonic_zh: Phenytoin 毒性口訣 PHENYTOIN：P-450 誘導劑、多毛症、齒齦增生、眼球震顫、皮膚色素沉著、致畸胎性、骨質軟化、干擾葉酸（貧血）、神經病變。
records.classic_association_en: Phenytoin -> Hydantoin sodium channel blocker & zero-order kinetics / gingival hyperplasia
records.classic_association_zh: 苯妥英 -> 乙內醯脲類鈉通道阻斷劑、零級動力學與齒齦增生
records.exam_trap_en: Phenytoin exhibits zero-order saturation kinetics (small dose change -> large level jump); classic toxicity triad = Gingival hyperplasia + Nystagmus + Ataxia. INEFFECTIVE for absence seizures.
records.exam_trap_zh: 苯妥英具零級飽和動力學（小劑量增加引致血藥濃度暴升）；經典毒性三聯徵 = 齒齦增生 + 眼球震顫 + 共濟失調。對失神發作無效。
records.board_high_yield_en: Prototype hydantoin anticonvulsant. Blocks Na channels. Zero-order saturation kinetics. Classic adverse effects: Gingival hyperplasia, nystagmus, ataxia, hirsutism, folate deficiency. Black box warning for IV rate.
records.dailymed_label_title: PHENYTOIN SODIUM CAPSULE, EXTENDED RELEASE [A-S MEDICATION SOLUTIONS]

indications_en: dailymed:ef4e97a7-cd18-47a9-a016-2eca5481a87e#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:ef4e97a7-cd18-47a9-a016-2eca5481a87e#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.site_of_action_en: Membrane sodium channels — the label states the precise mechanism has not been established, but is thought to involve voltage-dependent blockade of these channels
records.site_of_action_zh: 細胞膜鈉離子通道 —— 標籤載明確切機轉尚未確立,但一般認為涉及對此通道的電壓依賴性阻斷
records.physiologic_effect_en: A reduction in sustained high-frequency neuronal discharges
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 減少神經元持續性的高頻放電
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid ef4e97a7-cd18-47a9-a016-2eca5481a87e)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid ef4e97a7-cd18-47a9-a016-2eca5481a87e), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.mechanism_en: Blocks voltage-gated sodium channels in presynaptic neuronal membranes, depressing synaptic transmission and inhibiting repetitive high-frequency discharge.
records.mechanism_zh: 阻斷突觸前神經元膜電壓門控鈉離子通道，抑制突觸傳遞並阻斷高頻重複放電。
records.pharmacodynamics_summary_en: Potent anticonvulsant and specific antineuralgic action for trigeminal neuralgia; induces its own hepatic metabolism (auto-induction).

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: Slow and variable (several days for steady state); Peak: 4-12 hours; Duration: 24 hours.
pharmacokinetics.metabolism_en: Extensively metabolized by CYP3A4 to active carbamazepine-10,11-epoxide; exhibits auto-induction.

indications_en: Treatment of partial seizures with complex symptomatology, generalized tonic-clonic seizures, and mixed seizure patterns
Treatment of pain associated with true trigeminal neuralgia and glossopharyngeal neuralgia
Treatment of acute manic and mixed episodes associated with Bipolar I disorder
indications_zh: 治療具複雜症狀之部分性發作、全體強直陣攣性發作及混合型癲癇發作
治療真正三叉神經痛與舌咽神經痛引致之劇烈疼痛
治療雙相 I 型障礙之急性躁狂與混合發作
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 再生不良性貧血與顆粒性白血球缺乏症
毒性表皮壞死鬆解症 (TEN) / SJS
SIADH 抗利尿激素分泌異常引致嚴重低血鈉
肝毒性
records.boxed_warning_en: 1. Aplastic Anemia & Agranulocytosis: Risk 5-8 times higher than general population. Obtain baseline CBC. 2. Serious Dermatologic Reactions: SJS/TEN risk significantly heightened in patients carrying HLA-B*1502 allele (common in Asian ancestry). Test for HLA-B*1502 before initiating therapy.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 1. 再生不良性貧血與顆粒性白血球缺乏症：風險高出一般人群 5-8 倍。須檢測基線全血球計數。2. 嚴重皮膚反應：攜帶 HLA-B*1502 基因型（亞洲血統常見）患者 SJS/TEN 風險顯著升高。開始治療前須進行 HLA-B*1502 基因檢測。
warnings_en: HLA-B*1502 Screening: Strongly recommended in Asian ancestry patients prior to drug initiation.
CYP3A4 Auto-Induction: Induces its own metabolism, decreasing serum half-life over first 3-5 weeks of therapy.
warnings_zh: HLA-B*1502 基因篩檢：強烈建議亞洲血統患者於開始用藥前篩檢。
CYP3A4 自體誘導：會自體誘導自身的肝臟代謝，於用藥前 3-5 週內使半衰期逐漸縮短。
contraindications_en: Hypersensitivity to carbamazepine or tricyclic compounds
Co-administration with or within 14 days of MAOIs
contraindications_zh: 骨髓抑制病史
對卡馬西平或三環類化合物過敏
併用或 14 天內曾使用 MAO 抑制劑
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy Category D. Causes major congenital malformations (neural tube defects / spina bifida).
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 懷孕級別 D。造成重大先天性畸形（神經管缺陷 / 脊柱裂）。
records.renal_considerations_en: Monitor renal function and serum sodium; clearance may be altered.
records.hepatic_considerations_en: Contraindicated in active severe hepatic disease; baseline and periodic LFTs required.
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor baseline CBC & platelet count, LFTs, serum sodium, HLA-B*1502 status, and therapeutic levels (4-12 mcg/mL).

drug_interactions_graded.interaction_en: Carbamazepine induces CYP3A4 metabolism of hormonal contraceptives, leading to contraceptive failure.

records.tcm_relation_note_zh: Carbamazepine 為三叉神經痛（中醫面痛、頭風）首選西藥。具經典黑框警告「再生不良性貧血」與 HLA-B*1502 基因型史蒂芬斯-強森症候群（SJS）毒性。中醫診治三叉神經痛患者，須詢問基因篩檢與全血球複查狀況。
records.mnemonic_en: Carbamazepine = C (CYP inducer / Auto-induction) A (Aplastic anemia boxed warning) R (Rash SJS HLA-B*1502) B (Bipolar & Trigeminal neuralgia).
records.mnemonic_zh: Carbamazepine = CYP 誘導劑 (Auto-induction) 再生不良性貧血黑框警告 (Aplastic anemia) 亞洲人皮疹 SJS HLA-B*1502 基因檢測 三叉神經痛與雙相情感障礙 (Bipolar)。
records.classic_association_en: Carbamazepine -> Trigeminal neuralgia 1st line & HLA-B*1502 SJS boxed warning
records.classic_association_zh: 卡馬西平 -> 三叉神經痛首選與 HLA-B*1502 基因型 SJS 黑框警告
records.exam_trap_en: Carbamazepine is 1st line for TRIGEMINAL NEURALGIA; causes auto-induction of its own metabolism; requires HLA-B*1502 testing in Asians due to fatal SJS risk.
records.exam_trap_zh: 卡馬西平為三叉神經痛首選藥；具自體誘導代謝特性；因致命 SJS 風險，亞洲患者用藥前須檢測 HLA-B*1502 基因。
records.board_high_yield_en: Prototype iminostilbene sodium channel blocker. 1st line for trigeminal neuralgia. Boxed warnings for aplastic anemia/agranulocytosis & SJS/TEN (HLA-B*1502 screening in Asians). Potent CYP auto-inducer.

indications_en: dailymed:52cf3ba9-0a7c-4809-830e-af93d1532726#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:52cf3ba9-0a7c-4809-830e-af93d1532726#WARNINGS

records.physiologic_effect_en: In animal models carbamazepine reduces polysynaptic responses and blocks post-tetanic potentiation, depresses thalamic potential and bulbar and polysynaptic reflexes, and greatly reduces or abolishes pain induced by stimulation of the infraorbital nerve. The label states that the mechanism of action remains unknown.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 在動物模式中,carbamazepine 可減少多突觸反應並阻斷強直後增益,抑制視丘電位與延腦、多突觸反射,且能大幅減輕或消除刺激眶下神經所誘發的疼痛。標籤明載其作用機轉仍屬未知。

records.mechanism_en: Selectively depresses low-threshold T-type voltage-gated calcium currents in thalamic relay neurons, reducing 3-Hz spike-and-wave rhythmicity.
records.mechanism_zh: 選擇性抑制丘腦中繼神經元低閾值 T 型電壓門控鈣電流，降低 3-Hz 棘慢波節律性放電。
records.pharmacodynamics_summary_en: Specific efficacy for control of absence (petit mal) seizures without activity against tonic-clonic seizures.

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: Peak plasma concentration in 1-4 hours; Steady state in 4-7 days; Duration: 24-60 hours (long half-life).
pharmacokinetics.metabolism_en: Extensively metabolized by hepatic CYP3A4 to inactive metabolites.
pharmacokinetics.elimination_en: Renal clearance (20% excreted unchanged in urine).

indications_en: Control of absence (petit mal) epilepsy
indications_zh: 失神 (小發作) 癲癇之控制
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 血液疾病 (顆粒性白血球缺乏症、再生不良性貧血)
史蒂芬斯-強森症候群
全身性紅斑性狼瘡復發
warnings_en: Blood dyscrasias: Fatal blood dyscrasias have been reported. Perform periodic blood cell counts.
Abrupt withdrawal: May precipitate absence status epilepticus.
warnings_zh: 血液疾病：已有致命性血液疾病報告。須定期複查血球計數。
突發停藥：突然停藥可能誘發失神癲癇重積狀態。
contraindications_zh: 對琥珀醯亞胺類化合物過敏。
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy Category C. Crosses placenta; use only if clearly needed.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 懷孕級別 C。通過胎盤；僅於明確需要時使用。
records.renal_considerations_en: Use caution in renal impairment; monitor therapeutic blood levels.
records.hepatic_considerations_en: Use caution in hepatic impairment; baseline and periodic LFTs recommended.
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor therapeutic plasma levels (40-100 mcg/mL), CBC, renal & liver function.

drug_interactions_graded.interaction_en: Ethosuximide may alter phenytoin serum concentrations.

records.tcm_relation_note_zh: Ethosuximide 為兒童失神發作（小發作，中醫癇證、瞬目呆視）專一首選藥。特定作用於丘腦 T 型鈣通道。臨床常見消化道不適與嗜睡，須注意監測全血球計數。
records.mnemonic_en: EFG = Ethosuximide For Grand... NO! Ethosuximide For 'G-Petit' (Petit mal / Absence seizures). T-type calcium channel blocker.
records.mnemonic_zh: EFG 口訣 = Ethosuximide 代表藥，專用於 Petit mal (失神小發作)。阻斷 T 型鈣通道。
records.classic_association_en: Ethosuximide -> Absence (petit mal) seizure 1st choice & T-type calcium channel blocker
records.classic_association_zh: 乙琥胺 -> 失神 (小發作) 癲癇首選與 T 型鈣通道阻斷劑
records.exam_trap_en: Ethosuximide is 1st line for ABSENCE SEIZURES ONLY (blocks T-type Ca channels in thalamus); it has NO activity against tonic-clonic seizures.
records.exam_trap_zh: 乙琥胺僅用於失神發作（阻斷丘腦 T 型鈣通道）；對大發作（強直陣攣發作）無效。
records.board_high_yield_en: Prototype succinimide anticonvulsant. 1st-line drug for absence (petit mal) seizures. Specifically blocks T-type Ca channels in thalamic relay neurons. Adverse effect: GI distress & blood dyscrasias.

indications_en: dailymed:19c924c2-f558-4c78-9277-2d7e0df2f505#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:19c924c2-f558-4c78-9277-2d7e0df2f505#WARNINGS

records.site_of_action_en: The motor cortex and the central nervous system — the label attributes the effect to depression of the motor cortex and elevation of the CNS threshold to convulsive stimuli, hedged as apparent rather than established
records.site_of_action_zh: 運動皮質與中樞神經系統 —— 標籤將其效果歸因於抑制運動皮質並提高中樞神經對痙攣刺激的閾值,措辭為「看來如此」而非已確立
records.physiologic_effect_en: Suppression of the paroxysmal three cycle per second spike and wave activity associated with the lapses of consciousness common in absence (petit mal) seizures, with a reduction in the frequency of epileptiform attacks
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 抑制失神(小發作)癲癇中伴隨意識中斷、每秒三週期的陣發性棘慢波活動,並減少癲癇樣發作的頻率
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid 19c924c2-f558-4c78-9277-2d7e0df2f505)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid 19c924c2-f558-4c78-9277-2d7e0df2f505), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.mechanism_en: High-affinity binding to the auxiliary alpha-2-delta-1 subunit of voltage-gated calcium channels in the CNS, inhibiting presynaptic calcium influx and glutamate/substance P release.
records.mechanism_zh: 高親和力結合至中樞電壓門控鈣通道之 alpha-2-delta-1 輔助亞基，抑制突觸前鈣內流與興奮性遞質 (谷氨酸/P物質) 釋放。
records.pharmacodynamics_summary_en: Structurally related to GABA but does not bind GABA-A or GABA-B receptors and does not inhibit GABA uptake.

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: 2-3 hours; Peak: 2-3 hours; Duration: 8 hours (requires t.i.d. dosing).
pharmacokinetics.metabolism_en: Not metabolized in humans (0% hepatic metabolism).
pharmacokinetics.elimination_en: Renal excretion unchanged (100%); clearance directly proportional to CrCl.

indications_en: Management of postherpetic neuralgia in adults
Adjunctive therapy in the treatment of partial-onset seizures with or without secondary generalization
indications_zh: 成人帶狀皰疹後神經痛之控制
部分性發作 (伴或不伴二次全身化) 癲癇之輔助治療
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 嚴重呼吸抑制 (併用鴉片類時)
過敏性休克與血管水腫
自殺意念
warnings_en: Respiratory Depression: Serious, life-threatening respiratory depression may occur when used with opioids or in elderly/renal impairment patients.
Abrupt Discontinuation: Taper over at least 1 week to avoid withdrawal precipitation of status epilepticus.
warnings_zh: 呼吸抑制：與鴉片類併用或於老年/腎功能不全患者使用時可能引致致命性呼吸抑制。
突發停藥：須於至少 1 週內逐漸減量，以防戒斷誘發癲癇重積狀態。
contraindications_en: Hypersensitivity to gabapentin or formulation ingredients.
contraindications_zh: 對加巴噴丁或製劑成分過敏。
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy Category C. Excreted in human milk; use caution.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 懷孕級別 C。分泌至母乳中；慎用。
records.renal_considerations_en: Mandatory dosage reduction based on creatinine clearance (CrCl < 60 mL/min). Supplemental dose required post-hemodialysis.
records.hepatic_considerations_en: No dosage adjustment required (drug is not metabolized by the liver).
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor renal function (CrCl), sedation, dizziness, peripheral edema, and respiratory status when combined with opioids.

drug_interactions_graded.interaction_en: Co-administration increases gabapentin AUC and risk of severe CNS/respiratory depression.

records.tcm_relation_note_zh: Gabapentin 為神經痛門診極常見西藥（帶狀皰疹後神經痛、糖尿病神經病變，中醫脅痛、痺證、絡病）。副作用以頭暈、嗜睡、雙下肢水腫（中醫水濕停聚、脾腎陽虛水腫）最常見，須依腎功能 (CrCl) 嚴格調整劑量。
records.mnemonic_en: Gabapentin = G (GABA structural analog) A (Alpha-2-delta calcium channel subunit) B (Binds Ca channel, NOT GABA receptor) A (Analgesic for neuropathic pain).
records.mnemonic_zh: Gabapentin = GABA 結構類似物 (GABA analog) 結合 Alpha-2-delta 鈣通道亞基 治療神經痛 (Analgesic for neuropathic pain)。
records.classic_association_en: Gabapentin -> Postherpetic neuralgia & alpha-2-delta Ca channel subunit ligand / sedation & peripheral edema
records.classic_association_zh: 加巴噴丁 -> 帶狀皰疹後神經痛、alpha-2-delta 鈣通道亞基配體、鎮靜嗜睡與周邊水腫
records.exam_trap_en: Gabapentin is structurally derived from GABA, but DOES NOT bind GABA receptors; its primary clinical use is NEUROPATHIC PAIN (postherpetic neuralgia). Dosage MUST be reduced in renal impairment.
records.exam_trap_zh: 加巴噴丁結構源自 GABA，但不結合 GABA 受體；臨床主要用於神經病理性疼痛（帶狀皰疹後神經痛）。腎功能不全患者必須減量。
records.board_high_yield_en: Prototype gabapentinoid. Binds alpha-2-delta Ca channel subunit. 1st line for postherpetic neuralgia & neuropathic pain. Unmetabolized (100% renal excretion; reduce dose in renal impairment). Side effects: Dizziness, sedation, peripheral edema.

indications_en: dailymed:507bf6d0-e7a2-413d-9848-cd2445a1411d#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:507bf6d0-e7a2-413d-9848-cd2445a1411d#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.site_of_action_en: The alpha2delta subunit of voltage-activated calcium channels, bound with high affinity in vitro; the label states the relationship of this binding to gabapentin's therapeutic effects is unknown
records.site_of_action_zh: 電壓活化型鈣離子通道的 α2δ 次單元,體外試驗顯示高親和力結合;標籤載明此結合與其治療效果的關聯仍屬未知
records.physiologic_effect_en: The label states the precise mechanisms producing gabapentin's analgesic and antiepileptic actions are unknown. Gabapentin is structurally related to the neurotransmitter GABA but has no effect on GABA binding, uptake, or degradation.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 標籤載明 gabapentin 產生鎮痛與抗癲癇作用的確切機轉未明。其結構雖與神經傳導物質 GABA 相關,卻不影響 GABA 的結合、再攝取或分解。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid 507bf6d0-e7a2-413d-9848-cd2445a1411d)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid 507bf6d0-e7a2-413d-9848-cd2445a1411d), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.name_zh: 卡比多巴 / 左旋多巴
records.subclass_en: Dopamine Precursor and Peripheral DOPA Decarboxylase Inhibitor Combination
records.mechanism_en: Levodopa crosses the blood-brain barrier and is decarboxylated to dopamine in the striatum; carbidopa inhibits peripheral aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase, preventing peripheral conversion of levodopa to dopamine.
records.mechanism_zh: 左旋多巴穿過血腦障壁於紋狀體去羧化為多巴胺；卡比多巴抑制外周芳香族 L-胺基酸去羧酶，阻斷外周左旋多巴轉化為多巴胺並減少噁心等外周副作用。
records.pharmacodynamics_summary_en: Replenishes depleted striatal dopamine stores in Parkinson's disease; carbidopa increases brain levodopa delivery 3- to 4-fold.

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: 30 minutes (immediate release); Peak: 0.5-2 hours; Duration: 3-5 hours.
pharmacokinetics.metabolism_en: Levodopa is decarboxylated by central dopa decarboxylase to active dopamine; carbidopa is not significantly metabolized in CNS.
pharmacokinetics.elimination_en: Renal clearance of dopamine metabolites (homovanillic acid/HVA).

indications_en: Treatment of Parkinson's disease, post-encephalitic parkinsonism, and symptomatic parkinsonism
indications_zh: 治療帕金森氏症、腦炎後帕金森氏症候群及症狀性帕金森氏症候群
serious_adverse_effects_en: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS) upon sudden withdrawal
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 開關現象 (On-off motor fluctuations)
突發停藥引致抗精神病藥惡性症候群 (NMS)
嚴重精神病 / 衝動控制障礙
warnings_en: Motor Fluctuations: Long-term treatment leads to 'wearing-off' and unpredictable 'on-off' motor fluctuations.
MAOI Interaction: Concomitant nonselective MAOI use may cause severe hypertensive crisis; discontinue MAOIs 14 days prior.
warnings_zh: 運動波動現象：長期用藥引致藥效遞減 (Wearing-off) 及不可預測之『開關現象』。
MAOI 交互作用：併用非選擇性 MAOI 可造成嚴重高血壓危機；停用 MAOI 須達 14 天。
contraindications_en: Concomitant use of nonselective monoamine oxidase (MAO) inhibitors within 14 days
Suspicious undiagnosed skin lesions or history of melanoma
contraindications_zh: 14 天內併用非選擇性單胺氧化酶 (MAOI) 抑制劑
閉角型青光眼
疑似未確診之皮膚病變或黑色素瘤病史
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy Category C. Inhibits prolactin secretion; caution in nursing mothers.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 懷孕級別 C。抑制催乳素分泌；哺乳期慎用。
records.renal_considerations_en: No specific dosage adjustment provided; monitor for enhanced adverse effects.
records.hepatic_considerations_en: Use caution in severe hepatic impairment.
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor motor function, dyskinesias, blood pressure, mental status/psychosis, and skin examination for melanoma.

drug_interactions_graded.interaction_en: Severe, potentially fatal hypertensive crisis due to massive accumulation of catecholamines.

records.tcm_relation_note_zh: Carbidopa/Levodopa (Sinemet) 為帕金森氏症（中醫顫證、顫振）金標準。Levodopa 補充多巴胺，Carbidopa 抑制外周去羧酶減輕噁心。長期服藥易出現「開關現象」（動靜轉換障礙、藥效波動）與舞蹈樣不自主運動（中醫肝風內動），診察針灸時須記錄服藥時間點與動作開關狀態。
records.mnemonic_en: Sinemet = Carbidopa 'Carries' Levodopa across BBB by blocking peripheral decarboxylase; stops 'Nausea' from peripheral dopamine.
records.mnemonic_zh: Sinemet = Carbidopa 護送 (Carries) Levodopa 穿越血腦障壁，阻斷外周去羧酶，防止外周多巴胺引致噁心 (Nausea)。
records.classic_association_en: Carbidopa/Levodopa -> Parkinson's disease 1st line & peripheral dopa decarboxylase inhibition / on-off phenomenon
records.classic_association_zh: 卡比多巴/左旋多巴 -> 帕金森氏症首選、外周多巴去羧酶抑制與開關現象
records.exam_trap_en: Levodopa crosses the BBB; Carbidopa DOES NOT cross BBB (specifically inhibits peripheral decarboxylase to reduce peripheral nausea); long-term use leads to 'on-off' dyskinesia.
records.exam_trap_zh: Levodopa 可穿過血腦障壁；Carbidopa 不過血腦障壁（專一抑制外周去羧酶以降低外周噁心）；長期使用引致『開關』運動障礙。
records.board_high_yield_en: Gold standard for Parkinson's disease. Levodopa = dopamine precursor (crosses BBB). Carbidopa = peripheral dopa decarboxylase inhibitor (does not cross BBB; increases CNS levodopa 3-4x & reduces peripheral nausea). Side effects: Dyskinesias, on-off phenomenon, orthostatic hypotension.
records.dailymed_label_title: CARBIDOPA AND LEVODOPA TABLET [TEVA PHARMACEUTICALS USA, INC.]

indications_en: dailymed:4ace5274-b6cf-414c-b9c0-f60e28a9cea5#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:4ace5274-b6cf-414c-b9c0-f60e28a9cea5#WARNINGS

records.site_of_action_en: Levodopa crosses the blood-brain barrier and is presumably converted to dopamine in the corpus striatum; carbidopa acts only in extracerebral tissues, where it inhibits decarboxylation of peripheral levodopa, and does not cross the blood-brain barrier
records.site_of_action_zh: levodopa 可通過血腦障壁,一般認為在紋狀體轉為多巴胺;carbidopa 則只作用於腦外組織,抑制周邊 levodopa 的去羧基化,本身不通過血腦障壁
records.physiologic_effect_en: By limiting peripheral decarboxylation, carbidopa makes more levodopa available for transport to the brain and reduces the levodopa dose required for a given response by about 75%, increasing levodopa plasma levels and extending its half-life from about 50 minutes to about 1.5 hours; the incidence of levodopa-induced nausea and vomiting is lower with the combination
records.physiologic_effect_zh: carbidopa 抑制周邊去羧基化,使更多 levodopa 得以送入腦部,達到相同療效所需的 levodopa 劑量約可減少 75%,並提高其血中濃度、把半衰期由約 50 分鐘延長到約 1.5 小時;合併使用時 levodopa 引起噁心嘔吐的發生率也較低
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid 4ace5274-b6cf-414c-b9c0-f60e28a9cea5)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid 4ace5274-b6cf-414c-b9c0-f60e28a9cea5), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.mechanism_en: Irreversibly and non-selectively inhibits monoamine oxidase (MAO-A and MAO-B) enzymes, increasing endogenous concentrations of epinephrine, norepinephrine, serotonin, and dopamine in the CNS.
records.mechanism_zh: 不可逆性非選擇性抑制單胺氧化酶 (MAO-A 及 MAO-B)，提高中樞神經系統內腎上腺素、正腎上腺素、血清素及多巴胺濃度。
records.pharmacodynamics_summary_en: Antidepressant and anxiolytic efficacy in refractory/atypical depression; enzyme recovery requires up to 2 weeks after drug cessation.

pharmacokinetics.onset_duration_en: Onset: 2-6 weeks for full antidepressant therapeutic effect; Duration: 10-14 days after discontinuation due to irreversible enzyme inhibition.
pharmacokinetics.metabolism_en: Extensively metabolized by hepatic acetylation (slow vs fast acetylator phenotype).

indications_en: Treatment of major depressive disorder in patients who have failed to respond to other antidepressants (atypical or treatment-resistant depression)
indications_zh: 治療對其他抗憂鬱藥無效之重度憂鬱症患者 (非典型或難治性憂鬱症)
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 致命性高血壓危機 (酪胺飲食反應)
血清素症候群 (併用 SSRI/SNRI)
肝毒性
records.boxed_warning_en: Suicidality and Antidepressant Drugs: Increased risk of suicidal thinking and behavior in children, adolescents, and young adults (aged 18-24) taking antidepressants for MDD.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 自殺傾向與抗憂鬱藥黑框警告：兒童、青少年及青年 (18-24歲) 服用抗憂鬱藥治療 MDD 時，自殺意念與行為風險增加。
warnings_en: Hypertensive Crisis & Tyramine Foods: Ingestion of tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, red wine, cured meats, yeast extracts) can trigger fatal hypertensive crisis. Maintain dietary restriction for 2 weeks after stopping phenelzine.
Serotonin Syndrome & Washout: 14-day washout period required before starting another antidepressant (5 weeks for fluoxetine).
warnings_zh: 高血壓危機與酪胺食物：攝取富含酪胺食物（乳酪、紅酒、臘肉、酵母萃取物）可誘發致命高血壓危機。停藥後 2 週內須維持飲食限制。
血清素症候群與洗脫期：換用其他抗憂鬱藥前須嚴格遵守 14 天洗脫期（Fluoxetine 須 5 週）。
contraindications_en: Congestive heart failure or severe renal disease
Concomitant use of sympathomimetics, SSRIs, SNRIs, TCAs, meperidine, dextromethorphan, or tyramine-rich foods
contraindications_zh: 嗜鉻細胞腫
充血性心衰竭或嚴重腎臟疾病
併用交感神經刺激劑、SSRI、SNRI、TCA、Meperidine、Dextromethorphan 或富含酪胺食物
嚴重肝功能受損
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy Category C. Safety in pregnancy and lactation has not been established.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 懷孕級別 C。孕期及哺乳期安全性尚未確立。
records.renal_considerations_en: Contraindicated in severe renal disease or renal failure.
records.hepatic_considerations_en: Contraindicated in severe liver disease or abnormal LFTs.
records.monitoring_requirements_en: Monitor blood pressure frequently (for orthostatic hypotension or hypertensive crisis), suicidal ideation, LFTs, and adherence to tyramine-restricted diet.

drug_interactions_graded.interaction_en: Potentially fatal Serotonin Syndrome characterized by hyperthermia, rigidity, myoclonus, autonomic instability, and mental status changes.

records.tcm_relation_note_zh: Phenelzine 為非選擇性不可逆 MAOI 抗憂鬱藥。具經典「乳酪效應」（Tyramine 飲食反應引致致命高血壓危機，中醫肝陽暴亢、中風厥逆）。飲食禁忌：陳年乳酪、紅酒、醃肉、發酵豆製品。換用中藥或西藥抗憂鬱劑前須嚴格遵守 14 天洗脫期。
records.mnemonic_en: Phenelzine (Nardil) = NO Tyramine (cheese effect -> hypertensive crisis), NO SSRIs (serotonin syndrome), Need 14-day Washout.
records.mnemonic_zh: Phenelzine (Nardil) 口訣：NO 酪胺食物（乳酪效應 -> 高血壓危機）、NO SSRIs（血清素症候群）、Need 14天洗脫期。
records.classic_association_en: Phenelzine -> Nonselective MAOI & tyramine food hypertensive crisis / 14-day washout rule
records.classic_association_zh: 苯乙肼 -> 非選擇性 MAOI、酪胺食物高血壓危機與 14 天洗脫期規則
records.exam_trap_en: Phenelzine is a nonselective MAOI; ingestion of tyramine (aged cheese, wine) causes severe HYPERTENSIVE CRISIS ('cheese effect'); requires 14-day washout before starting SSRIs.
records.exam_trap_zh: 苯乙肼為非選擇性 MAOI；攝取酪胺食物（乳酪、紅酒）會引發嚴重高血壓危機（『乳酪效應』）；換用 SSRI 前須 14 天洗脫期。
records.board_high_yield_en: Prototype nonselective irreversible MAOI. Used for treatment-resistant atypical depression. Fatal hypertensive crisis with tyramine-containing foods. Fatal Serotonin Syndrome with SSRIs/meperidine. 14-day washout period required.
records.dailymed_label_title: PHENELZINE SULFATE TABLET, FILM COATED [MYLAN PHARMACEUTICALS INC.]

indications_en: dailymed:fa041652-fdde-4794-a8d2-279dd309e075#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:fa041652-fdde-4794-a8d2-279dd309e075#WARNINGS

records.site_of_action_en: Monoamine oxidase, a complex enzyme system widely distributed throughout the body
records.site_of_action_zh: 單胺氧化酶 —— 一套廣泛分布於全身的複雜酵素系統
records.physiologic_effect_en: The label is explicitly non-committal: it states that drugs inhibiting monoamine oxidase in the laboratory are associated with a number of clinical effects, and that it is unknown whether MAO inhibition itself, other pharmacologic actions, or an interaction of both is responsible for the clinical effects observed.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 標籤在此處刻意保留:僅說明在實驗室中抑制單胺氧化酶的藥物會伴隨多種臨床效應,而所觀察到的臨床效果究竟來自單胺氧化酶抑制本身、其他藥理作用,或兩者交互所致,目前並不清楚。

records.mechanism_en: Synthetic T4 (L-thyroxine). Replaces or supplements endogenous thyroid hormone. Peripheral deiodination converts T4 to active T3. Binds nuclear thyroid hormone receptors and regulates gene expression involved in metabolism, growth, and development.
records.mechanism_zh: 合成T4（左旋甲狀腺素）。替代或補充內源性甲狀腺素。周邊脫碘酶將T4轉化為活性T3。與核內甲狀腺素受體結合，調節代謝、生長及發育相關基因表達。
indications_en: Hypothyroidism: replacement or supplemental therapy
Pituitary thyroid-stimulating hormone suppression (as adjunct to surgery and radioiodine therapy in selected thyroid conditions)
indications_zh: 甲狀腺功能低下：替代或補充治療
腦垂體促甲狀腺素抑制（特定甲狀腺疾病術後及放射碘治療的輔助）
contraindications_en: Known hypersensitivity to levothyroxine or any inactive ingredient
contraindications_zh: 未矯正的腎上腺功能不全
急性心肌梗塞
已知對左旋甲狀腺素或任何非活性成分過敏
adverse_effects_en: Symptoms of hyperthyroidism when over-replaced: palpitations, tachycardia, anxiety, insomnia, heat intolerance, weight loss
Bone loss with prolonged supraphysiologic doses
Atrial fibrillation in older patients with excess doses
adverse_effects_zh: 替代過量出現甲狀腺功能亢進症狀：心悸、心跳過速、焦慮、失眠、耐熱能力下降、體重減輕
長期超生理劑量導致骨質流失
老年患者過量使用可能出現心房顫動
records.mnemonic_en: Levo = Left = T4, peripherally converts to active T3. TSH feedback is the monitoring anchor.
records.classic_association_en: Levothyroxine -> Synthroid -> T4 replacement -> Monitor TSH -> Absorption interactions (Ca, Fe, food)
records.exam_trap_en: Multiple drugs (calcium, iron, antacids) and food reduce levothyroxine absorption. Take on empty stomach. Pregnancy may require dose increase. Old pregnancy category A (in course) is NOT current FDA labeling.
records.exam_trap_zh: 多種藥物（鈣、鐵、制酸劑）及食物降低左旋甲狀腺素吸收。應空腹服用。懷孕可能需要增加劑量。課件的妊娠類別A已是過時分類，非現行FDA標示。
records.clinical_use_note_zh: 考試層：T4替代療法原型藥、黑框警語（不得用於減重）、TSH監測、多重吸收交互作用。課件來源 P3 Endocrine；黑框來自 DailyMed。

indications_en: dailymed:42a26f8a-dc67-42e4-abb0-d2602afb1b7d#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE

records.site_of_action_en: Thyroid receptor proteins attached to DNA in the cell nucleus
records.site_of_action_zh: 細胞核內附著於 DNA 上的甲狀腺素受體蛋白
records.physiologic_effect_en: Thyroid hormones act through control of DNA transcription and protein synthesis: T3 and T4 diffuse into the nucleus and bind thyroid receptor proteins, and the hormone-nuclear receptor complex activates gene transcription and synthesis of messenger RNA and cytoplasmic proteins. Physiological actions are produced predominantly by T3, approximately 80% of which is derived from T4 by deiodination in peripheral tissues. Oral levothyroxine is a synthetic T4 that exerts the same physiologic effect as endogenous T4, maintaining normal T4 levels where a deficiency is present.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 甲狀腺素透過調控 DNA 轉錄與蛋白質合成發揮作用:T3 與 T4 擴散進入細胞核並結合甲狀腺素受體蛋白,所形成的激素—核受體複合體再啟動基因轉錄與信使 RNA、細胞質蛋白的合成。生理作用主要由 T3 產生,其中約 80% 由 T4 在周邊組織去碘而來。口服 levothyroxine 為合成的 T4,作用與內生性 T4 相同,可在缺乏時維持正常的 T4 濃度。
records.boxed_warning_zh: 黑框警語：包括左旋甲狀腺素在內的甲狀腺素不得用於治療肥胖或減重。在正常或超出正常範圍的劑量，尤其與擬交感神經胺合用時，可能產生嚴重或威脅生命的毒性效應。
records.boxed_warning_en: BOXED WARNING: Thyroid hormones, including levothyroxine, should not be used for the treatment of obesity or weight loss. Doses within or above the normal range may produce serious or life-threatening toxic effects particularly when given with sympathomimetic amines.

records.mechanism_en: Prodrug converted to active prednisolone in the liver. Binds intracellular glucocorticoid receptors, translocates to nucleus, and modulates gene transcription — broadly suppressing inflammatory cytokines and immune response; also produces metabolic, cardiovascular, and CNS effects.
records.mechanism_zh: 前驅藥，在肝臟轉化為活性的潑尼龍（prednisolone）。結合細胞內糖皮質激素受體，轉位至細胞核調節基因轉錄—廣泛抑制炎症細胞因子與免疫反應；同時有代謝、心血管及中樞神經系統效應。
indications_en: Inflammatory and autoimmune disorders (numerous)
Allergic conditions
Dermatologic diseases
Respiratory diseases including asthma
Hematologic disorders
Certain neoplastic conditions (adjunct)
Adrenal insufficiency (replacement)
indications_zh: 炎症與自體免疫疾患（多種）
過敏性疾病
皮膚疾病
呼吸疾病，包括氣喘
血液疾患
特定腫瘤疾病（輔助）
腎上腺功能不全（替代）
contraindications_en: Known hypersensitivity to components of the formulation
contraindications_zh: 全身性真菌感染
對製劑成分已知過敏
warnings_en: Infection risk: corticosteroids may mask signs of infection and increase susceptibility. Disseminated infection risk with live vaccines and immunosuppressed patients.
Adrenal suppression: abrupt withdrawal after prolonged use can cause adrenal crisis.
Psychiatric effects: euphoria, insomnia, mood changes, severe depression, and psychotic manifestations may occur.
Musculoskeletal: corticosteroid myopathy and osteoporosis with prolonged use.
Endocrine: hyperglycemia and worsening diabetes control.
warnings_zh: 感染風險：皮質類固醇可能掩蓋感染徵象並增加易感性。活疫苗及免疫抑制患者有播散性感染風險。
腎上腺抑制：長期使用後突然停藥可能引發腎上腺危象。
精神症狀：可能出現欣快感、失眠、情緒變化、嚴重憂鬱及精神病症狀。
肌肉骨骼：長期使用導致皮質類固醇肌病及骨質疏鬆。
內分泌：高血糖及糖尿病控制惡化。
adverse_effects_en: Cataracts and glaucoma with prolonged use
adverse_effects_zh: 長期使用導致白內障與青光眼
records.mnemonic_en: PREDNISONE multi-system: Glucose up, Infection up, Bones down, Mood up then down
records.classic_association_en: Systemic glucocorticoid -> anti-inflammatory prototype -> multi-system adverse effects -> adrenal suppression on abrupt withdrawal
records.exam_trap_en: Do not stop abruptly after prolonged use — adrenal crisis risk. Glucose can rise significantly even in non-diabetics. Old pregnancy category C/D wording in older courses is not current FDA labeling.
records.exam_trap_zh: 長期使用後不得突然停藥——有腎上腺危象風險。即使是非糖尿病患者也可能出現明顯血糖升高。舊課件的妊娠類別C/D是過時分類，非現行FDA標示。
records.clinical_use_note_zh: 考試層：全身性糖皮質激素原型藥、多系統不良反應、腎上腺抑制/戒斷風險。課件來源 P3 Endocrine；禁忌與警語來自 DailyMed。

indications_en: dailymed:d6df3295-3118-49af-be05-b1fab0d4adaa#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:d6df3295-3118-49af-be05-b1fab0d4adaa#WARNINGS

records.physiologic_effect_en: Glucocorticoids cause profound and varied metabolic effects and modify the body's immune responses to diverse stimuli. Naturally occurring glucocorticoids, which also have salt-retaining properties, are used as replacement therapy in adrenocortical deficiency states, while their synthetic analogs are used primarily for their potent anti-inflammatory effects in disorders of many organ systems.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 糖皮質素會造成廣泛而深遠的代謝影響,並改變人體對各種刺激的免疫反應。天然的糖皮質素兼具留鹽作用,用於腎上腺皮質功能不足的補充治療;其合成類似物則主要取其強效抗發炎作用,用於多種器官系統的疾病。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid d6df3295-3118-49af-be05-b1fab0d4adaa)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid d6df3295-3118-49af-be05-b1fab0d4adaa), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.mechanism_en: GLP-1 receptor agonist. Activates GLP-1 receptors to stimulate glucose-dependent insulin secretion, suppress glucagon release, slow gastric emptying, and reduce appetite. Also reduces hepatic glucose output. Has cardiovascular and renal protective effects independent of glucose lowering.
records.mechanism_zh: GLP-1受體促效劑。激活GLP-1受體，促進葡萄糖依賴性胰島素分泌，抑制升糖素釋放，延緩胃排空，降低食慾。亦減少肝臟葡萄糖輸出。具有獨立於降糖作用的心血管與腎臟保護效果。
indications_en: Type 2 diabetes mellitus: glycemic control in adults (Ozempic/Rybelsus)
Reduction of major cardiovascular events in adults with T2DM + established CVD (Ozempic)
Reduction of CV and kidney outcomes in adults with T2DM + CKD (Ozempic)
Chronic weight management: BMI ≥30 or ≥27 with weight-related comorbidity (Wegovy)
indications_zh: 第二型糖尿病成人血糖控制（Ozempic/Rybelsus）
T2DM合併確診心血管疾病成人的主要心血管事件降低（Ozempic）
T2DM合併CKD成人的心血管與腎臟預後降低（Ozempic）
慢性體重管理：BMI≥30或≥27合併體重相關共病（Wegovy）
contraindications_en: Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC)
Known serious hypersensitivity to semaglutide or excipients
contraindications_zh: 個人或家族性甲狀腺髓樣癌（MTC）病史
第二型多發性內分泌腺瘤症（MEN2）
已知對司美格魯肽或賦形劑嚴重過敏
warnings_en: Pancreatitis: Discontinue if suspected.
Hypoglycemia: Risk increases when combined with insulin or insulin secretagogue.
Acute gallbladder disease: Increased rate reported.
Acute kidney injury: Monitor renal function with severe GI adverse reactions.
Peri-procedural aspiration risk: Delay gastric emptying may increase risk. Follow current procedural team guidance.
warnings_zh: 胰臟炎：若疑似應停藥。
低血糖：與胰島素或胰島素促分泌劑合用時風險增加。
急性膽囊疾病：報告發生率增加。
急性腎損傷：嚴重胃腸道不良反應時應監測腎功能。
圍術期吸入風險：胃排空延遲可能增加風險，應遵循手術團隊現行指引。
adverse_effects_en: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain (very common)
adverse_effects_zh: 噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉、腹痛（非常常見）
注射部位反應（皮下劑型）
records.mnemonic_en: Sema-GLUTIDE = GLP-1 = Glucose-dependent, Lowers appetite, Protects heart
records.classic_association_en: GLP-1 agonist -> Ozempic/Wegovy -> nausea very common -> MTC boxed warning -> delays gastric emptying (peri-procedure risk)
records.exam_trap_en: Product matters: Ozempic ≠ Wegovy ≠ Rybelsus. GLP-1s delay gastric emptying — anesthesia/procedure planning must account for this. Discontinue ≥ 2 months before planned pregnancy (long washout).
records.exam_trap_zh: 產品有別：Ozempic≠Wegovy≠Rybelsus。GLP-1類藥物延緩胃排空——麻醉/手術計劃須考量此點。計劃懷孕前至少2個月停藥（半衰期長）。
records.clinical_use_note_zh: 考試層：GLP-1受體促效劑原型藥、MTC黑框、噁心高發、胃排空延遲/圍術期風險。課件來源 P3 Endocrine；黑框來自 DailyMed Ozempic 標籤。

indications_en: dailymed:adec4fd2-6858-4c99-91d4-531f5f2a2d79#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:adec4fd2-6858-4c99-91d4-531f5f2a2d79#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.site_of_action_en: The GLP-1 receptor, the target for native GLP-1
records.site_of_action_zh: GLP-1 受體 —— 天然 GLP-1 的作用標的
records.physiologic_effect_en: Semaglutide stimulates insulin secretion and lowers glucagon secretion, both in a glucose-dependent manner, so that insulin secretion is stimulated and glucagon secretion inhibited when blood glucose is high; the mechanism also involves a minor delay in gastric emptying in the early postprandial phase. It lowers fasting and postprandial blood glucose and reduces body weight. The label states the mechanism of kidney-related risk reduction has not been established.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: semaglutide 以葡萄糖依賴的方式促進胰島素分泌並降低升糖素分泌 —— 血糖高時才刺激胰島素、抑制升糖素;其作用另包含在餐後早期輕度延遲胃排空。可降低空腹與餐後血糖並減輕體重。標籤載明其降低腎臟相關風險的機轉尚未確立。
records.boxed_warning_zh: 黑框警語（Ozempic）：甲狀腺C細胞腫瘤風險。MTC或MEN2個人/家族病史患者禁用。人體相關性未知。
records.boxed_warning_en: BOXED WARNING (Ozempic): Risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Contraindicated in patients with personal/family history of MTC or MEN2. Human relevance unknown.

records.mechanism_en: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (statin). Competitively inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the rate-limiting step in cholesterol biosynthesis. Reduces hepatic cholesterol synthesis, upregulates LDL receptors, and lowers circulating LDL-C.
records.mechanism_zh: HMG-CoA還原酶抑制劑（他汀類）。競爭性抑制膽固醇合成限速步驟HMG-CoA還原酶。降低肝臟膽固醇合成，上調LDL受體，降低循環LDL膽固醇。
indications_en: Primary hyperlipidemia and mixed dyslipidemia: reduction of LDL-C, total cholesterol, ApoB, TG; increase of HDL-C
Hypertriglyceridemia
Primary dysbetalipoproteinemia
Homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia
Reduction of cardiovascular risk in patients without clinically evident coronary artery disease (JUPITER trial indication)
indications_zh: 原發性高脂血症與混合性血脂異常：降低LDL-C、總膽固醇、ApoB、TG；升高HDL-C
高三酸甘油酯血症
原發性異常β脂蛋白血症
純合子家族性高膽固醇血症
無明顯冠狀動脈疾病患者的心血管風險降低（JUPITER試驗適應症）
contraindications_en: Active liver disease, including unexplained persistent elevations of hepatic transaminases
Known hypersensitivity to rosuvastatin or its components
contraindications_zh: 活動性肝病，包括原因不明的持續性肝轉氨酶升高
妊娠
哺乳
已知對瑞舒伐他汀或其成分過敏
合用環孢素（Crestor製劑）
warnings_en: Myopathy and rhabdomyolysis: risk increases with higher doses, Asian patients, renal impairment, hypothyroidism, and interacting drugs. Instruct patients to report unexplained muscle pain/weakness/tenderness.
Liver enzyme elevations: rare; consider discontinuation for persistent significant elevations.
Endocrine: may cause elevated blood glucose levels; weigh against cardiovascular benefit.
warnings_zh: 肌病與橫紋肌溶解：高劑量、亞裔患者、腎功能損害、甲狀腺功能低下及交互作用藥物時風險增加。指導患者回報原因不明的肌肉疼痛/無力/壓痛。
肝酶升高：罕見；持續顯著升高時考慮停藥。
內分泌：可能導致血糖升高；需與心血管獲益進行評估。
adverse_effects_zh: 橫紋肌溶解（罕見但嚴重）
records.mnemonic_en: Rosuva = Crestor. More potent than atorvastatin per mg. Still same class toxicity: myopathy/rhabdo.
records.classic_association_en: High-intensity statin -> Crestor -> compare atorvastatin for potency -> same myopathy risk class
records.exam_trap_en: Legacy statin pregnancy category X is NOT current FDA labeling. Contraindicated in pregnancy. Myopathy risk increases with renal impairment and interacting drugs (especially CYP interactions different from atorvastatin).
records.exam_trap_zh: 舊課件他汀類妊娠類別X非現行FDA標示，但妊娠仍屬禁忌。腎功能損害與交互作用藥物（與阿托伐他汀的CYP交互作用特性不同）會增加肌病風險。

indications_en: dailymed:d58f1f63-4bb6-413c-9730-ded3e8078618#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:d58f1f63-4bb6-413c-9730-ded3e8078618#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.site_of_action_en: HMG-CoA reductase in the liver
records.site_of_action_zh: 肝臟中的 HMG-CoA 還原酶
records.physiologic_effect_en: Inhibition of HMG-CoA reductase accelerates expression of LDL receptors and hepatic uptake of LDL-C, lowering plasma LDL-C and total cholesterol; sustained inhibition of hepatic cholesterol synthesis also lowers very-low-density lipoprotein levels. Maximum LDL-C reduction is usually achieved by 4 weeks and maintained thereafter.
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 抑制 HMG-CoA 還原酶可加速低密度脂蛋白受體的表現與肝臟對低密度脂蛋白膽固醇的攝取,使血漿低密度脂蛋白膽固醇與總膽固醇下降;持續抑制肝臟膽固醇合成亦降低極低密度脂蛋白濃度。最大降幅通常在 4 週達成並可維持。

records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid d58f1f63-4bb6-413c-9730-ded3e8078618), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.mechanism_en: Non-dihydropyridine calcium channel blocker (benzothiazepine subclass). Blocks L-type voltage-gated calcium channels in cardiac and vascular smooth muscle. Slows sinoatrial and atrioventricular nodal conduction, reduces heart rate, decreases myocardial contractility, and dilates coronary and peripheral vasculature.
records.mechanism_zh: 非二氫吡啶類鈣通道阻滯劑（苯并噻氮卓亞類）。阻斷心臟與血管平滑肌L型電壓門控鈣通道。延緩竇房結與房室結傳導，降低心率，減少心肌收縮力，擴張冠狀動脈與周邊血管。
indications_en: Chronic stable angina
Angina due to coronary artery spasm
Hypertension (extended-release forms)
Supraventricular tachyarrhythmias: rate control of atrial fibrillation/flutter (IV form); paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (IV form)
indications_zh: 慢性穩定型心絞痛
冠狀動脈痙攣引起的心絞痛
高血壓（緩釋劑型）
室上性心動過速：心房顫動/撲動的心率控制（靜脈劑型）；陣發性室上性心動過速（靜脈劑型）
contraindications_en: Sick sinus syndrome (except with functioning pacemaker)
Second- or third-degree AV block (except with functioning pacemaker)
Acute myocardial infarction with pulmonary congestion
contraindications_zh: 病竇症候群（有功能心律器除外）
二度或三度房室傳導阻滯（有功能心律器除外）
嚴重低血壓（收縮壓<90 mmHg）
伴肺充血的急性心肌梗塞
禁止與靜脈注射β阻斷劑合用
warnings_en: Cardiac conduction abnormalities: can cause bradycardia and AV block — monitor ECG.
Heart failure: use with caution; can worsen systolic heart failure.
Hypotension.
Drug interactions: inhibits CYP3A4; multiple significant interactions including cyclosporine, simvastatin.
warnings_zh: 心臟傳導異常：可能引起心跳過緩與房室傳導阻滯——監測心電圖。
心衰竭：謹慎使用；可能加重收縮性心衰竭。
低血壓。
藥物交互作用：抑制CYP3A4；與環孢素、辛伐他汀等多種藥物有顯著交互作用。
records.mnemonic_en: Dilt-IAZ-em = non-DHP CCB. Contrasts with amlodipine: Diltiazem SLOWS the heart, Amlodipine OPENS the vessels.
records.classic_association_en: Non-DHP CCB -> rate control AF/flutter -> do NOT combine IV with IV beta-blocker (fatal bradycardia/AV block risk)
records.exam_trap_en: Do NOT combine IV diltiazem with IV beta-blockers — risk of severe bradycardia and AV block. CYP3A4 inhibitor — numerous drug interactions. Different from dihydropyridine CCBs: diltiazem significantly slows HR.
records.exam_trap_zh: 靜脈地爾硫卓不得與靜脈β阻斷劑合用——有嚴重心跳過緩與房室傳導阻滯風險。CYP3A4抑制劑——多種藥物交互作用。與二氫吡啶類CCB不同：地爾硫卓明顯降低心率。

indications_en: dailymed:196fc367-330e-4d15-b1d6-084ad3f97ae7#INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE
warnings_en: dailymed:196fc367-330e-4d15-b1d6-084ad3f97ae7#WARNINGS

records.site_of_action_en: Slow calcium channels of cardiac and vascular smooth muscle, including the coronary arteries
records.site_of_action_zh: 心肌與血管平滑肌(含冠狀動脈)的慢速鈣離子通道
records.physiologic_effect_en: Inhibition of calcium ion influx during membrane depolarization produces dilation of epicardial and subendocardial coronary arteries and inhibits coronary artery spasm; myocardial oxygen demand falls through reductions in heart rate and systemic blood pressure at submaximal and maximal exercise workloads
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 抑制細胞膜去極化時的鈣離子內流,使心外膜與心內膜下的冠狀動脈擴張並抑制冠狀動脈痙攣;在次大與最大運動負荷下降低心率與全身血壓,因而減少心肌耗氧量
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_zh: 依 DailyMed SPL(查證日 2026-08-11,setid 196fc367-330e-4d15-b1d6-084ad3f97ae7)未標記黑框警語區段(LOINC 34066-1)。
records.boxed_warning_checked_note_en: Per the DailyMed SPL (checked 2026-08-11, setid 196fc367-330e-4d15-b1d6-084ad3f97ae7), no boxed-warning section (LOINC 34066-1) is coded.

records.mechanism_en: Selective beta-1 adrenergic receptor blocker (cardioselective). Competitively blocks catecholamine stimulation of cardiac beta-1 receptors, reducing heart rate, myocardial contractility, and AV conduction velocity. Reduces systemic blood pressure and myocardial oxygen demand.
records.mechanism_zh: 選擇性β1腎上腺素受體阻斷劑（心臟選擇性）。競爭性阻斷兒茶酚胺對心臟β1受體的刺激，降低心率、心肌收縮力及房室傳導速度。降低全身血壓與心肌需氧量。
indications_en: Hypertension
Angina pectoris
Acute myocardial infarction (to reduce cardiovascular mortality)
indications_zh: 高血壓
心絞痛
急性心肌梗塞（降低心血管死亡率）
contraindications_en: Greater than first-degree AV block (without functioning pacemaker)
contraindications_zh: 竇性心跳過緩
一度以上房室傳導阻滯（無功能心律器）
心原性休克
明顯心衰竭
已知對阿替洛爾過敏
warnings_en: Abrupt cessation: can precipitate angina, myocardial infarction, or arrhythmia — taper when discontinuing.
Bronchospasm: beta-1 selectivity is relative; use with extreme caution in reactive airway disease.
Heart failure: can precipitate overt cardiac failure — use with extreme care.
Hypoglycemia: may mask tachycardia and other signs of hypoglycemia.
Renal impairment: atenolol is renally excreted; dose adjustment required in renal impairment.
warnings_zh: 突然停藥：可能誘發心絞痛、心肌梗塞或心律不整——停藥時應逐漸減量。
支氣管痙攣：β1選擇性為相對選擇性；反應性氣道疾病患者應極度謹慎使用。
心衰竭：可能誘發明顯心衰竭——需極度謹慎使用。
低血糖：可能掩蓋低血糖的心跳過速及其他症狀。
腎功能損害：阿替洛爾由腎臟排泄；腎功能損害時需調整劑量。
adverse_effects_zh: 喘鳴/支氣管痙攣（易感個體）
records.mnemonic_en: Atenolol = -olol = beta blocker. ATEN = 'a ten' = beta-1 selective at ten. Compare: metoprolol vs atenolol (both beta-1 selective, different PK/renal vs hepatic)
records.classic_association_en: Beta-1 selective blocker -> hypertension/angina -> renal clearance (contrast metoprolol which is hepatic) -> taper on discontinuation
records.exam_trap_en: Do NOT stop abruptly — angina rebound risk. Beta-1 selectivity is NOT absolute — still can cause bronchospasm at higher doses. Atenolol is renally cleared; different from metoprolol (hepatic).
records.exam_trap_zh: 不得突然停藥——心絞痛反彈風險。β1選擇性為相對選擇性——高劑量仍可能引起支氣管痙攣。阿替洛爾由腎臟清除，不同於美托洛爾（肝臟清除）。

warnings_en: dailymed:4ca8dd77-cdac-41fe-a742-b1b32551203b#WARNINGS

records.site_of_action_en: Beta1-adrenergic receptors (cardioselective); at higher doses atenolol also inhibits beta2-adrenoreceptors, chiefly in bronchial and vascular musculature
records.site_of_action_zh: 乙型第一型腎上腺素受體(心臟選擇性);劑量較高時也會抑制主要位於支氣管與血管平滑肌的乙型第二型受體
records.physiologic_effect_en: Beta1-selective adrenergic blockade without membrane stabilizing or intrinsic sympathomimetic (partial agonist) activity
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 選擇性阻斷乙型第一型腎上腺素受體,不具膜穩定作用,也沒有內在擬交感(部分促效)活性
