records.mechanism_en: Non-selective beta-adrenergic receptor blocker with additional alpha-1 adrenergic blocking activity. Blocks beta-1, beta-2, and alpha-1 receptors. The combined beta + alpha blockade produces vasodilation (unlike pure beta-blockers), reduces heart rate, and decreases systemic vascular resistance.
records.mechanism_zh: 非選擇性β腎上腺素受體阻斷劑，同時具有額外的α1腎上腺素阻斷活性。阻斷β1、β2及α1受體。β+α聯合阻斷產生血管舒張效果（不同於純β阻斷劑），降低心率，減少全身血管阻力。
indications_en: Mild to severe chronic heart failure of ischemic or cardiomyopathic origin (to reduce cardiovascular mortality and hospitalizations)
Left ventricular dysfunction following myocardial infarction
Hypertension
indications_zh: 缺血性或心肌病性輕至重度慢性心衰竭（降低心血管死亡率與住院率）
心肌梗塞後左心室功能不全
高血壓
contraindications_en: Bronchial asthma or related bronchospastic conditions
Second- or third-degree AV block without functioning pacemaker
Sick sinus syndrome without functioning pacemaker
Cardiogenic shock or decompensated heart failure requiring IV inotropic therapy
contraindications_zh: 支氣管哮喘或相關支氣管痙攣疾病
無功能心律器的二度或三度房室傳導阻滯
無功能心律器的病竇症候群
心原性休克或需靜脈正性肌力藥物的失代償性心衰竭
嚴重心跳過緩
warnings_en: Abrupt cessation: angina, MI, and arrhythmia can occur — taper gradually.
Bradycardia and hypotension: monitor; may require dose reduction.
Worsening heart failure: initiate at low doses with gradual up-titration; monitor for fluid retention.
Non-selective: blocks beta-2 — can cause significant bronchospasm in reactive airway disease. CONTRAINDICATED in bronchial asthma.
Hypoglycemia masking: can mask tachycardia of hypoglycemia.
warnings_zh: 突然停藥：可能出現心絞痛、心肌梗塞及心律不整——應逐漸減量。
心跳過緩與低血壓：監測；可能需要減量。
心衰竭惡化：從低劑量開始緩慢滴定；監測液體瀦留。
非選擇性：阻斷β2受體——反應性氣道疾病患者可能引起明顯支氣管痙攣。支氣管哮喘禁忌。
低血糖掩蓋：可能掩蓋低血糖引起的心跳過速。
adverse_effects_zh: 頭暈、低血壓（尤其是體位性低血壓）
records.mnemonic_en: CARVEdilol = CARdiac protection + VEssel dilation (alpha-1 block). Non-selective + alpha = vasodilation unlike pure beta-blockers.
records.classic_association_en: Non-selective beta + alpha-1 blocker -> heart failure mortality reduction -> vasodilation distinguishes from pure beta-blockers -> asthma CONTRAINDICATED
records.exam_trap_en: Carvedilol blocks alpha-1 too (vasodilation = less reflex tachycardia than pure alpha-1 blockers). CONTRAINDICATED in asthma (blocks beta-2). Heart failure: start low, go slow — avoid rapid up-titration.
records.exam_trap_zh: 卡維地洛也阻斷α1受體（血管舒張 = 比純α1阻斷劑反射性心動過速少）。哮喘禁忌（阻斷β2）。心衰竭：從低劑量開始，緩慢滴定——避免快速增量。

records.site_of_action_en: Beta-adrenoreceptors (nonselective, via the S(-) enantiomer) and alpha1-adrenergic receptors (via both R(+) and S(-) enantiomers at equal potency)
records.site_of_action_zh: 乙型腎上腺素受體(非選擇性,由 S(-) 對映異構物負責)與甲型第一型腎上腺素受體(R(+) 與 S(-) 兩種對映異構物效價相當)
records.physiologic_effect_en: Combined nonselective beta-blockade and alpha1-blockade with no intrinsic sympathomimetic activity; in heart failure it significantly reduced systemic blood pressure, pulmonary artery pressure, right atrial pressure, systemic vascular resistance and heart rate, while stroke volume index increased
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 同時具非選擇性乙型阻斷與甲型第一型阻斷作用,且無內在擬交感活性;用於心衰竭時可明顯降低全身血壓、肺動脈壓、右心房壓、全身血管阻力與心率,而每搏輸出量指數上升

records.mechanism_en: Nonsteroidal competitive inhibitor of the aromatase enzyme system; inhibits conversion of androgens (androstenedione, testosterone) to estrogens (estrone, estradiol) by competitively binding the heme of the cytochrome P450 subunit of aromatase. Selectively inhibits gonadal steroidogenesis without significant effect on adrenal mineralocorticoid or glucocorticoid synthesis.
records.mechanism_zh: 非固醇類芳香酶競爭性抑制劑;經與芳香酶細胞色素 P450 次單元的血基質競爭結合,抑制雄性素(雄烯二酮、睪固酮)轉化為雌激素(雌酮、雌二醇)。選擇性抑制性腺類固醇生成,對腎上腺礦物皮質素或糖皮質素合成無顯著影響。
indications_en: FDA-approved: adjuvant treatment of postmenopausal women with hormone receptor-positive early breast cancer
FDA-approved: extended adjuvant treatment after prior standard adjuvant tamoxifen therapy
FDA-approved: first- and second-line treatment of postmenopausal women with hormone receptor-positive or unknown advanced breast cancer
indications_zh: FDA 核准:荷爾蒙受體陽性早期乳癌停經後婦女之輔助治療
FDA 核准:接受過標準 tamoxifen 輔助治療後之延長輔助治療

records.off_label_en: Ovulation induction / superovulation in fertility care (very common off-label use in reproductive endocrinology, including PCOS-related anovulation) is NOT an FDA-approved indication on this label. This label's entire efficacy and safety dataset is from postmenopausal breast-cancer populations, not reproductive-age fertility patients.
records.off_label_zh: 生殖醫學常用之誘導排卵/超排卵(含 PCOS 相關無排卵)為仿單外使用,本標籤並未核准此適應症。本標籤全部療效與安全性資料來自停經後乳癌族群,並非生育年齡不孕症患者族群。
contraindications_en: Known hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients
contraindications_zh: 孕婦(可能造成胎兒傷害)
對活性成分或任一賦形劑已知過敏
warnings_en: Decreases in bone mineral density may occur; consider BMD monitoring
Increases in total cholesterol may occur; consider cholesterol monitoring
Fatigue, dizziness, and somnolence may occur; caution with machinery
Embryo-fetal toxicity: obtain a pregnancy test in females of reproductive potential; advise effective contraception
warnings_zh: 可能發生骨密度下降;可考慮監測骨密度
可能發生總膽固醇上升;可考慮監測膽固醇
可能發生疲倦、頭暈、嗜睡;操作機械應謹慎
胚胎-胎兒毒性:對有生育能力之女性應先驗孕;建議採取有效避孕
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Contraindicated in pregnancy: based on post-marketing reports, animal data, and mechanism of action, letrozole can cause fetal harm (post-marketing reports of spontaneous abortion and congenital birth defects; animal studies show increased post-implantation loss, fewer live fetuses, and renal/skeletal malformations). Lactation: advise lactating women not to breastfeed during treatment and for at least 3 weeks after the last dose; unknown whether letrozole is present in human milk.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 孕期禁忌:根據上市後通報、動物試驗及作用機轉,萊翠唑可能造成胎兒傷害(上市後通報自發性流產與先天性缺陷;動物試驗顯示著床後胚胎流失增加、活產胎數減少及腎臟/骨骼畸形)。哺乳:建議哺乳婦女於治療期間及末次劑量後至少 3 週不哺乳;是否分泌至人乳尚不明。
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: 萊翠唑誘導排卵屬西醫生殖內分泌治療,與中醫「補腎助孕」等證型調理並非一對一對應;合併使用時應以西醫排卵監測(卵泡超音波、LH 高峰)為準,中醫介入定位為輔助調理,不取代生殖科追蹤。

warnings_en: dailymed:63e54b62-a30d-4a56-9215-75e7a0b0bf02#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS
drug_interactions_en: dailymed:63e54b62-a30d-4a56-9215-75e7a0b0bf02#DRUG_INTERACTIONS
Tamoxifen: co-administration reduced letrozole plasma levels by ~38% on average; clinical experience indicates therapeutic effect is not impaired if letrozole is given immediately after tamoxifen.
drug_interactions_zh: Tamoxifen:併用使letrozole 血漿濃度平均下降約 38%;臨床經驗顯示若在 tamoxifen 之後立即給予 letrozole,療效未受影響。

drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Reduces letrozole plasma levels by ~38% on average; clinical effect not impaired if letrozole given immediately after tamoxifen

records.herb_drug_interaction_note_zh: 本標籤 DRUG INTERACTIONS 段落僅記載與 tamoxifen 之交互作用,未指名任何中藥或植物藥。未查得即為未查得,不推論中藥安全或不安全。

records.site_of_action_en: Aromatase enzyme system in peripheral tissues, ovary, and estrogen-dependent tumor tissue
records.site_of_action_zh: 周邊組織、卵巢及雌激素依賴性腫瘤組織之芳香酶系統
records.physiologic_effect_en: Significantly lowers serum estrone, estradiol, and estrone sulfate; does not significantly affect adrenal corticosteroid, aldosterone, or thyroid hormone synthesis
records.physiologic_effect_zh: 顯著降低血清雌酮、雌二醇及硫酸雌酮;對腎上腺皮質類固醇、醛固酮或甲狀腺素合成無顯著影響

records.mechanism_en: Interacts with estrogen-receptor-containing tissues (hypothalamus, pituitary, ovary, endometrium, vagina, cervix), competing with estrogen for receptor-binding sites and delaying replenishment of intracellular estrogen receptors. Initiates a series of endocrine events culminating in a preovulatory gonadotropin surge and follicular rupture. Has mixed estrogenic and antiestrogenic properties; no apparent progestational, androgenic, or antiandrogenic effects, and does not appear to interfere with pituitary-adrenal or pituitary-thyroid function.
records.mechanism_zh: 與含雌激素受體之組織(下視丘、腦垂體、卵巢、子宮內膜、陰道、子宮頸)作用,與雌激素競爭受體結合位並延遲細胞內雌激素受體之再合成,啟動一系列內分泌事件而導致排卵前促性腺激素高峰及濾泡破裂。具混合型雌激素與抗雌激素性質;無明顯黃體素、雄性素或抗雄性素作用,亦未見干擾腦垂體-腎上腺或腦垂體-甲狀腺功能。
indications_en: FDA-approved: treatment of ovulatory dysfunction in women desiring pregnancy (PCOS, amenorrhea-galactorrhea syndrome, psychogenic amenorrhea, post-oral-contraceptive amenorrhea, certain secondary amenorrhea of undetermined etiology)
indications_zh: FDA 核准:有生育意願女性之排卵功能障礙治療(PCOS、閉經-泌乳症候群、心因性閉經、停服口服避孕藥後閉經、部分病因不明之續發性閉經)
records.off_label_en: Not indicated/effective for male infertility (label states no adequate/well-controlled studies demonstrate effectiveness, and notes reports of testicular tumors and gynecomastia in males using clomiphene; cause-and-effect not established). Not recommended for combined ovulation-induction regimens or IVF ovum-production protocols — label states no standard regimen exists and these uses are not recommended.
records.off_label_zh: 標籤敘明無充分對照試驗證實其對男性不孕症之療效,且有男性使用後睪丸腫瘤與男性女乳症之通報(因果關係未確立)。標籤亦敘明合併其他促排卵藥物或 IVF 取卵方案無標準用法,不建議此類使用。
adverse_effects_en: Visual symptoms (blurred vision, floaters, scotomata, photophobia)
adverse_effects_zh: 腹部/骨盆不適、脹感、腹脹
視覺症狀(視力模糊、飛蚊、暗點、畏光)
serious_adverse_effects_en: Ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS) — can progress rapidly, gross ovarian enlargement, ascites, dyspnea, oliguria, pleural effusion, hemoconcentration, thromboembolism, death reported
Multiple pregnancy (label reports ~8% incidence of multiple pregnancies in clinical trials)
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 卵巢過度刺激症候群(OHSS)——可能快速惡化,出現嚴重卵巢腫大、腹水、呼吸困難、少尿、肋膜積液、血液濃縮、血栓栓塞,並有死亡通報
持續性或不可逆之視覺障礙
多胞胎妊娠(標籤臨床試驗中多胞胎發生率約 8%)
contraindications_en: Hypersensitivity to clomiphene citrate or any ingredient
Liver disease or history of liver dysfunction
Abnormal uterine bleeding of undetermined origin
Ovarian cysts or enlargement not due to PCOS
Uncontrolled thyroid or adrenal dysfunction, or organic intracranial lesion (e.g. pituitary tumor)
contraindications_zh: 對可洛米分或任一成分過敏
孕婦(無助益,禁用)
肝病或肝功能不全病史
病因不明之異常子宮出血
非 PCOS 導致之卵巢囊腫或腫大
未控制之甲狀腺或腎上腺功能障礙,或器質性顱內病灶(如腦垂體腫瘤)
warnings_en: Visual symptoms (blurring, spots/flashes/scintillating scotomata) may occur, increase with dose/duration, and may be irreversible — discontinue and refer for complete ophthalmological evaluation if they occur
Ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS) — use lowest effective dose; PCOS patients especially sensitive and should start at lowest dose/shortest duration
Pelvic exam required before first and each subsequent treatment course
warnings_zh: 可能出現視覺症狀(視力模糊、閃光/閃爍暗點),隨劑量或療程延長而增加,可能不可逆——一旦出現應停藥並轉介完整眼科評估
卵巢過度刺激症候群(OHSS)——應使用最低有效劑量;PCOS 患者特別敏感,首次療程應由最低劑量、最短療程開始
首次及每次後續療程前均須進行骨盆檢查
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Contraindicated in pregnancy (offers no benefit in pregnant women). Available human data do not suggest increased risk of congenital anomalies above background population risk; however animal reproductive toxicology studies showed increased embryo-fetal loss and structural malformations. Long-term cyclic therapy not recommended beyond ~6 cycles.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 孕期禁忌(對孕婦無助益)。現有人體資料未顯示先天性異常風險高於一般族群背景風險;然而動物生殖毒理試驗顯示胚胎-胎兒流失與結構性畸形增加。不建議長期週期性治療超過約 6 個週期。
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: 可洛米分誘導排卵之機轉(阻斷雌激素負回饋)與中醫「腎陰虛」「肝鬱」等證型無一對一對應;患者若在服藥期間出現視覺症狀或劇烈腹脹痛,應立即轉介西醫評估 OHSS,不宜以症狀對應證型延誤處置。

records.mechanism_en: Antihyperglycemic agent that improves glucose tolerance, lowering both basal and postprandial plasma glucose. Decreases hepatic glucose production, decreases intestinal absorption of glucose, and improves insulin sensitivity by increasing peripheral glucose uptake and utilization. Insulin secretion remains unchanged while fasting and day-long plasma insulin response may decrease. Label does not name a single discrete molecular receptor target.
records.mechanism_zh: 抗高血糖藥物,可改善葡萄糖耐受性,降低空腹與飯後血糖。降低肝臟葡萄糖生成、減少腸道葡萄糖吸收,並藉由增加周邊葡萄糖攝取與利用來改善胰島素敏感性。胰島素分泌不受影響,但空腹及全天血漿胰島素反應可能下降。標籤未指名單一明確分子受體標的。
indications_en: FDA-approved: adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in type 2 diabetes mellitus (adults and pediatric patients 10 years and older)
indications_zh: FDA 核准:作為飲食與運動之輔助療法,改善第二型糖尿病(成人及 10 歲以上兒童)血糖控制
records.off_label_en: Widely used off-label in reproductive endocrinology for PCOS-related insulin resistance/ovulatory dysfunction and as an adjunct in fertility treatment — this is NOT an FDA-approved indication on this label; this label's safety data derive from the type 2 diabetes population.
records.off_label_zh: 生殖內分泌科廣泛仿單外使用於 PCOS 相關胰島素阻抗/排卵功能障礙及不孕症輔助治療——本標籤並未核准此適應症;本標籤安全性資料來自第二型糖尿病族群。
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 乳酸中毒(見黑框警語)
維生素 B12 缺乏
低血糖(併用胰島素/胰島素促泌劑時)
records.boxed_warning_en: Postmarketing cases of metformin-associated lactic acidosis have resulted in death, hypothermia, hypotension, and resistant bradyarrhythmias. Onset is often subtle with nonspecific symptoms (malaise, myalgias, respiratory distress, somnolence, abdominal pain). Risk factors: renal impairment, concomitant carbonic anhydrase inhibitors (e.g. topiramate), age ≥65, radiological contrast studies, surgery, hypoxic states, excessive alcohol intake, hepatic impairment, mitochondrial disease. If suspected, discontinue metformin immediately and institute supportive measures in a hospital setting; prompt hemodialysis is recommended.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 上市後通報顯示 metformin 相關乳酸中毒可能導致死亡、低體溫、低血壓及頑固性心搏過緩。起病常隱匿,伴非特異性症狀(倦怠、肌痛、呼吸窘迫、嗜睡、腹痛)。危險因子:腎功能不全、併用碳酸酐酶抑制劑(如 topiramate)、年齡 ≥65 歲、顯影劑檢查、手術、缺氧狀態、過量飲酒、肝功能不全、粒線體疾病。若懷疑發生,應立即停藥並於醫院內給予支持性治療;建議儘速血液透析。
contraindications_en: Acute or chronic metabolic acidosis, including diabetic ketoacidosis, with or without coma
contraindications_zh: 嚴重腎功能不全(eGFR 低於 30 mL/min/1.73m²)
對 metformin 過敏
急性或慢性代謝性酸中毒,包含糖尿病酮酸中毒(不論是否合併昏迷)
warnings_en: Lactic acidosis — see boxed warning
Vitamin B12 deficiency: measure hematological parameters annually and B12 at 2-3 year intervals
Hypoglycemia with concomitant insulin/insulin secretagogue use — lower dose of the other agent may be required
No conclusive evidence of macrovascular risk reduction from clinical studies
warnings_zh: 乳酸中毒——見黑框警語
維生素 B12 缺乏:建議每年測血液學參數,每 2-3 年測 B12
併用胰島素/胰島素促泌劑時之低血糖——可能需降低另一藥物劑量
臨床試驗尚無確切證據顯示可降低大血管疾病風險
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy: limited data insufficient to determine drug-associated risk for major birth defects or miscarriage; published studies have not reported a clear association. Risks to mother/fetus are associated with poorly-controlled diabetes itself. Lactation: metformin is present in human milk (infant dose ~0.11%-1% of maternal weight-adjusted dose); insufficient data on breastfed-infant effects — weigh developmental/health benefits of breastfeeding against maternal need.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 孕期:現有資料有限,不足以判定重大出生缺陷或流產之藥物相關風險;已發表研究未見明確關聯。孕期糖尿病控制不良本身即對母胎有風險。哺乳:metformin 會分泌至人乳(嬰兒劑量約為母體體重校正劑量之 0.11%-1%);對哺乳嬰兒影響資料不足——應權衡哺乳之發展/健康益處與母親用藥需求。
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: Metformin 用於 PCOS 之胰島素阻抗調理,與中醫「脾虛痰濕」「腎虛」等證型有部分機轉重疊(改善代謝),但不構成中西醫病名一對一等同;合併使用時應留意腹瀉等腸胃道不良反應是否與中藥方劑之瀉下/滑腸成分疊加。

warnings_en: dailymed:1e8136e0-cc98-41e4-ad4b-a8fc27fb4daa#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS
drug_interactions_en: dailymed:1e8136e0-cc98-41e4-ad4b-a8fc27fb4daa#DRUG_INTERACTIONS

records.overdose_en: Overdose (including ingestion >50g) has occurred; hypoglycemia in ~10% of cases (causal link not established); lactic acidosis reported in ~32% of overdose cases. Metformin is dialyzable (clearance up to 170 mL/min); hemodialysis may be useful for drug removal.
drug_interactions_en: Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors (topiramate, zonisamide, acetazolamide, dichlorphenamide): may increase risk of lactic acidosis
Drugs reducing metformin clearance (OCT2/MATE inhibitors — ranolazine, vandetanib, dolutegravir, cimetidine): may increase metformin exposure and lactic acidosis risk
Alcohol: potentiates effect of metformin on lactate metabolism
Insulin secretagogues or insulin: increased hypoglycemia risk

Drugs affecting glycemic control (thiazides/diuretics, corticosteroids, phenothiazines, thyroid products, estrogens, oral contraceptives, phenytoin, nicotinic acid, sympathomimetics, calcium channel blockers, isoniazid): may cause hyper- or hypoglycemia when added/withdrawn
drug_interactions_zh: 碳酸酐酶抑制劑(topiramate、zonisamide、acetazolamide、dichlorphenamide):可能增加乳酸中毒風險
降低 metformin 清除率之藥物(OCT2/MATE 抑制劑——ranolazine、vandetanib、dolutegravir、cimetidine):可能增加 metformin 暴露量與乳酸中毒風險
酒精:加強 metformin 對乳酸代謝之作用
胰島素促泌劑或胰島素:增加低血糖風險
影響血糖控制之藥物(thiazide/利尿劑、皮質類固醇、phenothiazine、甲狀腺製劑、雌激素、口服避孕藥、phenytoin、菸鹼酸、擬交感神經藥、鈣離子通道阻斷劑、isoniazid):加入或停用時可能造成高血糖或低血糖

drug_interactions_graded.with_label_en: Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors (topiramate, zonisamide, acetazolamide, dichlorphenamide)
drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: May increase risk of lactic acidosis via metabolic acidosis
drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 可能透過代謝性酸中毒增加乳酸中毒風險

drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Potentiates effect of metformin on lactate metabolism, increasing lactic acidosis risk
drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 加強 metformin 對乳酸代謝之作用,增加乳酸中毒風險

records.herb_drug_interaction_note_zh: 本標籤 DRUG INTERACTIONS 段落未指名任何中藥或植物藥。未查得即為未查得,不推論已排除;PCOS 常用中藥複方併用 metformin 之交互作用需另查 NCCIH 或原始文獻。

records.mechanism_en: Oral dosage form of micronized progesterone which is chemically identical to progesterone of ovarian origin (synthesized from a plant source). Micronization increases oral bioavailability. This label's CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY section does not itself elaborate receptor-level mechanism.
records.mechanism_zh: 微粒化黃體素之口服劑型,化學結構與卵巢來源之黃體素相同(自植物來源合成)。微粒化可提升口服生體可用率。本標籤 CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY 段落本身未闡述受體層級機轉。
indications_en: FDA-approved (this label): prevention of endometrial hyperplasia in nonhysterectomized postmenopausal women receiving conjugated estrogens
FDA-approved (this label): secondary amenorrhea
indications_zh: 本標籤核准適應症:未切除子宮之停經後婦女接受結合型雌激素治療時,預防子宮內膜增生
本標籤核准適應症:續發性閉經
records.off_label_en: This clinic's most common use of oral micronized progesterone — luteal-phase support and early-pregnancy support in ART/IVF cycles — is NOT covered by this label. This label's own CONTRAINDICATIONS section lists 'known or suspected pregnancy' as a contraindication and its efficacy/safety data derive entirely from postmenopausal HRT and secondary-amenorrhea populations. This reflects that pregnancy has no role in THIS label's approved (non-pregnancy) indications — it is not a safety statement against the well-established practice of luteal-phase/early-pregnancy progesterone support in reproductive endocrinology, which relies on a separate ART/fertility evidence base this label does not address. Do not extrapolate this label's pregnancy contraindication to counsel against fertility-context use without checking ART-specific literature.
records.off_label_zh: 本診所最常見的口服微粒化黃體素用法——ART/IVF 週期黃體期支持與早期妊娠支持——本標籤並未涵蓋。本標籤 CONTRAINDICATIONS 段落將「已知或疑似懷孕」列為禁忌,其療效/安全性資料完全來自停經後 HRT 與續發性閉經族群。這反映的是懷孕與本標籤核准之(非孕期)適應症無關,並非針對生殖內分泌科黃體期/早期妊娠黃體素支持這項成熟臨床實務的安全性聲明——後者仰賴本標籤未處理的 ART/生殖醫學獨立實證。不可將本標籤之孕期禁忌直接外推為反對生殖科用法,須另查 ART 專屬文獻。
serious_adverse_effects_en: Breast carcinoma (reported at low rate in the postmenopausal HRT trial population)
Cardiovascular/thromboembolic events (as part of estrogen+progestin combination therapy — see boxed warning)
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 乳癌(停經後 HRT 試驗族群中低發生率通報)
心血管/血栓栓塞事件(屬雌激素+黃體素併用治療之一部分——見黑框警語)
records.boxed_warning_en: WARNING: CARDIOVASCULAR DISORDERS, BREAST CANCER, AND PROBABLE DEMENTIA FOR ESTROGEN PLUS PROGESTIN THERAPY. Applies specifically to this label's postmenopausal estrogen+progestin HRT indication (this drug given cyclically WITH conjugated estrogens). The WHI estrogen-plus-progestin substudy reported increased risk of DVT, pulmonary embolism, stroke, and MI in postmenopausal women (age 50-79) over 5.6 years of CE+MPA therapy vs. placebo. WHIMS reported increased probable dementia risk in women ≥65 over 4 years. WHI also reported increased invasive breast cancer risk. Estrogen plus progestin should not be used for prevention of cardiovascular disease or dementia.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 黑框警語:雌激素併用黃體素治療之心血管疾病、乳癌與可能失智症風險。此警語特別針對本標籤停經後雌激素+黃體素 HRT 適應症(本藥與結合型雌激素週期性併用之情境)。WHI 雌激素併黃體素次研究顯示,50-79 歲停經後婦女接受 CE+MPA 治療 5.6 年,深部靜脈栓塞、肺栓塞、中風及心肌梗塞風險較安慰劑組增加。WHIMS 顯示 65 歲以上婦女治療 4 年後可能失智症風險增加。WHI 亦顯示侵襲性乳癌風險增加。雌激素併黃體素不應用於預防心血管疾病或失智症。
contraindications_en: Known hypersensitivity to its ingredients — contains peanut oil, never use in patients allergic to peanuts
Known, suspected, or history of breast cancer
Active deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, or history of these conditions
Active arterial thromboembolic disease (e.g. stroke, MI), or history of these conditions
Known or suspected pregnancy (this label's approved, non-pregnancy indications — see off_label note re: ART/fertility use)
contraindications_zh: 對其成分已知過敏——含花生油,對花生過敏者絕對禁用
病因不明之異常生殖器出血
已知、疑似或有乳癌病史
活動性深部靜脈栓塞、肺栓塞或此類病史
活動性動脈血栓栓塞疾病(如中風、心肌梗塞)或此類病史
已知肝功能不全或肝病
已知或疑似懷孕(此為本標籤核准之非孕期適應症所致——ART/生殖科用法之落差見 off_label 說明)
warnings_en: See boxed warning (cardiovascular, breast cancer, probable dementia — estrogen+progestin combination context)
Fluid retention — caution in cardiac or renal dysfunction
Dizziness and drowsiness — caution driving/operating machinery; take as single bedtime dose
warnings_zh: 見黑框警語(心血管、乳癌、可能失智症——雌激素+黃體素併用情境)
體液滯留——心臟或腎臟功能不全者應謹慎
頭暈與嗜睡——駕駛或操作機械應謹慎;建議睡前單次服用
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: This label states progesterone capsules should not be used during pregnancy (see contraindications) and classifies as Pregnancy Category B based on older reproductive studies in mice, rats, rabbits, guinea pigs, and rhesus monkeys showing little or no evidence of impaired fertility or fetal harm. See off_label_en for the critical distinction between this label's non-pregnancy indications and the separate, well-established ART/luteal-support evidence base.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 本標籤敘明黃體素膠囊不應於孕期使用(見禁忌),並依較舊制度列為妊娠分類 B,依據小鼠、大鼠、兔、天竺鼠及恆河猴之生殖試驗顯示幾無生育能力受損或胎兒傷害證據。本標籤非孕期適應症與 ART 黃體期支持之獨立成熟實證間的關鍵區別,見 off_label_en 說明。
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: ART 黃體期黃體素支持與中醫「補腎固胎」「安胎」等概念在臨床目的上有交集,但不構成一對一等同;中藥安胎方劑併用時應留意頭暈嗜睡之疊加效應,並確認西醫黃體支持追蹤(血中黃體素濃度)未受中斷。

records.overdose_en: No studies on overdosage have been conducted in humans; discontinue and treat symptomatically.
records.herb_drug_interaction_note_zh: 本標籤未列 DRUG INTERACTIONS 段落,亦未指名任何中藥或植物藥。未查得即為未查得,不推論已排除。
records.gap_note_zh: 本卡為診所常用頻率擴充新建(原方劑課程未涵蓋)。這是本批 CRITICAL 落差最大的一張卡——標籤禁忌孕期,診所卻常用於黃體期/早期妊娠支持,已在 off_label_en/zh 與 contraindications 逐項標註,務必讓臨床使用者看到此區別,避免誤讀「孕期禁忌」為反對 ART 用法的安全訊號。

records.mechanism_en: Estradiol is the principal, most potent intracellular human estrogen; endogenous estrogens are largely responsible for development/maintenance of the female reproductive system and secondary sexual characteristics. Acts via binding to nuclear estrogen receptors (two subtypes identified) in estrogen-responsive tissues; modulates pituitary secretion of LH and FSH through negative feedback.
records.mechanism_zh: 雌二醇為人體最主要、活性最強的細胞內雌激素;內生性雌激素主要負責女性生殖系統與第二性徵之發育與維持。作用機轉為結合雌激素反應性組織之細胞核雌激素受體(已知兩種亞型);透過負回饋調節腦垂體 LH 與 FSH 之分泌。
indications_en: FDA-approved (this label): moderate-to-severe vasomotor symptoms of menopause
FDA-approved (this label): moderate-to-severe vulvar and vaginal atrophy of menopause
FDA-approved (this label): hypoestrogenism due to hypogonadism, castration, or primary ovarian failure
FDA-approved (this label): palliative treatment of breast cancer (metastatic) and androgen-dependent prostate cancer
FDA-approved (this label): prevention of postmenopausal osteoporosis (selected patients)
indications_zh: 本標籤核准適應症:中重度更年期血管舒縮症狀
本標籤核准適應症:中重度更年期外陰陰道萎縮
本標籤核准適應症:性腺功能低下、去勢或原發性卵巢衰竭所致之低雌激素狀態
本標籤核准適應症:轉移性乳癌與雄性素依賴性攝護腺癌之緩和治療
本標籤核准適應症:停經後骨質疏鬆預防(特定患者)
records.off_label_en: Endometrial priming for frozen embryo transfer (FET) and other ART protocols — a core use of oral estradiol in this clinic's fertility workflow — is NOT covered by this label. This label's Pregnancy Category X / 'known or suspected pregnancy is contraindicated' language reflects its menopausal-HRT indications (where pregnancy is not a relevant clinical state to begin with), not a safety judgment against the ART practice of continuing estradiol support into early pregnancy under reproductive-endocrinology protocols. Do not extrapolate this label's pregnancy contraindication to counsel against ART use without checking ART-specific literature.
records.off_label_zh: 凍胚植入(FET)及其他 ART 方案之子宮內膜準備——本診所生殖科工作流程中口服雌二醇之核心用途——本標籤並未涵蓋。本標籤之妊娠分類 X /「已知或疑似懷孕為禁忌」文字,反映的是其更年期 HRT 適應症本身與懷孕無關(而非相關臨床狀態),並非針對生殖內分泌科方案中持續使用雌二醇支持早期妊娠此一 ART 實務的安全性判斷。不可將本標籤之孕期禁忌直接外推為反對 ART 用法,須另查 ART 專屬文獻。
adverse_effects_en: Vaginal bleeding pattern changes, breakthrough bleeding, spotting
Breast tenderness, enlargement, pain, nipple discharge
Edema, weight change, changes in libido
adverse_effects_zh: 陰道出血型態改變、突破性出血、點狀出血
乳房脹痛、增大、疼痛、乳頭分泌物
噁心、嘔吐、腹部絞痛、腹脹
肝斑/黃褐斑(停藥後可能持續)
水腫、體重改變、性慾改變
serious_adverse_effects_en: Endometrial cancer (unopposed estrogen with intact uterus — see boxed warning)
Deep/superficial venous thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, myocardial infarction, stroke
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 子宮內膜癌(有子宮且單用雌激素——見黑框警語)
深部/淺部靜脈栓塞、肺栓塞、心肌梗塞、中風
需手術之膽囊疾病
視網膜血管栓塞
records.boxed_warning_en: ESTROGENS INCREASE THE RISK OF ENDOMETRIAL CANCER — close clinical surveillance important; adequate diagnostic measures (including endometrial sampling) should rule out malignancy in undiagnosed persistent/recurring abnormal vaginal bleeding. CARDIOVASCULAR AND OTHER RISKS — estrogens with or without progestins should not be used for prevention of cardiovascular disease. WHI reported increased MI, stroke, invasive breast cancer, pulmonary emboli, and DVT with oral CE+MPA over 5 years vs. placebo. WHIMS reported increased probable dementia in women ≥65 with CE+MPA over 4 years.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 黑框警語:雌激素增加子宮內膜癌風險——應密切臨床監測;未確診之持續性或反覆性異常陰道出血,應以適當診斷措施(含子宮內膜採樣)排除惡性腫瘤。心血管及其他風險——雌激素(併用或不併用黃體素)不應用於預防心血管疾病。WHI 顯示口服 CE+MPA 治療 5 年,較安慰劑組增加心肌梗塞、中風、侵襲性乳癌、肺栓塞及深部靜脈栓塞風險。WHIMS 顯示 65 歲以上婦女接受 CE+MPA 治療 4 年,可能失智症風險增加。
contraindications_en: Known, suspected, or history of breast cancer (except appropriately selected metastatic-disease patients)
Active DVT, pulmonary embolism, or history of these conditions
Active or recent (within ~1 year) arterial thromboembolic disease (stroke, MI)
Known or suspected pregnancy (this label's approved, non-pregnancy indications — see off_label note re: ART use)
contraindications_zh: 病因不明之異常生殖器出血
已知、疑似或有乳癌病史(適當篩選之轉移性疾病患者除外)
已知或疑似雌激素依賴性腫瘤
活動性深部靜脈栓塞、肺栓塞或此類病史
活動性或近期(約 1 年內)動脈血栓栓塞疾病(中風、心肌梗塞)
肝功能不全或肝病
對成分已知過敏
已知或疑似懷孕(此為本標籤核准之非孕期適應症所致——ART 用法之落差見 off_label 說明)
warnings_en: See boxed warnings (endometrial cancer, cardiovascular, probable dementia)
warnings_zh: 見黑框警語(子宮內膜癌、心血管、可能失智症)
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: This label classifies estradiol as Pregnancy Category X: 'should not be used during pregnancy' (see contraindications). Label separately notes little or no increased risk of birth defects has been observed in children born to women who inadvertently used estrogens/progestins from oral contraceptives in early pregnancy. See off_label_en for the critical distinction between this label's non-pregnancy menopausal indications and the separate ART/FET evidence base.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 本標籤將雌二醇列為妊娠分類 X:「不應於孕期使用」(見禁忌)。標籤另指出,早期妊娠時不慎使用口服避孕藥中雌激素/黃體素之產婦,其子女先天缺陷風險未見明顯增加。本標籤非孕期更年期適應症與 ART/FET 獨立實證間的關鍵區別,見 off_label_en 說明。
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: FET 週期雌二醇子宮內膜準備與中醫「補腎填精」「滋陰養血」等概念在臨床目的上有交集,但不構成一對一等同;合併中藥時應留意標籤所列 CYP3A4 交互作用(見 drug_interactions),避免植物藥誘導/抑制 CYP3A4 而改變雌二醇濃度。

records.overdose_en: Serious ill effects have not been reported following acute ingestion of large doses of estrogen-containing oral contraceptives by young children; overdosage may cause nausea/vomiting and withdrawal bleeding in females.
drug_interactions_en: CYP3A4 inducers (St. John's Wort/Hypericum perforatum, phenobarbital, carbamazepine, rifampin): may reduce plasma estrogen concentrations, decreasing therapeutic effect and/or altering bleeding profile
CYP3A4 inhibitors (erythromycin, clarithromycin, ketoconazole, itraconazole, ritonavir, grapefruit juice): may increase plasma estrogen concentrations and side effects
Thyroid replacement therapy: estrogen increases thyroid-binding globulin, may require higher thyroid hormone doses
drug_interactions_zh: CYP3A4 誘導劑(聖約翰草/貫葉連翹、phenobarbital、carbamazepine、rifampin):可能降低雌激素血中濃度,減弱療效及/或改變出血型態
CYP3A4 抑制劑(erythromycin、clarithromycin、ketoconazole、itraconazole、ritonavir、葡萄柚汁):可能增加雌激素血中濃度及副作用
甲狀腺補充治療:雌激素會增加甲狀腺結合球蛋白,可能需提高甲狀腺素劑量

drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: CYP3A4 induction may reduce plasma estrogen concentrations, decreasing therapeutic effect and/or altering uterine bleeding profile
drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 誘導 CYP3A4 可能降低雌激素血中濃度,減弱療效及/或改變子宮出血型態

herb_drug_interactions_graded.effect_en: Named in the estradiol label as a CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce plasma estrogen concentrations
herb_drug_interactions_graded.effect_zh: 標籤指名為 CYP3A4 誘導劑,可能降低雌激素血中濃度

records.herb_drug_interaction_note_zh: 標籤在 CYP3A4 段落指名聖約翰草(西藥草,非中藥),藥庫目前無此卡;中藥複方是否含 CYP3A4 誘導/抑制成分需個別查證,不可從本欄推論。
records.gap_note_zh: 本卡為診所常用頻率擴充新建(原方劑課程未涵蓋)。落差同 progesterone:標籤孕期禁忌(Category X)針對非孕期 HRT 適應症,ART/FET 子宮內膜準備用法未被涵蓋,已於 off_label_en/zh 詳述,避免誤讀。

records.mechanism_en: GABA-A receptor positive modulator of the imidazopyridine class, presumed to exert therapeutic effects through binding to the benzodiazepine site of alpha-1 subunit-containing GABA-A receptors, increasing the frequency of chloride channel opening and inhibiting neuronal excitation.
records.mechanism_zh: 咪唑吡啶類 GABA-A 受體正向調節劑,推定藉由結合含 alpha-1 次單元 GABA-A 受體之苯二氮平結合位而發揮療效,增加氯離子通道開啟頻率,抑制神經元興奮。
indications_en: FDA-approved: short-term treatment of insomnia characterized by difficulty with sleep initiation (shown to decrease sleep latency for up to 35 days in controlled trials)
indications_zh: FDA 核准:短期治療以入睡困難為特徵之失眠(對照試驗顯示可縮短入睡潛伏期達 35 天)
serious_adverse_effects_en: Complex sleep behaviors (sleep-walking, sleep-driving, other activities while not fully awake) — see boxed warning
Abnormal thinking/behavioral changes (decreased inhibition, bizarre behavior, agitation, depersonalization)
Worsening depression or emergence of suicidal thinking
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 複雜睡眠行為(夢遊、夢中駕駛、未完全清醒時之其他活動)——見黑框警語
嚴重過敏性/類過敏反應(血管性水腫、過敏性休克)
異常思考/行為改變(抑制力下降、怪異行為、躁動、去人格化)
憂鬱惡化或出現自殺意念
呼吸抑制
records.boxed_warning_en: Complex sleep behaviors including sleep-walking, sleep-driving, and engaging in other activities while not fully awake may occur following use of zolpidem. Some of these events may result in serious injuries, including death. Discontinue zolpidem immediately if a patient experiences a complex sleep behavior.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 使用唑吡坦後可能出現複雜睡眠行為,包含夢遊、夢中駕駛及未完全清醒時之其他活動。部分事件可能導致重大傷害,包含死亡。若病人出現複雜睡眠行為應立即停藥。
contraindications_en: Patients who have experienced complex sleep behaviors after taking zolpidem
Known hypersensitivity to zolpidem (observed reactions include anaphylaxis and angioedema)
contraindications_zh: 曾於服用唑吡坦後出現複雜睡眠行為之病人
對唑吡坦已知過敏(曾見反應包含過敏性休克及血管性水腫)
warnings_en: CNS-depressant effects — risk of next-day impairment; increases with dose and with other CNS depressants/alcohol
Reevaluate if insomnia persists after 7-10 days (possible comorbid diagnosis)
Severe anaphylactic/anaphylactoid reactions — do not rechallenge
Abnormal thinking and behavioral changes — evaluate any new-onset behavioral change immediately
Depression — may worsen; prescribe least amount of tablets feasible
Respiratory depression risk in compromised respiratory function
Avoid in severe hepatic impairment
Withdrawal effects may occur with rapid dose reduction/discontinuation
warnings_zh: 中樞神經抑制效應——有隔日功能受損風險;隨劑量及併用其他中樞抑制劑/酒精而增加
失眠若持續 7-10 天以上應重新評估(可能有共病診斷)
嚴重過敏性/類過敏反應——不應再次嘗試投藥
異常思考與行為改變——新發生之行為改變應立即評估
憂鬱——可能惡化;應開立可行之最少藥量
呼吸功能不全者有呼吸抑制風險
嚴重肝功能不全者應避免使用
快速減量或停藥可能出現戒斷效應
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy: neonates born to mothers using zolpidem late in the third trimester have been reported to experience respiratory depression and sedation; published data have not reported a clear association with major birth defects; monitor neonates exposed during pregnancy/labor. Lactation: a lactating woman may pump and discard breast milk during treatment and for 23 hours after the dose.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 孕期:第三孕期後期使用唑吡坦之產婦,其新生兒曾通報出現呼吸抑制與鎮靜;已發表資料未見與重大先天缺陷有明確關聯;孕期/生產時暴露之新生兒應監測。哺乳:哺乳婦女可於治療期間及服藥後 23 小時內擠出並丟棄乳汁。

records.boxed_warning_en: WARNING: RISKS FROM CONCOMITANT USE WITH OPIOIDS; ABUSE, MISUSE, AND ADDICTION; DEPENDENCE AND WITHDRAWAL REACTIONS. Concomitant benzodiazepine+opioid use may result in profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death — reserve for patients without adequate alternatives, limit dose/duration. Benzodiazepine use exposes patients to risk of abuse, misuse, addiction, which can lead to overdose or death — assess risk before and throughout treatment. Continued use may lead to clinically significant physical dependence; abrupt discontinuation or rapid dose reduction may precipitate acute, life-threatening withdrawal reactions — use gradual taper.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 黑框警語:併用鴉片類藥物之風險;濫用、誤用及成癮;依賴及戒斷反應。苯二氮平併用鴉片類藥物可能導致嚴重鎮靜、呼吸抑制、昏迷及死亡——僅於無其他適當替代治療時使用,並限制劑量與療程。苯二氮平之使用使病人暴露於濫用、誤用及成癮風險,可能導致過量用藥或死亡——治療前及治療期間均應評估風險。持續使用可能導致臨床顯著之身體依賴;驟然停藥或快速減量可能引發急性、危及生命之戒斷反應——應採漸進減量。

records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy: exposure to SSRIs, particularly in the month before delivery, associated with less than 2-fold increase in postpartum hemorrhage risk; published epidemiologic studies of first-trimester exposure suggest no difference in major birth defect risk vs. background rate, though some studies report increases for specific defects (inconclusive). Third-trimester exposure has clinical considerations for neonates. Lactation: published data demonstrate low levels of sertraline/metabolites in human milk (~2% of maternal serum level in one pooled analysis); no adverse reactions observed in studied infants.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 孕期:暴露於 SSRI(尤其產前一個月)與產後大出血風險增加不到 2 倍相關;已發表流行病學研究顯示第一孕期暴露之重大先天缺陷風險與背景值無差異,惟部分研究顯示特定缺陷增加(尚無定論)。第三孕期暴露對新生兒有臨床注意事項。哺乳:已發表資料顯示人乳中舍曲林/代謝物濃度低(一項匯總分析約為母體血清濃度之 2%);研究中之嬰兒未見不良反應。

records.tcm_relation_note_zh: SSRI 治療之憂鬱/焦慮症狀與中醫「肝鬱」「心脾兩虛」等證型有部分症狀重疊,但不構成一對一等同;血清素症候群、自殺意念惡化等安全訊號應立即轉介西醫,不宜以證型延誤處置。

records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Pregnancy Exposure Registry available for antidepressants. Exposure to SSRIs, particularly in the month before delivery, has been associated with a less than 2-fold increase in postpartum hemorrhage risk. Available published epidemiologic/postmarketing data have not established an increased risk of major birth defects or miscarriage. Risks of persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN) and poor neonatal adaptation with SSRI (including escitalopram) exposure during pregnancy. Animal reproduction studies of escitalopram and racemic citalopram showed adverse embryo/fetal and postnatal developmental effects (including fetal structural abnormalities) at doses greater than human therapeutic doses. Untreated depression itself carries maternal/fetal risk (relapse more likely if antidepressants discontinued in pregnancy).

records.mechanism_en: Triazolopyridine derivative; label describes it as both a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor and a 5HT2 receptor antagonist. The mechanism of trazodone's antidepressant action is not fully understood; the net result of this dual action on serotonergic transmission and its role in the antidepressant effect is unknown per the label.

records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Published prospective cohort studies, case series, and case reports over several decades of trazodone use in pregnant women have not identified drug-associated risks of major birth defects, miscarriage, or adverse maternal/fetal outcomes. Animal studies (rat, rabbit) showed increased fetal resorption/congenital anomalies only at high multiples (~7-22x) of the maximum recommended human dose. Pregnancy exposure registry available for antidepressants.

records.overdose_en: Death from overdose has occurred, typically with concurrent CNS depressants (alcohol, chloral hydrate, diazepam, amobarbital, chlordiazepoxide, meprobamate). Most severe reported reactions with trazodone alone: priapism, respiratory arrest, seizures, ECG changes (QT prolongation), SIADH. No specific antidote; consider multiple-drug involvement.
drug_interactions_en: MAOIs (including linezolid, IV methylene blue): contraindicated — serotonin syndrome risk
Other serotonergic drugs (triptans, TCAs/SSRIs, fentanyl, lithium, tramadol, tryptophan, buspirone, St. John's Wort): increased serotonin syndrome risk
Antiplatelet agents and anticoagulants: may potentiate bleeding risk (serotonin release by platelets plays a role in hemostasis)
CNS depressants: trazodone may enhance effects of alcohol, barbiturates, other CNS depressants
CYP3A4 inhibitors: consider trazodone dose reduction
CYP3A4 inducers: may need trazodone dose increase
Digoxin or phenytoin: monitor for increased serum levels
Warfarin: monitor for altered prothrombin time
drug_interactions_zh: MAOI(含 linezolid、靜脈注射 methylene blue):禁忌併用——血清素症候群風險
其他血清素藥物(triptan、三環/SSRI 抗憂鬱藥、fentanyl、鋰鹽、tramadol、色胺酸、buspirone、聖約翰草):血清素症候群風險增加
抗血小板藥與抗凝血劑:可能加強出血風險(血小板釋放之血清素在止血中扮演角色)
中樞神經抑制劑:曲唑酮可能增強酒精、巴比妥類及其他中樞抑制劑之效果
CYP3A4 抑制劑:應考慮降低曲唑酮劑量
CYP3A4 誘導劑:可能需提高曲唑酮劑量
Digoxin 或 phenytoin:應監測血中濃度是否升高
Warfarin:應監測凝血酶原時間變化

records.mechanism_en: NSAID with analgesic and antipyretic activity; mode of action, like other NSAIDs, not completely understood but may be related to prostaglandin synthetase inhibition. In rheumatoid arthritis/osteoarthritis studies, comparable to aspirin in controlling pain/inflammation with statistically significant reduction in milder GI side effects.

records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Use of NSAIDs, including ibuprofen, can cause premature closure of the fetal ductus arteriosus and fetal renal dysfunction leading to oligohydramnios and, in some cases, neonatal renal impairment. Limit dose/duration between about 20 and 30 weeks gestation; avoid use at about 30 weeks gestation and later. First/second-trimester observational data on other embryofetal risks are inconclusive; animal data show prostaglandin synthesis inhibitors can increase pre/post-implantation loss.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: NSAID(含布洛芬)可能造成胎兒動脈導管早閉及胎兒腎功能異常,導致羊水過少,部分病例併發新生兒腎功能損傷。妊娠約 20 至 30 週間應限制劑量與療程;妊娠約 30 週起及之後應避免使用。第一/第二孕期其他胚胎-胎兒風險之觀察性資料尚無定論;動物資料顯示前列腺素合成抑制劑可能增加著床前後之胚胎流失。
records.acupuncture_note_zh: NSAID 抑制血小板功能,標籤本身雖未針對針刺給出數據,但出血/瘀傷風險與抗凝血劑併列討論(見 warfarin 卡片交互作用),臨床上長期或高劑量使用 NSAID 之患者接受侵入性針刺、放血或拔罐前應評估出血傾向。
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: NSAID 消炎止痛之目的與中醫「活血化瘀」「清熱消腫」等治法有部分交集,但不構成一對一等同;妊娠中後期 NSAID 之胎兒風險為西醫明確禁忌,中醫止痛方劑併用時應留意不可取代此安全考量。

records.mechanism_en: Relieves skeletal muscle spasm of local origin without interfering with muscle function; ineffective in muscle spasm due to CNS disease. Animal studies indicate cyclobenzaprine does not act at the neuromuscular junction or directly on skeletal muscle, but acts primarily within the CNS at brain stem (vs. spinal cord) levels, reducing tonic somatic motor activity via both gamma and alpha motor systems. Structurally related to tricyclic antidepressants, sharing reserpine antagonism, norepinephrine potentiation, potent central/peripheral anticholinergic effects, and sedation.
records.mechanism_zh: 緩解局部性骨骼肌痙攣,不干擾肌肉功能;對中樞神經系統疾病所致之肌肉痙攣無效。動物試驗顯示環苯扎林並非作用於神經肌肉接合處或直接作用於骨骼肌,而是主要在中樞神經系統腦幹層級(相對脊髓層級)發揮作用,透過 gamma 與 alpha 運動系統降低張力性軀體運動活性。結構上與三環抗憂鬱藥相關,具類似之利血平拮抗、正腎上腺素增強、強效中樞/周邊抗膽鹼效應及鎮靜作用。
indications_en: FDA-approved: adjunct to rest and physical therapy for relief of muscle spasm associated with acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions (short-term use, up to 2-3 weeks)
indications_zh: FDA 核准:作為休息與物理治療之輔助,緩解急性疼痛性肌肉骨骼病症相關之肌肉痙攣(短期使用,至多 2-3 週)
records.off_label_en: Label explicitly states cyclobenzaprine has NOT been found effective in spasticity associated with cerebral or spinal cord disease, or in children with cerebral palsy — do not extrapolate to these conditions.
records.off_label_zh: 標籤明確敘明環苯扎林對腦部或脊髓疾病所致之痙攣性肌張力異常,以及腦性麻痺兒童,均未證實有效——不應外推使用於這些情況。
serious_adverse_effects_en: Serotonin syndrome (with SSRIs, SNRIs, TCAs, tramadol, bupropion, meperidine, verapamil, or MAOIs)

併用 MAOI 或停用未滿 14 天(曾有高熱危象、癲癇發作、死亡通報)

records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Older Pregnancy Category B classification: reproduction studies in rats, mice, and rabbits at doses up to 20x human dose revealed no evidence of impaired fertility or fetal harm; however, no adequate/well-controlled studies in pregnant women — use during pregnancy only if clearly needed.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 採用較舊之妊娠分類 B:大鼠、小鼠及兔之生殖試驗於人體劑量 20 倍以下未顯示生育能力受損或胎兒傷害證據;然而尚無孕婦之充分對照試驗——僅於確有需要時於孕期使用。
records.acupuncture_note_zh: 環苯扎林具中樞鎮靜效應,理論上與電針/放鬆反應之鎮靜效應可能疊加;標籤未針對針刺給出具體交互作用數據,不自行設定門檻。
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: 環苯扎林治療急性肌肉痙攣與中醫「筋脈拘急」「風寒濕痹」等證型有部分症狀重疊,但不構成一對一等同;血清素症候群與 MAOI 交互作用屬西醫明確安全議題,應主動詢問患者是否服用抗憂鬱藥。

records.overdose_en: Most common effects: drowsiness and tachycardia. Less frequent: tremor, agitation, coma, ataxia, hypertension, slurred speech, confusion, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, hallucinations. Rare but critical: cardiac arrest, chest pain, cardiac dysrhythmias, severe hypotension, seizures, neuroleptic malignant syndrome. QRS widening on ECG is a clinically significant toxicity indicator; contact poison control center for management.
drug_interactions_en: MAOIs: life-threatening interactions — see contraindications
SSRIs, SNRIs, TCAs, tramadol, bupropion, meperidine, verapamil: postmarketing serotonin syndrome reports
Alcohol, barbiturates, other CNS depressants: cyclobenzaprine may enhance effects
Guanethidine-type antihypertensives: TCA-class action may block antihypertensive effect
Tramadol: may enhance seizure risk
drug_interactions_zh: MAOI:可能致命之交互作用——見禁忌

guanethidine 類降血壓藥:三環類作用可能阻斷其降血壓效果
Tramadol:可能增加癲癇發作風險

records.boxed_warning_en: WARNING: RISK OF SERIOUS CARDIOVASCULAR AND GASTROINTESTINAL EVENTS. NSAIDs, including celecoxib, cause increased risk of serious CV thrombotic events (MI, stroke), which can be fatal; risk may occur early and increase with duration of use; celecoxib is contraindicated in setting of CABG surgery. NSAIDs cause increased risk of serious GI adverse events including bleeding, ulceration, and perforation, which can be fatal; can occur at any time without warning symptoms; elderly and prior peptic ulcer/GI bleeding history at greater risk.
records.boxed_warning_zh: 黑框警語:嚴重心血管與腸胃事件風險。NSAID(含塞來昔布)增加嚴重心血管血栓事件(心肌梗塞、中風)風險,可能致命;風險可能於治療早期即出現並隨療程延長增加;塞來昔布於冠狀動脈繞道手術情境下禁用。NSAID 增加嚴重腸胃不良事件風險,包含出血、潰瘍、穿孔,可能致命,可於任何時間點無預警發生;老年患者及有消化性潰瘍/腸胃出血病史者風險較高。
contraindications_en: Known hypersensitivity (anaphylactic reactions, serious skin reactions) to celecoxib or any component

records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Use of NSAIDs, including celecoxib, can cause premature closure of the fetal ductus arteriosus and fetal renal dysfunction leading to oligohydramnios and, in some cases, neonatal renal impairment. Limit dose/duration between about 20 and 30 weeks gestation; avoid use at about 30 weeks gestation and later. Lactation: limited data from 3 published reports (12 breastfeeding women) showed low levels of celecoxib in breast milk (calculated average infant dose 10-40 mcg/kg/day, <1% of weight-based therapeutic dose for a 2-year-old).
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: NSAID(含塞來昔布)可能造成胎兒動脈導管早閉及胎兒腎功能異常,導致羊水過少,部分病例併發新生兒腎功能損傷。妊娠約 20 至 30 週間應限制劑量與療程;妊娠約 30 週起及之後應避免使用。哺乳:3 篇已發表報告(共 12 位哺乳婦女)之有限資料顯示乳汁中塞來昔布濃度低(推算嬰兒平均每日劑量 10-40 mcg/kg,低於 2 歲兒童體重校正治療劑量之 1%)。
records.acupuncture_note_zh: COX-2 選擇性抑制劑對血小板功能影響相對較小,但仍屬 NSAID 類別黑框警語涵蓋之心血管/腸胃出血風險;標籤未針對針刺給出數據,長期使用者接受侵入性治療前仍應評估整體出血/心血管風險。
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: 塞來昔布消炎止痛之目的與中醫「活血化瘀」「清熱消腫」等治法有部分交集,但不構成一對一等同;含磺胺過敏史之患者為西醫明確禁忌,問診時應主動詢問磺胺藥物過敏史。

records.mechanism_en: Substituted benzimidazole antisecretory compound that suppresses gastric acid secretion by specific inhibition of the H+/K+-ATPase enzyme system at the secretory surface of the gastric parietal cell — characterized as a gastric acid-pump inhibitor blocking the final step of acid production. Dose-related; inhibits both basal and stimulated acid secretion irrespective of the stimulus.
records.mechanism_zh: 取代型苯并咪唑類抑酸化合物,藉由專一性抑制胃壁細胞分泌面之 H+/K+-ATPase 酵素系統以抑制胃酸分泌——被歸類為胃酸幫浦抑制劑,阻斷胃酸生成之最後一步。效果具劑量相關性;不論刺激來源為何,均可抑制基礎及受刺激之胃酸分泌。

drug_interactions_zh: Clopidogrel:應避免併用——奧美拉唑(抑制 CYP2C19)降低 clopidogrel 之活性代謝物與抗血小板活性,即使間隔 12 小時服用亦然;應考慮替代抗血小板療法

records.mechanism_en: PPI that suppresses the final step in gastric acid production by covalently binding to the H+/K+-ATPase enzyme system at the secretory surface of the gastric parietal cell, inhibiting both basal and stimulated gastric acid secretion irrespective of the stimulus, with a duration of antisecretory effect persisting longer than 24 hours.
records.mechanism_zh: PPI,藉由與胃壁細胞分泌面之 H+/K+-ATPase 酵素系統共價結合,抑制胃酸生成之最後一步,不論刺激來源為何,均可抑制基礎及受刺激之胃酸分泌,抑酸效果可持續超過 24 小時。
indications_en: FDA-approved: short-term treatment (up to 8 weeks) of erosive esophagitis associated with GERD (adults and pediatric patients ≥5 years)
FDA-approved: maintenance of healing of erosive esophagitis
FDA-approved: pathologic hypersecretory conditions (e.g. Zollinger-Ellison syndrome)
indications_zh: FDA 核准:胃食道逆流症相關糜爛性食道炎之短期治療(至多 8 週,成人及 5 歲以上兒童)
FDA 核准:糜爛性食道炎癒合後之維持治療
FDA 核准:病理性胃酸分泌過多狀態(如 Zollinger-Ellison 症候群)
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 急性腎小管間質性腎炎
困難梭狀桿菌相關腹瀉
高劑量/長期使用之骨折
嚴重皮膚不良反應
皮膚性/全身性紅斑性狼瘡
維生素 B12 缺乏(長期使用)
低血鎂症(長期使用)
contraindications_en: Known hypersensitivity to any component of the formulation or any substituted benzimidazole
contraindications_zh: 對本劑型任一成分或任一取代型苯并咪唑類藥物已知過敏
併用含 rilpivirine 之產品
warnings_en: Class warnings same as omeprazole: TIN, C. difficile diarrhea, bone fracture, severe cutaneous reactions, lupus erythematosus, B12 deficiency, hypomagnesemia
Use lowest effective dose and shortest duration appropriate to the condition
warnings_zh: 與奧美拉唑相同之類別警語:急性腎小管間質性腎炎、困難梭狀桿菌腹瀉、骨折、嚴重皮膚反應、紅斑性狼瘡、B12 缺乏、低血鎂症
應使用適合病症之最低有效劑量與最短療程
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Available data from published observational studies did not demonstrate an association of major malformations or other adverse pregnancy outcomes with pantoprazole. Animal reproduction studies (rats, rabbits) showed no evidence of adverse developmental outcomes at high oral doses.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 已發表觀察性研究資料未顯示泮托拉唑與重大畸形或其他不良妊娠結果有關聯。動物生殖試驗(大鼠、兔)於高口服劑量下未顯示不良發育結果證據。
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: 同 omeprazole,PPI 抑酸治療與中醫「胃火」「肝胃不和」等證型有部分症狀重疊,但不構成一對一等同。

records.mechanism_en: Selective 5-HT3 receptor antagonist. Mechanism of antiemetic action not fully characterized; ondansetron is explicitly stated NOT to be a dopamine-receptor antagonist. 5-HT3 receptors are present peripherally on vagal nerve terminals and centrally in the chemoreceptor trigger zone of the area postrema; not certain whether antiemetic action is mediated centrally, peripherally, or both.
records.mechanism_zh: 選擇性 5-HT3 受體拮抗劑。止吐機轉尚未完全釐清;標籤明確敘明昂丹司瓊並非多巴胺受體拮抗劑。5-HT3 受體周邊分布於迷走神經末梢,中樞則位於延腦最後區之化學受器觸發區;無法確定止吐作用是中樞性、周邊性或兩者兼具。
indications_en: FDA-approved: prevention of nausea/vomiting associated with highly emetogenic cancer chemotherapy (e.g. cisplatin ≥50 mg/m²)
FDA-approved: prevention of nausea/vomiting with initial and repeat courses of moderately emetogenic chemotherapy
FDA-approved: prevention of nausea/vomiting with radiotherapy (total body irradiation, high-dose abdominal fraction, or daily abdominal fractions)
FDA-approved: prevention of postoperative nausea/vomiting
indications_zh: FDA 核准:預防高致吐性化學治療(如 cisplatin ≥50 mg/m²)引起之噁心/嘔吐
FDA 核准:預防中度致吐性化學治療首次及重複療程引起之噁心/嘔吐
FDA 核准:預防放射治療(全身照射、單次高劑量腹部照射或每日腹部分次照射)引起之噁心/嘔吐
FDA 核准:預防術後噁心/嘔吐
records.off_label_en: This clinic's likely common use — nausea/vomiting of pregnancy (hyperemesis gravidarum / morning sickness) — is NOT an FDA-approved indication on this label. This label's efficacy/safety data derive from oncology, radiotherapy, and postoperative populations, not pregnancy. Pregnancy safety data on this label come from a separate, methodologically limited epidemiologic literature specific to that off-label use (see pregnancy_lactation_en).
records.off_label_zh: 本診所可能常見之用法——妊娠劇吐/孕吐——並非本標籤核准之適應症。本標籤療效/安全性資料來自腫瘤科、放射治療及術後族群,非孕期族群。標籤中之孕期安全性資料來自另一批針對此仿單外用法、方法學上有其侷限之流行病學文獻(見 pregnancy_lactation_en)。
serious_adverse_effects_en: Hypersensitivity reactions including anaphylaxis and bronchospasm
QT interval prolongation, including postmarketing Torsade de Pointes reports
Serotonin syndrome (alone or with other serotonergic drugs)
serious_adverse_effects_zh: 過敏反應,含過敏性休克及支氣管痙攣
QT 間期延長,含上市後尖端扭轉型心室頻脈通報
血清素症候群(單獨使用或併用其他血清素藥物)
contraindications_en: Known hypersensitivity (e.g. anaphylaxis) to ondansetron or any formulation component
Concomitant apomorphine use (risk of profound hypotension and loss of consciousness)
contraindications_zh: 對昂丹司瓊或任一劑型成分已知過敏(如過敏性休克)
併用 apomorphine(有嚴重低血壓及意識喪失風險)
warnings_en: Hypersensitivity reactions — discontinue if occur, treat per standard of care
QT prolongation — avoid in congenital long QT syndrome; ECG monitoring recommended with electrolyte abnormalities, CHF, bradyarrhythmias, or other QT-prolonging drugs

Serotonin syndrome — most reports involve concomitant serotonergic drugs (SSRIs, SNRIs, MAOIs, mirtazapine, fentanyl, lithium, tramadol, IV methylene blue); some fatal; can occur with ondansetron overdose alone
warnings_zh: 過敏反應——發生時應停藥並依標準照護處置
QT 延長——先天性長 QT 症候群者應避免使用;電解質異常、鬱血性心衰竭、心搏過緩型心律不整或併用其他延長 QT 藥物者建議心電圖監測
血清素症候群——多數通報涉及併用血清素相關藥物(SSRI、SNRI、MAOI、mirtazapine、fentanyl、鋰鹽、tramadol、靜脈注射 methylene blue);部分致命;昂丹司瓊單獨過量亦可能發生
records.pregnancy_lactation_en: Published epidemiological studies on the association between ondansetron use and major birth defects have reported inconsistent findings with important methodological limitations that preclude conclusions about safety in pregnancy. Available postmarketing data have not identified a drug-associated risk of miscarriage or adverse maternal outcomes. Reproductive studies in rats/rabbits did not show fetal harm at high multiples of the maximum recommended human dose.
records.pregnancy_lactation_zh: 已發表關於昂丹司瓊使用與重大出生缺陷關聯性之流行病學研究結果不一致,且有重要方法學侷限,無法對孕期安全性下定論。現有上市後資料未顯示與流產或不良母體結局有藥物相關風險。大鼠/兔生殖試驗於人體建議最高劑量之高倍數下未顯示胎兒傷害。
records.acupuncture_note_zh: 止吐效果與中醫「和胃降逆」治法(如內關穴)目的有交集,臨床上常合併使用;標籤未討論針灸,兩者機轉獨立,合併使用無已知禁忌,但仍應個別評估病因(如是否為需優先處理之腸阻塞等器質性問題)。
records.tcm_relation_note_zh: 昂丹司瓊止吐與中醫「和胃降逆」證型治法目的有交集,但不構成一對一等同;QT 延長與血清素症候群為西醫明確安全議題,應留意患者是否合併服用其他延長 QT 或血清素相關藥物。
